name: Primolut N Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About PRIMOLUT N TABLET

PRIMOLUT N TABLET contains Norethisterone, which belongs to a group of medicines called Progestogens. It is used to manage heavy menstrual bleeding or abnormal uterine bleeding (that occurs due to hormonal imbalance), painful periods, irregular periods or periods that are more frequent than normal (polymenorrhoea), premenstrual tension, endometriosis (abnormal growth of endometrial tissue of the uterus that causes pain and menstrual irregularities), metriopatheias haemorrhagia (intermenstrual bleeding) and breast cancer. It is also used to delay the menstrual cycle.

PRIMOLUT N TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pulmonary embolism (blood clots in the lung), liver disease, heart attack (myocardial infarction) or angina and deep vein thrombosis. PRIMOLUT N TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma, kidney disease, fits, and migraine headaches.

PRIMOLUT N TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy as it may affect the developing baby. Inform your doctor if you have had repeated miscarriages. PRIMOLUT N TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. If you experience mood changes and depressive symptoms, contact your doctor as soon as possible.

The most common side effects of taking PRIMOLUT N TABLET are irregular bleeding, heavy menstruation, spotting between menstrual cycles, delayed or not having a menstrual cycle, stomach discomfort, nausea, vomiting, breast tenderness, headache, and dizziness. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen

mechanismOfAction:
How PRIMOLUT N TABLET Works

PRIMOLUT N TABLET inhibits the release of pituitary hormones that are responsible for the release of female hormones (such as oestrogen and progesterone) and thereby suppressing ovulation. This action modifies the lining of the endometrium and thus ceases bleeding in menstrual abnormalities in cancer PRIMOLUT N TABLET may act by pituitary inhibition or by direct action on tumour deposits.

name: DYDROLAST 10 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About DYDROLAST 10 TABLET

DYDROLAST 10 TABLET contains Dydrogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Replacement Therapy. It is used to manage progesterone-deficiency states. It helps to manage problems that occur due to a deficiency of a female sex hormone called progesterone in the body. It helps to relieve period cramps and manage symptoms of endometriosis and premenstrual syndrome in women with progesterone deficiency. It can also be used to manage female reproductive health and is used in postmenopausal women to manage signs of menopause when used in combination with estrogens.

Dydrogesterone is a synthetic derivative of a female sex hormone called progesterone. It supplements the bodies with sufficient levels of progesterone. As a result, it relieves the unpleasant symptoms associated with progesterone deficiencies, such as menstrual pain, premenstrual syndrome, infertility, irregular periods, or signs of menopause. During management with DYDROLAST 10 TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Do not take DYDROLAST 10 TABLET if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma). Before taking DYDROLAST 10 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems, depression, or porphyria. Consult your doctor before taking DYDROLAST 10 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. DYDROLAST 10 TABLET should be used with caution in adolescent girls who have attained puberty (aged between 12-18 years).

Inform your doctor if you experience any changes in the breast, such as breast pain, tenderness, discharge from the nipple, lump growth in the breasts, heavy menstrual bleeding, pain, swelling, redness of the legs, sudden chest pain, or difficulty breathing after taking DYDROLAST 10 TABLET. The most common side effects of taking DYDROLAST 10 TABLET are severe headaches, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
uses: Manage the symptoms of endometriosis and premenstrual syndrome

mechanismOfAction:
How DYDROLAST 10 TABLET Works

DYDROLAST 10 TABLET helps in managing problems associated with progesterone deficiency states. It improves the thickness of the uterine lining, which helps in correcting infertility problems and irregular periods. It also provides relief from postmenopausal symptoms (such as hot flushes, sleep problems, irritability, and depression) by replacing the deficient progesterone levels in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use DYDROLAST 10 TABLET

Take DYDROLAST 10 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow DYDROLAST 10 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take DYDROLAST 10 TABLET at the same time each day. It can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of DYDROLAST 10 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Susten SR 200mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SUSTEN SR 200MG TABLET

SUSTEN SR 200MG TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking SUSTEN SR 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take SUSTEN SR 200MG TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with SUSTEN SR 200MG TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

SUSTEN SR 200MG TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. SUSTEN SR 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking SUSTEN SR 200MG TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How SUSTEN SR 200MG TABLET Works

SUSTEN SR 200MG TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CLOMIPURE 25MG CAPSULE

CLOMIPURE 25MG CAPSULE is a combination of Clomiphene Citrate and Melatonin, which belong to the groups of medicines called Ovarian stimulants and Nutraceutical products, respectively. It is used in the management of female infertility, which means not being able to get pregnant after at least one year of trying (or 6 months if the woman is over age 35) or a woman who keeps having miscarriages. It can result from age, physical problems, hormone problems and lifestyle or environmental factors and present as abnormal periods, heavy menstrual bleeding or lighter than usual, irregular periods, the number of days in between each period varying each month, painful periods or periods that suddenly stop.

Before starting CLOMIPURE 25MG CAPSULE, your doctor should check for any other causes of fertility problems. CLOMIPURE 25MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease, unusual menstrual bleeding where the cause is not known, hormone-dependent cancers or ovarian cysts. Before taking CLOMIPURE 25MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have early menopause or stopped having periods because you are underweight, have uterine fibroids, polycystic ovaries or swollen ovaries, hypertriglyceridemia, epilepsy, autoimmune disease, diabetes or smoking habit.

CLOMIPURE 25MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children, adolescents (below 18 years of age) and post-menopausal women. The common side effects of CLOMIPURE 25MG CAPSULE are flushing, pelvic discomfort or abdominal distention or bloating, nausea and vomiting, painful breasts and headaches. If any of these become worse, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CLOMIPURE 25MG CAPSULE
Used to manage female infertility
mechanismOfAction:
How CLOMIPURE 25MG CAPSULE Works

CLOMIPURE 25MG CAPSULE is a combination of Clomiphene citrate that selectively binds to estrogen hormone receptors in the brain, ovary, endometrium and cervix to increase the secretion of the luteinizing hormone as well as a follicle-stimulating hormone for the release of a mature egg from ovaries and Melatonin improves egg quality by reducing the damage, which in turn leads to higher fertilization rate. This collective action is useful in managing female infertility.
usageDetails:
How to use CLOMIPURE 25MG CAPSULE

Take CLOMIPURE 25MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. The correct dose and duration for you will be decided by your doctor, depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Estrabet 1mg Tablet 28'S
introduction:
Introduction About ESTRABET 1MG TABLET

ESTRABET 1MG TABLET contains Estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Estrogens. ESTRABET 1MG TABLET is used in postmenopausal women (with at least 6 months since their last natural period) to provide relief from symptoms that occurs after menopause. It is also used to manage osteoporosis (condition marked by weak and fragile bones) which occurs after menopause in few women.

ESTRABET 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Estradiol. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have/had/suspected of breast/endometrial cancer or thrombosis (blood clot in vein). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who suffer from unusual vaginal bleeding, unmanageed endometrial hyperplasia (excessive thickening of the womb lining), lung disease (such as pulmonary embolism), heart disease (such as heart attack/heart block), and/or liver disease (such as benign liver tumour).

Before taking ESTRABET 1MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have fibroids (non-cancerous growths inside womb), endometriosis (growth of womb lining outside womb)/endometrial hyperplasia (excessive growth of the womb lining), and/or suffer from epilepsy, otosclerosis (disease that affects eardrum and hearing), kidney problems, and/or lung problems (such as asthma).

ESTRABET 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women since it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women. The medicine is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents since it is indicated for use only in postmenopausal women. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly women (aged 60 years and above) after consulting the doctor since the medicine may increase the risk of heart disease in elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking ESTRABET 1MG TABLET are headache, nausea, cramps in legs, abdominal/pelvic pain, unscheduled bleeding/spotting, asthenia (feeling of weakness), and/or rash/itching. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

Introduction About MEPRATE 10MG TABLET

MEPRATE 10MG TABLET contains Medroxyprogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal medicines. It is used to maintain balance on menstrual cycle and controls abnormal tissue growth in the uterus.

MEPRATE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems, breast cancer, venous thrombosis or arterial thrombosis, porphyria, undiagnosed vaginal bleeding, heart attack or stroke.   

MEPRATE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women as it can affect the developing baby. If you think you are pregnant or planning to have baby or have a history of repeated miscarriage, breastfeeding inform your doctor before taking MEPRATE 10MG TABLET.

MEPRATE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. The most common side effects of taking MEPRATE 10MG TABLET are headache, nausea, difficulty sleeping, tiredness and hair loss. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEPRATE 10MG TABLET Works

MEPRATE 10MG TABLET works by stopping the production of gonadotropin hormone, which is responsible for maturation of cells in the ovary and the process of releasing mature egg from the ovary (ovulation) to avoid pregnancy. This kind of action also thins the endometrium (uterus lining), which in turn provides relief from unpleasant period symptoms.

introduction:
Introduction About ESTRAHENZ TABLET

ESTRAHENZ TABLET contains Estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Estrogens. ESTRAHENZ TABLET is used in postmenopausal women (with at least 6 months since their last natural period) to provide relief from symptoms that occurs after menopause. It is also used to manage osteoporosis (condition marked by weak and fragile bones) which occurs after menopause in few women.

ESTRAHENZ TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Estradiol. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have/had/suspected of breast/endometrial cancer or thrombosis (blood clot in vein). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who suffer from unusual vaginal bleeding, unmanageed endometrial hyperplasia (excessive thickening of the womb lining), lung disease (such as pulmonary embolism), heart disease (such as heart attack/heart block), and/or liver disease (such as benign liver tumour).

Before taking ESTRAHENZ TABLET, inform your doctor if you have fibroids (non-cancerous growths inside womb), endometriosis (growth of womb lining outside womb)/endometrial hyperplasia (excessive growth of the womb lining), and/or suffer from epilepsy, otosclerosis (disease that affects eardrum and hearing), kidney problems, and/or lung problems (such as asthma).

ESTRAHENZ TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women since it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women. The medicine is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents since it is indicated for use only in postmenopausal women. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly women (aged 60 years and above) after consulting the doctor since the medicine may increase the risk of heart disease in elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking ESTRAHENZ TABLET are headache, nausea, cramps in legs, abdominal/pelvic pain, unscheduled bleeding/spotting, asthenia (feeling of weakness), and/or rash/itching. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

Have/recently had blood clots in arteries such as stroke
Suffer from inherited porphyria (rare blood disorder)

Before taking ESTRAHENZ TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have fibroids (non-cancerous growths) inside womb
Suffer from endometriosis (growth of womb lining outside womb) or have a history of endometrial hyperplasia (excessive growth of the womb lining)
Have an increased risk of developing blood clots
Have an increased risk of developing estrogen-sensitive cancer such as mother, sister/ grandmother who has/had breast cancer
Suffer from high blood pressure, diabetes, gallstones, migraine/severe headaches
Suffer from systemic lupus erythematosus (disease of the immune system that affects many organs of the body)
Suffer from epilepsy
Suffer from otosclerosis (disease affecting eardrum and hearing), hereditary and acquired angioedema
Are scheduled for any surgery

Use in Paediatrics:

ESTRAHENZ TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents since it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women.

Use in Geriatrics:

ESTRAHENZ TABLET should be used with caution in elderly women (aged 60 years and above) due to increased risk of developing heart disease.  Consult your doctor before taking ESTRAHENZ TABLET.

Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin, rifabutin)

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of ESTRAHENZ TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are nausea, vomiting, sleepiness, dizziness, and/or withdrawal bleeding.

introduction:
Introduction About SUSTEN 8% GEL

SUSTEN 8% GEL is a vaginal gel used in females to manage female infertility due to incorrect levels of progesterone during the menstrual cycle or when you are having an assisted fertility procedure.

It contains a medicine called Progesterone which is a synthetic female hormone. When the gel is inserted into your vagina, the progesterone will slowly release into your bloodstream throughout the day which mimics the actions of natural progesterone produced in your body.

SUSTEN 8% GEL is for vaginal use only. Gently insert the gel using the applicator into the vagina. Wash your hands before and after application. Before using this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems, asthma, diabetes, epilepsy, unexplained vaginal bleeding, migraine or history of depression as a precaution.

SUSTEN 8% GEL is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. It is normally not suggested during pregnancy, unless you have used this medicine to help become pregnancy. The most common side effects of using SUSTEN 8% GEL are breast tenderness, stomach cramps, pelvic pain, pain around genital area, vaginal discharge or itching, low sex drive, and sleepiness. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

Talk to your doctor if you experience breast enlargement and pain after using this medicine.

Female Infertility
mechanismOfAction:
How SUSTEN 8% GEL Works

SUSTEN 8% GEL contains progesterone which is a synthetic form of naturally occurring female sex hormone. Upon application into the vagina, it slowly releases the medicine and mimic as a natural progesterone which is required in maintaining optimum uterine thickness for egg implantation and maintenance of pregnancy in the early stages.
usageInstructions: Use SUSTEN 8% GEL under medical supervision
Wash your hands thoroughly with soap and water.
SUSTEN 8% GEL usually comes with a pre-filled applicator. Take the required amount of the medicine into the gel applicator
Lie on your back with your knees bent or stand with one foot elevated, whichever is more comfortable for you.
Gently insert the gel using the applicator into your vagina, pushing it as far as comfortable.
Slowly press the plunger to release the gel into the vagina.
Remove the applicator and discard it if it’s disposable or wash it with soap and water if it’s reusable.
Wash your hands again after the application.
Follow your doctor’s instructions regarding the timing and frequency of use.

introduction:
Introduction About DEVIRY 10MG TABLET

DEVIRY 10MG TABLET contains Medroxyprogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal medicines. It is used to maintain balance on menstrual cycle and controls abnormal tissue growth in the uterus.

DEVIRY 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems, breast cancer, venous thrombosis or arterial thrombosis, porphyria, undiagnosed vaginal bleeding, heart attack or stroke.   

DEVIRY 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women as it can affect the developing baby. If you think you are pregnant or planning to have baby or have a history of repeated miscarriage, breastfeeding inform your doctor before taking DEVIRY 10MG TABLET.

DEVIRY 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. The most common side effects of taking DEVIRY 10MG TABLET are headache, nausea, difficulty sleeping, tiredness and hair loss. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How DEVIRY 10MG TABLET Works

DEVIRY 10MG TABLET works by stopping the production of gonadotropin hormone, which is responsible for maturation of cells in the ovary and the process of releasing mature egg from the ovary (ovulation) to avoid pregnancy. This kind of action also thins the endometrium (uterus lining), which in turn provides relief from unpleasant period symptoms.

Take DEVIRY 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow DEVIRY 10MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DYDROSURE 10 TABLET

DYDROSURE 10 TABLET contains Dydrogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Replacement Therapy. It is used to manage progesterone-deficiency states. It helps to manage problems that occur due to a deficiency of a female sex hormone called progesterone in the body. It helps to relieve period cramps and manage symptoms of endometriosis and premenstrual syndrome in women with progesterone deficiency. It can also be used to manage female reproductive health and is used in postmenopausal women to manage signs of menopause when used in combination with estrogens.

Dydrogesterone is a synthetic derivative of a female sex hormone called progesterone. It supplements the bodies with sufficient levels of progesterone. As a result, it relieves the unpleasant symptoms associated with progesterone deficiencies, such as menstrual pain, premenstrual syndrome, infertility, irregular periods, or signs of menopause. During management with DYDROSURE 10 TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Do not take DYDROSURE 10 TABLET if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma). Before taking DYDROSURE 10 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems, depression, or porphyria. Consult your doctor before taking DYDROSURE 10 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. DYDROSURE 10 TABLET should be used with caution in adolescent girls who have attained puberty (aged between 12-18 years).

Inform your doctor if you experience any changes in the breast, such as breast pain, tenderness, discharge from the nipple, lump growth in the breasts, heavy menstrual bleeding, pain, swelling, redness of the legs, sudden chest pain, or difficulty breathing after taking DYDROSURE 10 TABLET. The most common side effects of taking DYDROSURE 10 TABLET are severe headaches, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

How DYDROSURE 10 TABLET Works

DYDROSURE 10 TABLET helps in managing problems associated with progesterone deficiency states. It improves the thickness of the uterine lining, which helps in correcting infertility problems and irregular periods. It also provides relief from postmenopausal symptoms (such as hot flushes, sleep problems, irritability, and depression) by replacing the deficient progesterone levels in the body.

Take DYDROSURE 10 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow DYDROSURE 10 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take DYDROSURE 10 TABLET at the same time each day. It can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of DYDROSURE 10 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DYDROWELL TABLET

DYDROWELL TABLET contains Dydrogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Replacement Therapy. It is used to manage progesterone-deficiency states. It helps to manage problems that occur due to a deficiency of a female sex hormone called progesterone in the body. It helps to relieve period cramps and manage symptoms of endometriosis and premenstrual syndrome in women with progesterone deficiency. It can also be used to manage female reproductive health and is used in postmenopausal women to manage signs of menopause when used in combination with estrogens.

Dydrogesterone is a synthetic derivative of a female sex hormone called progesterone. It supplements the bodies with sufficient levels of progesterone. As a result, it relieves the unpleasant symptoms associated with progesterone deficiencies, such as menstrual pain, premenstrual syndrome, infertility, irregular periods, or signs of menopause. During management with DYDROWELL TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Do not take DYDROWELL TABLET if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma). Before taking DYDROWELL TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems, depression, or porphyria. Consult your doctor before taking DYDROWELL TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. DYDROWELL TABLET should be used with caution in adolescent girls who have attained puberty (aged between 12-18 years).

Inform your doctor if you experience any changes in the breast, such as breast pain, tenderness, discharge from the nipple, lump growth in the breasts, heavy menstrual bleeding, pain, swelling, redness of the legs, sudden chest pain, or difficulty breathing after taking DYDROWELL TABLET. The most common side effects of taking DYDROWELL TABLET are severe headaches, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

How DYDROWELL TABLET Works

DYDROWELL TABLET helps in managing problems associated with progesterone deficiency states. It improves the thickness of the uterine lining, which helps in correcting infertility problems and irregular periods. It also provides relief from postmenopausal symptoms (such as hot flushes, sleep problems, irritability, and depression) by replacing the deficient progesterone levels in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use DYDROWELL TABLET

Take DYDROWELL TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow DYDROWELL TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take DYDROWELL TABLET at the same time each day. It can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of DYDROWELL TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: EV ACTIVE Tablet 28's
introduction:
Introduction About EV ACTIVE TABLET

EV ACTIVE TABLET contains Estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Estrogens. EV ACTIVE TABLET is used in postmenopausal women (with at least 6 months since their last natural period) to provide relief from symptoms that occurs after menopause. It is also used to manage osteoporosis (condition marked by weak and fragile bones) which occurs after menopause in few women.

EV ACTIVE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Estradiol. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have/had/suspected of breast/endometrial cancer or thrombosis (blood clot in vein). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who suffer from unusual vaginal bleeding, unmanageed endometrial hyperplasia (excessive thickening of the womb lining), lung disease (such as pulmonary embolism), heart disease (such as heart attack/heart block), and/or liver disease (such as benign liver tumour).

Before taking EV ACTIVE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have fibroids (non-cancerous growths inside womb), endometriosis (growth of womb lining outside womb)/endometrial hyperplasia (excessive growth of the womb lining), and/or suffer from epilepsy, otosclerosis (disease that affects eardrum and hearing), kidney problems, and/or lung problems (such as asthma).

EV ACTIVE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women since it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women. The medicine is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents since it is indicated for use only in postmenopausal women. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly women (aged 60 years and above) after consulting the doctor since the medicine may increase the risk of heart disease in elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking EV ACTIVE TABLET are headache, nausea, cramps in legs, abdominal/pelvic pain, unscheduled bleeding/spotting, asthenia (feeling of weakness), and/or rash/itching. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

Have/recently had blood clots in arteries such as stroke

Are scheduled for any surgery

introduction:
Introduction About GESTOFORD 200 CAPSULE

GESTOFORD 200 CAPSULE is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking GESTOFORD 200 CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take GESTOFORD 200 CAPSULE if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with GESTOFORD 200 CAPSULE, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

GESTOFORD 200 CAPSULE may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. GESTOFORD 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking GESTOFORD 200 CAPSULE are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How GESTOFORD 200 CAPSULE Works

GESTOFORD 200 CAPSULE is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DYDROBOON TABLET

DYDROBOON TABLET contains Dydrogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Replacement Therapy. It is used to manage progesterone-deficiency states. It helps to manage problems that occur due to a deficiency of a female sex hormone called progesterone in the body. It helps to relieve period cramps and manage symptoms of endometriosis and premenstrual syndrome in women with progesterone deficiency. It can also be used to manage female reproductive health and is used in postmenopausal women to manage signs of menopause when used in combination with estrogens.

Dydrogesterone is a synthetic derivative of a female sex hormone called progesterone. It supplements the bodies with sufficient levels of progesterone. As a result, it relieves the unpleasant symptoms associated with progesterone deficiencies, such as menstrual pain, premenstrual syndrome, infertility, irregular periods, or signs of menopause. During management with DYDROBOON TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Do not take DYDROBOON TABLET if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma). Before taking DYDROBOON TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems, depression, or porphyria. Consult your doctor before taking DYDROBOON TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. DYDROBOON TABLET should be used with caution in adolescent girls who have attained puberty (aged between 12-18 years).

Inform your doctor if you experience any changes in the breast, such as breast pain, tenderness, discharge from the nipple, lump growth in the breasts, heavy menstrual bleeding, pain, swelling, redness of the legs, sudden chest pain, or difficulty breathing after taking DYDROBOON TABLET. The most common side effects of taking DYDROBOON TABLET are severe headaches, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About DYDRO FEM TABLET

DYDRO FEM TABLET contains Dydrogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Replacement Therapy. It is used to manage progesterone-deficiency states. It helps to manage problems that occur due to a deficiency of a female sex hormone called progesterone in the body. It helps to relieve period cramps and manage symptoms of endometriosis and premenstrual syndrome in women with progesterone deficiency. It can also be used to manage female reproductive health and is used in postmenopausal women to manage signs of menopause when used in combination with estrogens.

Dydrogesterone is a synthetic derivative of a female sex hormone called progesterone. It supplements the bodies with sufficient levels of progesterone. As a result, it relieves the unpleasant symptoms associated with progesterone deficiencies, such as menstrual pain, premenstrual syndrome, infertility, irregular periods, or signs of menopause. During management with DYDRO FEM TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Do not take DYDRO FEM TABLET if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma). Before taking DYDRO FEM TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems, depression, or porphyria. Consult your doctor before taking DYDRO FEM TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. DYDRO FEM TABLET should be used with caution in adolescent girls who have attained puberty (aged between 12-18 years).

Inform your doctor if you experience any changes in the breast, such as breast pain, tenderness, discharge from the nipple, lump growth in the breasts, heavy menstrual bleeding, pain, swelling, redness of the legs, sudden chest pain, or difficulty breathing after taking DYDRO FEM TABLET. The most common side effects of taking DYDRO FEM TABLET are severe headaches, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

How DYDRO FEM TABLET Works

DYDRO FEM TABLET helps in managing problems associated with progesterone deficiency states. It improves the thickness of the uterine lining, which helps in correcting infertility problems and irregular periods. It also provides relief from postmenopausal symptoms (such as hot flushes, sleep problems, irritability, and depression) by replacing the deficient progesterone levels in the body.

It can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of DYDRO FEM TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About EVADIOL TABLET

EVADIOL TABLET contains Estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Estrogens. EVADIOL TABLET is used in postmenopausal women (with at least 6 months since their last natural period) to provide relief from symptoms that occurs after menopause. It is also used to manage osteoporosis (condition marked by weak and fragile bones) which occurs after menopause in few women.

EVADIOL TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Estradiol. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have/had/suspected of breast/endometrial cancer or thrombosis (blood clot in vein). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who suffer from unusual vaginal bleeding, unmanageed endometrial hyperplasia (excessive thickening of the womb lining), lung disease (such as pulmonary embolism), heart disease (such as heart attack/heart block), and/or liver disease (such as benign liver tumour).

Before taking EVADIOL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have fibroids (non-cancerous growths inside womb), endometriosis (growth of womb lining outside womb)/endometrial hyperplasia (excessive growth of the womb lining), and/or suffer from epilepsy, otosclerosis (disease that affects eardrum and hearing), kidney problems, and/or lung problems (such as asthma).

EVADIOL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women since it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women. The medicine is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents since it is indicated for use only in postmenopausal women. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly women (aged 60 years and above) after consulting the doctor since the medicine may increase the risk of heart disease in elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking EVADIOL TABLET are headache, nausea, cramps in legs, abdominal/pelvic pain, unscheduled bleeding/spotting, asthenia (feeling of weakness), and/or rash/itching. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About CLOVUMIN 50MG TABLET

CLOVUMIN 50MG TABLET contains Clomiphene which belongs to the group of medicines called Ovulation Stimulators. It is used in the management of female infertility. It can promote ovulation (release of matured egg from the ovaries) in women who do not produce eggs and in women undergoing fertility managements.

Prior to the management, your doctor may evaluate your fertility status thoroughly as a precaution. During management with CLOVUMIN 50MG TABLET, your doctor will closely monitor your health condition through several blood tests and ultrasounds to avoid the risk of side effects.

Before taking CLOVUMIN 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidney or liver. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, high blood fat levels, unexplained vaginal bleeding, early menopause, cyst in the ovaries or cancer in the breast, uterus or ovaries as a precaution.

CLOVUMIN 50MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant women after successful conception. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in children or adolescents (aged below 18 years).

introduction:
Introduction About REGESTRONE CR 15MG TABLET

REGESTRONE CR 15MG TABLET contains Norethisterone, which belongs to a group of medicines called Progestogens. It is used to manage heavy menstrual bleeding or abnormal uterine bleeding (that occurs due to hormonal imbalance), painful periods, irregular periods or periods that are more frequent than normal (polymenorrhoea), premenstrual tension, endometriosis (abnormal growth of endometrial tissue of the uterus that causes pain and menstrual irregularities), metriopatheias haemorrhagia (intermenstrual bleeding) and breast cancer. It is also used to delay the menstrual cycle.

REGESTRONE CR 15MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pulmonary embolism (blood clots in the lung), liver disease, heart attack (myocardial infarction) or angina and deep vein thrombosis. REGESTRONE CR 15MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma, kidney disease, fits, and migraine headaches.

REGESTRONE CR 15MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy as it may affect the developing baby. Inform your doctor if you have had repeated miscarriages. REGESTRONE CR 15MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. If you experience mood changes and depressive symptoms, contact your doctor as soon as possible.

The most common side effects of taking REGESTRONE CR 15MG TABLET are irregular bleeding, heavy menstruation, spotting between menstrual cycles, delayed or not having a menstrual cycle, stomach discomfort, nausea, vomiting, breast tenderness, headache, and dizziness. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How REGESTRONE CR 15MG TABLET Works

REGESTRONE CR 15MG TABLET inhibits the release of pituitary hormones that are responsible for the release of female hormones (such as oestrogen and progesterone) and thereby suppressing ovulation. This action modifies the lining of the endometrium and thus ceases bleeding in menstrual abnormalities in cancer REGESTRONE CR 15MG TABLET may act by pituitary inhibition or by direct action on tumour deposits.

introduction:
Introduction About SUSTEN 400MG CAPSULE

SUSTEN 400MG CAPSULE is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking SUSTEN 400MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take SUSTEN 400MG CAPSULE if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with SUSTEN 400MG CAPSULE, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

SUSTEN 400MG CAPSULE may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. SUSTEN 400MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking SUSTEN 400MG CAPSULE are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SUSTEN 400MG CAPSULE

It is used in the management of the following progesterone deficiency conditions such as:

Female infertility
Abnormal uterine bleeding
Menopausal disorders

Threatened abortions and pre-term delivery
mechanismOfAction:
How SUSTEN 400MG CAPSULE Works

SUSTEN 400MG CAPSULE is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DYDROLADY 10MG TABLET

DYDROLADY 10MG TABLET contains Dydrogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Replacement Therapy. It is used to manage progesterone-deficiency states. It helps to manage problems that occur due to a deficiency of a female sex hormone called progesterone in the body. It helps to relieve period cramps and manage symptoms of endometriosis and premenstrual syndrome in women with progesterone deficiency. It can also be used to manage female reproductive health and is used in postmenopausal women to manage signs of menopause when used in combination with estrogens.

Dydrogesterone is a synthetic derivative of a female sex hormone called progesterone. It supplements the bodies with sufficient levels of progesterone. As a result, it relieves the unpleasant symptoms associated with progesterone deficiencies, such as menstrual pain, premenstrual syndrome, infertility, irregular periods, or signs of menopause. During management with DYDROLADY 10MG TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Do not take DYDROLADY 10MG TABLET if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma). Before taking DYDROLADY 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems, depression, or porphyria. Consult your doctor before taking DYDROLADY 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. DYDROLADY 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in adolescent girls who have attained puberty (aged between 12-18 years).

Inform your doctor if you experience any changes in the breast, such as breast pain, tenderness, discharge from the nipple, lump growth in the breasts, heavy menstrual bleeding, pain, swelling, redness of the legs, sudden chest pain, or difficulty breathing after taking DYDROLADY 10MG TABLET. The most common side effects of taking DYDROLADY 10MG TABLET are severe headaches, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About SUSTEN 100MG INJECTION

SUSTEN 100MG INJECTION is used for the maintenance of early pregnancy in patients who faced documented history of repeated miscarriages due to luteal phase defect (a problem in menstrual cycle caused due to deficiency of progesterone during the midway of the menstrual cycle).

It can also be used as an adjuvant to infertility techniques (such as in vitro fertilization (IVF) or gamete intra-fallopian transfer (GIFT)) to facilitate successful implantation of the fertilized egg in the uterus. It is also used to manage threatened abortions and to manage abnormal uterine bleeding caused due to hormonal imbalance.

It can be used as a diagnostic tool in progesterone withdrawal testing to diagnose the endocrinal causes of secondary amenorrhea (irregular or lack of menstrual periods) and to judge the chances of pregnancy among infertile women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before receiving SUSTEN 100MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, epilepsy, or migraine headaches before receiving SUSTEN 100MG INJECTION as a precaution.

SUSTEN 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, ovarian cancer, uterine cancer, blood clot problems or any vaginal infections. SUSTEN 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

SUSTEN 100MG INJECTION can be used during the first three months of pregnancy. However, it should not be used in women who have ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside the womb) and in women who had a history of idiopathic jaundice (severe itching of the skin) or other skin problems during their earlier pregnancies.

The most common side effects of receiving SUSTEN 100MG INJECTION are pain, redness, itching, irritation or swelling at the injection site, vaginal bleeding, headache, bloating, nausea, hair loss, abnormal hair growth in the body, darkening of the facial skin or difficulty in sleeping. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. Talk to your doctor immediately if you experience any changes in body weight or feel depressed while receiving SUSTEN 100MG INJECTION.

introduction:
Introduction About MACGEST 200MG CAPSULE

MACGEST 200MG CAPSULE is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking MACGEST 200MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take MACGEST 200MG CAPSULE if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with MACGEST 200MG CAPSULE, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

MACGEST 200MG CAPSULE may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. MACGEST 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking MACGEST 200MG CAPSULE are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How MACGEST 200MG CAPSULE Works

MACGEST 200MG CAPSULE is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SII EVATONE 2 TABLET

SII EVATONE 2 TABLET contains Estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Estrogens. SII EVATONE 2 TABLET is used in postmenopausal women (with at least 6 months since their last natural period) to provide relief from symptoms that occurs after menopause. It is also used to manage osteoporosis (condition marked by weak and fragile bones) which occurs after menopause in few women.

SII EVATONE 2 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Estradiol. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have/had/suspected of breast/endometrial cancer or thrombosis (blood clot in vein). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who suffer from unusual vaginal bleeding, unmanageed endometrial hyperplasia (excessive thickening of the womb lining), lung disease (such as pulmonary embolism), heart disease (such as heart attack/heart block), and/or liver disease (such as benign liver tumour).

Before taking SII EVATONE 2 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have fibroids (non-cancerous growths inside womb), endometriosis (growth of womb lining outside womb)/endometrial hyperplasia (excessive growth of the womb lining), and/or suffer from epilepsy, otosclerosis (disease that affects eardrum and hearing), kidney problems, and/or lung problems (such as asthma).

SII EVATONE 2 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women since it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women. The medicine is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents since it is indicated for use only in postmenopausal women. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly women (aged 60 years and above) after consulting the doctor since the medicine may increase the risk of heart disease in elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking SII EVATONE 2 TABLET are headache, nausea, cramps in legs, abdominal/pelvic pain, unscheduled bleeding/spotting, asthenia (feeling of weakness), and/or rash/itching. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

Introduction About DUPHASTON 10MG TABLET
What is Duphaston 10mg Tablet?

Duphaston 10mg Tablet contains Dydrogesterone, a well-studied synthetic progesterone. It is often prescribed as part of a hormone support plan for individuals managing menstrual cycle irregularities or undergoing reproductive care. This tablet mimics the action of natural progesterone, contributing to a more stable hormonal profile.

Use Duphaston 10mg Tablet exactly as directed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken orally with or without food. Dosage and duration depend on your specific health goals and medical history.

During management with Duphaston 10mg Tablet, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Duphaston helps support hormonal balance by mimicking the natural actions of progesterone during the second half (luteal phase) of the menstrual cycle. This can assist in regulating the uterine lining and promoting cycle regularity. Women who experience inconsistent cycles, mid-cycle spotting, or other cycle-related issues due to hormonal imbalances may benefit from its regulated use as advised by their healthcare provider.

Before starting Duphaston 10mg, it is important to consult a healthcare professional to evaluate the underlying cause of hormonal changes. Usage in pregnancy, breastfeeding, or with other hormonal therapies should always be discussed in advance. Do not take Duphaston 10mg Tablet, if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma).

The most common side effects of taking Duphaston 10mg Tablet are severe headache, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DUPHASTON 10MG TABLET Works
Understanding the Role of Dydrogesterone

Duphaston 10mg Tablet contains Dydrogesterone, a synthetic form of the natural hormone progesterone. It mimics the hormonal activity needed for cycle regulation and supports the environment needed for hormone-responsive conditions. Unlike some other compounds, Dydrogesterone does not have androgenic or estrogenic effects, making it more selective in its action. This tablet is often used in hormone support strategies where balanced progesterone activity is essential.

Is Duphaston a natural or synthetic hormone?
Duphaston contains dydrogesterone, which is a synthetic hormone. It is a synthetic form of the naturally occurring hormone progesterone
How Duphaston may help with menstrual irregularities?

During a normal menstrual cycle, progesterone levels rise in the second half (luteal phase) to prepare the uterus for possible pregnancy. If pregnancy does not occur, progesterone levels drop, triggering menstruation. When the body does not produce enough progesterone, it can lead to irregular or missed periods, spotting, or cycle-related discomfort.

Duphaston compensates for this hormonal gap by providing dydrogesterone, which:

Helps maintain the natural rhythm of the menstrual cycle
Supports the uterine lining (endometrium) during the luteal phase
Encourages a predictable withdrawal bleed, simulating a natural period when the tablet is stopped
Duphaston Tablet uses in Pregnancy: 

It is often prescribed during pregnancy to help maintain a healthy pregnancy, particularly in cases where there is a risk of miscarriage or preterm labor due to progesterone deficiency. It supports the uterine lining, making it more favorable for embryo implantation and helps sustain early pregnancy. Duphaston may also be used in women who have a history of recurrent miscarriages or those undergoing fertility management.

Duphaston Tablet Uses in Menstrual Disorders:

Duphaston helps balance hormones, reducing the intense uterine contractions that cause pain during menstruation. By reducing the growth of the endometrial tissue that grows outside the uterus, it relieves pain and discomfort associated with endometriosis. Duphaston helps stabilize hormone levels, reducing mood swings, bloating, and other symptoms of PMS.

introduction:
Introduction About PROGYNOVA 2MG TABLET

PROGYNOVA 2MG TABLET contains Estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Estrogens. PROGYNOVA 2MG TABLET is used in postmenopausal women (with at least 6 months since their last natural period) to provide relief from symptoms that occurs after menopause. It is also used to manage osteoporosis (condition marked by weak and fragile bones) which occurs after menopause in few women.

PROGYNOVA 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Estradiol. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have/had/suspected of breast/endometrial cancer or thrombosis (blood clot in vein). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who suffer from unusual vaginal bleeding, unmanageed endometrial hyperplasia (excessive thickening of the womb lining), lung disease (such as pulmonary embolism), heart disease (such as heart attack/heart block), and/or liver disease (such as benign liver tumour).

Before taking PROGYNOVA 2MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have fibroids (non-cancerous growths inside womb), endometriosis (growth of womb lining outside womb)/endometrial hyperplasia (excessive growth of the womb lining), and/or suffer from epilepsy, otosclerosis (disease that affects eardrum and hearing), kidney problems, and/or lung problems (such as asthma).

PROGYNOVA 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women since it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women. The medicine is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents since it is indicated for use only in postmenopausal women. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly women (aged 60 years and above) after consulting the doctor since the medicine may increase the risk of heart disease in elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking PROGYNOVA 2MG TABLET are headache, nausea, cramps in legs, abdominal/pelvic pain, unscheduled bleeding/spotting, asthenia (feeling of weakness), and/or rash/itching. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking PROGYNOVA 2MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage blood clotting (Ex. warfarin)
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. phenobarbital, phenytoin, carbamazepine)
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin, rifabutin)
Anti-retroviral medicines used to manage HIV (Ex. nevirapine, efavirenz, ritonavir, nelfinavir)
St John’s Wort (herbal medicine used to manage depression)
Medicines used to manage Hepatitis C Virus (Ex. boceprevir, telaprevir)

Fentanyl (used to reduce pain)
Theophylline (used for asthma and other breathing problems)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of PROGYNOVA 2MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are nausea, vomiting, sleepiness, dizziness, and/or withdrawal bleeding.

NOSTRA CR 15MG TABLET contains Norethisterone, which belongs to a group of medicines called Progestogens. It is used to manage heavy menstrual bleeding or abnormal uterine bleeding (that occurs due to hormonal imbalance), painful periods, irregular periods or periods that are more frequent than normal (polymenorrhoea), premenstrual tension, endometriosis (abnormal growth of endometrial tissue of the uterus that causes pain and menstrual irregularities), metriopatheias haemorrhagia (intermenstrual bleeding) and breast cancer. It is also used to delay the menstrual cycle.

NOSTRA CR 15MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pulmonary embolism (blood clots in the lung), liver disease, heart attack (myocardial infarction) or angina and deep vein thrombosis. NOSTRA CR 15MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma, kidney disease, fits, and migraine headaches.

NOSTRA CR 15MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy as it may affect the developing baby. Inform your doctor if you have had repeated miscarriages. NOSTRA CR 15MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. If you experience mood changes and depressive symptoms, contact your doctor as soon as possible.

The most common side effects of taking NOSTRA CR 15MG TABLET are irregular bleeding, heavy menstruation, spotting between menstrual cycles, delayed or not having a menstrual cycle, stomach discomfort, nausea, vomiting, breast tenderness, headache, and dizziness. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How NOSTRA CR 15MG TABLET Works

NOSTRA CR 15MG TABLET inhibits the release of pituitary hormones that are responsible for the release of female hormones (such as oestrogen and progesterone) and thereby suppressing ovulation. This action modifies the lining of the endometrium and thus ceases bleeding in menstrual abnormalities in cancer NOSTRA CR 15MG TABLET may act by pituitary inhibition or by direct action on tumour deposits.

NOSTRA CR 15MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had a pulmonary embolism (blood clots in the lung) and should be used with caution in patients with asthma. Contact your doctor before taking NOSTRA CR 15MG TABLET.
NOSTRA CR 15MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with active or recent angina (chest pain) or heart attack. Contact your doctor before taking NOSTRA CR 15MG TABLET.

Others

NOSTRA CR 15MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Blood disorders like porphyria
Clotting disorders like deep vein thrombosis or a family history of the same
Pruritis (a condition with severe generalised itching of the body)
Undiagnosed vaginal bleeding (not a period)

Before taking NOSTRA CR 15MG TABLET tell your doctor if you have:

Epilepsy
Migraine headache
Are very overweight
Systemic lupus erythematosus.
A blood clot in the veins
Are unable to move for long periods (Ex. after an operation)
Serious injury
Have major surgery or are going to have an operation (particularly abdominal or orthopaedic surgery to the lower limbs)
Blood tests (for liver function, thyroid function, and coagulation).
Vision impairment, bulging eyes, double vision
Depression

Anticancer medicines

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more of NOSTRA CR 15MG TABLET, contact your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital immediately if the symptoms worsen. The symptoms may include nausea, vomiting, breast enlargement and vaginal bleeding.

name: Susten 200mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE

SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE

It is used in the management of the following progesterone deficiency conditions such as:

Female infertility
Abnormal uterine bleeding
Menopausal disorders
Secondary amenorrhea
Supports early stages of pregnancy
Threatened abortions and pre-term delivery
mechanismOfAction:
How SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE Works

SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Common Side Effects of SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE:
Headache

Irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting
Stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, constipation
Hair loss

Vaginal yeast infection

Stop taking SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Signs of liver disease (such as yellow skin or white of the eyes)
Severely high blood pressure (signs include headache, tiredness and dizziness)
Migraine-like headaches (happening for the first time)
Sudden or gradual, partial, or complete loss of eyesight
Bulging of one or both eyes, double vision
Swelling of the optic nerve
Retinal vascular lesions (eye diseases)
Signs of blood clot (such as painful swelling and redness of the legs, sudden chest pain and trouble breathing)

warnings.details: SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE can be taken by pregnant women to support the growth of fetus during the early stages of pregnancy. However, consult your doctor before taking it.
SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use during breast-feeding. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or drowsy after taking SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE.
SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.
SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients who had or have liver disease and with abnormal liver function test. It should be used with caution in patients with benign liver tumor.
Do not take SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Progesterone.
SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients who had or have blood clot in the lungs (pulmonary embolism). It should be used with caution in patients with asthma.
SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent heart attack or chest pain. It should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure.
SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

Others

SUSTEN 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have known or suspected cancer of the breast or womb lining (endometrium)
Have unusual vaginal bleeding
Had or have blood clots in the legs (deep venous thrombosis) or in the veins (thrombosis)
Have bleeding on the brain (cerebral hemorrhage) or stroke
Have blood clotting disorder (like protein C, protein S, or antithrombin deficiency)
Have porphyria (rare genetic blood disorder)

introduction:
Introduction About SUSTEN SR 300MG TABLET

SUSTEN SR 300MG TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking SUSTEN SR 300MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take SUSTEN SR 300MG TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with SUSTEN SR 300MG TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

SUSTEN SR 300MG TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. SUSTEN SR 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking SUSTEN SR 300MG TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How SUSTEN SR 300MG TABLET Works

SUSTEN SR 300MG TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Estrabet 2mg Tablet 28'S
introduction:
Introduction About ESTRABET 2MG TABLET

ESTRABET 2MG TABLET contains Estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Estrogens. ESTRABET 2MG TABLET is used in postmenopausal women (with at least 6 months since their last natural period) to provide relief from symptoms that occurs after menopause. It is also used to manage osteoporosis (condition marked by weak and fragile bones) which occurs after menopause in few women.

ESTRABET 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Estradiol. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have/had/suspected of breast/endometrial cancer or thrombosis (blood clot in vein). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who suffer from unusual vaginal bleeding, unmanageed endometrial hyperplasia (excessive thickening of the womb lining), lung disease (such as pulmonary embolism), heart disease (such as heart attack/heart block), and/or liver disease (such as benign liver tumour).

Before taking ESTRABET 2MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have fibroids (non-cancerous growths inside womb), endometriosis (growth of womb lining outside womb)/endometrial hyperplasia (excessive growth of the womb lining), and/or suffer from epilepsy, otosclerosis (disease that affects eardrum and hearing), kidney problems, and/or lung problems (such as asthma).

ESTRABET 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women since it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women. The medicine is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents since it is indicated for use only in postmenopausal women. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly women (aged 60 years and above) after consulting the doctor since the medicine may increase the risk of heart disease in elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking ESTRABET 2MG TABLET are headache, nausea, cramps in legs, abdominal/pelvic pain, unscheduled bleeding/spotting, asthenia (feeling of weakness), and/or rash/itching. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

Have/suspected of endometrium cancer

Have/had thrombosis (blood clot in a vein) such as deep venous thrombosis
Have blood clotting disorder such as protein C/protein S/antithrombin deficiency
Have/recently had blood clots in arteries such as stroke
Suffer from inherited porphyria (rare blood disorder)

Have fibroids (non-cancerous growths) inside womb

introduction:
Introduction About PROLUTON 500MG INJECTION(DEPOT)

PROLUTON 500MG INJECTION(DEPOT) contains Hydroxyprogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Progestin hormones. It is used to lower the risk of preterm births among women who have a previous history of pre-term delivery.

Preterm delivery is a condition in which the baby is born too early that is before the completion of 37 weeks due to maternal complications.

PROLUTON 500MG INJECTION(DEPOT) is not recommended for use in patients with liver tumours, any active liver disease, blood clots in the body, known or suspected breast cancer/other hormone-sensitive cancers and uncontrolled high blood pressure.

PROLUTON INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with asthma, kidney or heart problems, diabetes or pre-diabetes, epilepsy and migraine. It is not recommended for use in pregnant women with cholestatic jaundice.

PROLUTON INJECTION is not recommended for use in girls (aged below 16 years). The common side effects associated with the use of PROLUTON INJECTION are pain, swelling, itching or a hard bump at the injection site, raised red rashes, itching, nausea and diarrhoea. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens or prolong.

mechanismOfAction:
How PROLUTON 500MG INJECTION(DEPOT) Works

PROLUTON INJECTION contains a medicine called hydroxyprogesterone which is a synthetic form of naturally occurring female hormone called progesterone. It works by regulating the female reproductive system and by assisting successful implantation of embryo within the uterus. It also induces anti-inflammatory response that can initiate pre-term labour.

Your doctor will decide the correct Proluton dosage and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
