name: DYDROGEST 10 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About DYDROGEST 10 TABLET

DYDROGEST 10 TABLET contains Dydrogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Replacement Therapy. It is used to manage progesterone-deficiency states. It helps to manage problems that occur due to a deficiency of a female sex hormone called progesterone in the body. It helps to relieve period cramps and manage symptoms of endometriosis and premenstrual syndrome in women with progesterone deficiency. It can also be used to manage female reproductive health and is used in postmenopausal women to manage signs of menopause when used in combination with estrogens.

Dydrogesterone is a synthetic derivative of a female sex hormone called progesterone. It supplements the bodies with sufficient levels of progesterone. As a result, it relieves the unpleasant symptoms associated with progesterone deficiencies, such as menstrual pain, premenstrual syndrome, infertility, irregular periods, or signs of menopause. During management with DYDROGEST 10 TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Do not take DYDROGEST 10 TABLET if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma). Before taking DYDROGEST 10 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems, depression, or porphyria. Consult your doctor before taking DYDROGEST 10 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. DYDROGEST 10 TABLET should be used with caution in adolescent girls who have attained puberty (aged between 12-18 years).

Inform your doctor if you experience any changes in the breast, such as breast pain, tenderness, discharge from the nipple, lump growth in the breasts, heavy menstrual bleeding, pain, swelling, redness of the legs, sudden chest pain, or difficulty breathing after taking DYDROGEST 10 TABLET. The most common side effects of taking DYDROGEST 10 TABLET are severe headaches, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
uses: Manage the symptoms of endometriosis and premenstrual syndrome

mechanismOfAction:
How DYDROGEST 10 TABLET Works

DYDROGEST 10 TABLET helps in managing problems associated with progesterone deficiency states. It improves the thickness of the uterine lining, which helps in correcting infertility problems and irregular periods. It also provides relief from postmenopausal symptoms (such as hot flushes, sleep problems, irritability, and depression) by replacing the deficient progesterone levels in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use DYDROGEST 10 TABLET

Take DYDROGEST 10 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow DYDROGEST 10 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take DYDROGEST 10 TABLET at the same time each day. It can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of DYDROGEST 10 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DYDROEASE TABLET

DYDROEASE TABLET contains Dydrogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Replacement Therapy. It is used to manage progesterone-deficiency states. It helps to manage problems that occur due to a deficiency of a female sex hormone called progesterone in the body. It helps to relieve period cramps and manage symptoms of endometriosis and premenstrual syndrome in women with progesterone deficiency. It can also be used to manage female reproductive health and is used in postmenopausal women to manage signs of menopause when used in combination with estrogens.

Dydrogesterone is a synthetic derivative of a female sex hormone called progesterone. It supplements the bodies with sufficient levels of progesterone. As a result, it relieves the unpleasant symptoms associated with progesterone deficiencies, such as menstrual pain, premenstrual syndrome, infertility, irregular periods, or signs of menopause. During management with DYDROEASE TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Do not take DYDROEASE TABLET if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma). Before taking DYDROEASE TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems, depression, or porphyria. Consult your doctor before taking DYDROEASE TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. DYDROEASE TABLET should be used with caution in adolescent girls who have attained puberty (aged between 12-18 years).

Inform your doctor if you experience any changes in the breast, such as breast pain, tenderness, discharge from the nipple, lump growth in the breasts, heavy menstrual bleeding, pain, swelling, redness of the legs, sudden chest pain, or difficulty breathing after taking DYDROEASE TABLET. The most common side effects of taking DYDROEASE TABLET are severe headaches, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

How DYDROEASE TABLET Works

DYDROEASE TABLET helps in managing problems associated with progesterone deficiency states. It improves the thickness of the uterine lining, which helps in correcting infertility problems and irregular periods. It also provides relief from postmenopausal symptoms (such as hot flushes, sleep problems, irritability, and depression) by replacing the deficient progesterone levels in the body.
usageDetails:

Take DYDROEASE TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow DYDROEASE TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take DYDROEASE TABLET at the same time each day. It can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of DYDROEASE TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CHOP 300 SR TABLET

CHOP 300 SR TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking CHOP 300 SR TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take CHOP 300 SR TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with CHOP 300 SR TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

CHOP 300 SR TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. CHOP 300 SR TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking CHOP 300 SR TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How CHOP 300 SR TABLET Works

CHOP 300 SR TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.

introduction:
Introduction About SYSRON N CR 10MG TABLET

SYSRON N CR 10MG TABLET contains Norethisterone, which belongs to a group of medicines called Progestogens. It is used to manage heavy menstrual bleeding or abnormal uterine bleeding (that occurs due to hormonal imbalance), painful periods, irregular periods or periods that are more frequent than normal (polymenorrhoea), premenstrual tension, endometriosis (abnormal growth of endometrial tissue of the uterus that causes pain and menstrual irregularities), metriopatheias haemorrhagia (intermenstrual bleeding) and breast cancer. It is also used to delay the menstrual cycle.

SYSRON N CR 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pulmonary embolism (blood clots in the lung), liver disease, heart attack (myocardial infarction) or angina and deep vein thrombosis. SYSRON N CR 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma, kidney disease, fits, and migraine headaches.

SYSRON N CR 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy as it may affect the developing baby. Inform your doctor if you have had repeated miscarriages. SYSRON N CR 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. If you experience mood changes and depressive symptoms, contact your doctor as soon as possible.

The most common side effects of taking SYSRON N CR 10MG TABLET are irregular bleeding, heavy menstruation, spotting between menstrual cycles, delayed or not having a menstrual cycle, stomach discomfort, nausea, vomiting, breast tenderness, headache, and dizziness. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen.

How SYSRON N CR 10MG TABLET Works

SYSRON N CR 10MG TABLET inhibits the release of pituitary hormones that are responsible for the release of female hormones (such as oestrogen and progesterone) and thereby suppressing ovulation. This action modifies the lining of the endometrium and thus ceases bleeding in menstrual abnormalities in cancer SYSRON N CR 10MG TABLET may act by pituitary inhibition or by direct action on tumour deposits.

introduction:
Introduction About DROGYNA 10MG TABLET

DROGYNA 10MG TABLET contains Dydrogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Replacement Therapy. It is used to manage progesterone-deficiency states. It helps to manage problems that occur due to a deficiency of a female sex hormone called progesterone in the body. It helps to relieve period cramps and manage symptoms of endometriosis and premenstrual syndrome in women with progesterone deficiency. It can also be used to manage female reproductive health and is used in postmenopausal women to manage signs of menopause when used in combination with estrogens.

Dydrogesterone is a synthetic derivative of a female sex hormone called progesterone. It supplements the bodies with sufficient levels of progesterone. As a result, it relieves the unpleasant symptoms associated with progesterone deficiencies, such as menstrual pain, premenstrual syndrome, infertility, irregular periods, or signs of menopause. During management with DROGYNA 10MG TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Do not take DROGYNA 10MG TABLET if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma). Before taking DROGYNA 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems, depression, or porphyria. Consult your doctor before taking DROGYNA 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. DROGYNA 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in adolescent girls who have attained puberty (aged between 12-18 years).

Inform your doctor if you experience any changes in the breast, such as breast pain, tenderness, discharge from the nipple, lump growth in the breasts, heavy menstrual bleeding, pain, swelling, redness of the legs, sudden chest pain, or difficulty breathing after taking DROGYNA 10MG TABLET. The most common side effects of taking DROGYNA 10MG TABLET are severe headaches, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

How DROGYNA 10MG TABLET Works

DROGYNA 10MG TABLET helps in managing problems associated with progesterone deficiency states. It improves the thickness of the uterine lining, which helps in correcting infertility problems and irregular periods. It also provides relief from postmenopausal symptoms (such as hot flushes, sleep problems, irritability, and depression) by replacing the deficient progesterone levels in the body.

Take DROGYNA 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow DROGYNA 10MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take DROGYNA 10MG TABLET at the same time each day. It can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of DROGYNA 10MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About AQSUSTEN 50MG INJECTION

AQSUSTEN 50MG INJECTION is used for the maintenance of early pregnancy in patients who faced documented history of repeated miscarriages due to luteal phase defect (a problem in menstrual cycle caused due to deficiency of progesterone during the midway of the menstrual cycle).

It can also be used as an adjuvant to infertility techniques (such as in vitro fertilization (IVF) or gamete intra-fallopian transfer (GIFT)) to facilitate successful implantation of the fertilized egg in the uterus. It is also used to manage threatened abortions and to manage abnormal uterine bleeding caused due to hormonal imbalance.

It can be used as a diagnostic tool in progesterone withdrawal testing to diagnose the endocrinal causes of secondary amenorrhea (irregular or lack of menstrual periods) and to judge the chances of pregnancy among infertile women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before receiving AQSUSTEN 50MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, epilepsy, or migraine headaches before receiving AQSUSTEN 50MG INJECTION as a precaution.

AQSUSTEN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, ovarian cancer, uterine cancer, blood clot problems or any vaginal infections. AQSUSTEN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

AQSUSTEN 50MG INJECTION can be used during the first three months of pregnancy. However, it should not be used in women who have ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside the womb) and in women who had a history of idiopathic jaundice (severe itching of the skin) or other skin problems during their earlier pregnancies.

The most common side effects of receiving AQSUSTEN 50MG INJECTION are pain, redness, itching, irritation or swelling at the injection site, vaginal bleeding, headache, bloating, nausea, hair loss, abnormal hair growth in the body, darkening of the facial skin or difficulty in sleeping. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. Talk to your doctor immediately if you experience any changes in body weight or feel depressed while receiving AQSUSTEN 50MG INJECTION.

introduction:
Introduction About DYDROJOY 10 TABLET

DYDROJOY 10 TABLET contains Dydrogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Replacement Therapy. It is used to manage progesterone-deficiency states. It helps to manage problems that occur due to a deficiency of a female sex hormone called progesterone in the body. It helps to relieve period cramps and manage symptoms of endometriosis and premenstrual syndrome in women with progesterone deficiency. It can also be used to manage female reproductive health and is used in postmenopausal women to manage signs of menopause when used in combination with estrogens.

Dydrogesterone is a synthetic derivative of a female sex hormone called progesterone. It supplements the bodies with sufficient levels of progesterone. As a result, it relieves the unpleasant symptoms associated with progesterone deficiencies, such as menstrual pain, premenstrual syndrome, infertility, irregular periods, or signs of menopause. During management with DYDROJOY 10 TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Do not take DYDROJOY 10 TABLET if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma). Before taking DYDROJOY 10 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems, depression, or porphyria. Consult your doctor before taking DYDROJOY 10 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. DYDROJOY 10 TABLET should be used with caution in adolescent girls who have attained puberty (aged between 12-18 years).

Inform your doctor if you experience any changes in the breast, such as breast pain, tenderness, discharge from the nipple, lump growth in the breasts, heavy menstrual bleeding, pain, swelling, redness of the legs, sudden chest pain, or difficulty breathing after taking DYDROJOY 10 TABLET. The most common side effects of taking DYDROJOY 10 TABLET are severe headaches, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

DYDROJOY 10 TABLET helps in managing problems associated with progesterone deficiency states. It improves the thickness of the uterine lining, which helps in correcting infertility problems and irregular periods. It also provides relief from postmenopausal symptoms (such as hot flushes, sleep problems, irritability, and depression) by replacing the deficient progesterone levels in the body.

introduction:
Introduction About ENRIFOL H TABLET

ENRIFOL H TABLET is used in postmenopausal women (with at least 6 months since their last natural period) to manage symptoms that occur after menopause, like hot face, neck, and chest (hot flushes) and osteoporosis (weak bones). It contains Estradiol hemihydrate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Estrogens that helps maintain an adequate level of circulating hormones, thus providing relief from hot flushes and weak bones.

Before you start using ENRIFOL H TABLET, your doctor will ask about your own and your family’s medical history. Your doctor may decide to perform a physical examination (examination of your breasts and/or an internal examination) if necessary.

ENRIFOL H TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Estradiol or if you have or have had liver disease and the liver function tests have not returned to normal or have lung disease such as pulmonary embolism (blood clots in the lungs), heart disease such as a heart attack, or angina. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have or have suspected breast or endometrial tumour or thrombosis (blood clots in the vein), unusual vaginal bleeding, or unmanageed endometrial hyperplasia (excessive thickening of the womb lining).

Before taking ENRIFOL H TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver disease (such as a benign liver tumour), lung problems such as asthma, or have high blood pressure, fibroids (non-cancerous growths inside the womb), endometriosis (growth of the womb lining outside the womb) or endometrial hyperplasia (excessive growth of the womb lining), and/or suffer from epilepsy, otosclerosis (disease that affects the eardrum and hearing), and kidney problems.

ENRIFOL H TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women since it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women. The medicine is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents since it is indicated for use only in postmenopausal women.

The common side effects of taking ENRIFOL H TABLET are headache, nausea, cramps in the legs, abdominal or pelvic pain, unscheduled bleeding or spotting, wind, asthenia (a feeling of weakness), changes in weight, and/or rash or itching. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

It also inhibits bone resorption and helps manage osteoporosis.

Introduction About DYDROEVA TABLET
What is DYDROEVA TABLET?

DYDROEVA TABLET contains Dydrogesterone, a well-studied synthetic progesterone. It is often prescribed as part of a hormone support plan for individuals managing menstrual cycle irregularities or undergoing reproductive care. This tablet mimics the action of natural progesterone, contributing to a more stable hormonal profile.

Use DYDROEVA TABLET exactly as directed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken orally with or without food. Dosage and duration depend on your specific health goals and medical history.

During management with DYDROEVA TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

DYDROEVA TABLET helps support hormonal balance by mimicking the natural actions of progesterone during the second half (luteal phase) of the menstrual cycle. This can assist in regulating the uterine lining and promoting cycle regularity. Women who experience inconsistent cycles, mid-cycle spotting, or other cycle-related issues due to hormonal imbalances may benefit from its regulated use as advised by their healthcare provider.

Before starting DYDROEVA TABLET, it is important to consult a healthcare professional to evaluate the underlying cause of hormonal changes. Usage in pregnancy, breastfeeding, or with other hormonal therapies should always be discussed in advance. Do not take DYDROEVA TABLET, if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma).

The most common side effects of taking DYDROEVA TABLET are severe headache, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DYDROEVA TABLET Works
Understanding the Role of Dydrogesterone

DYDROEVA TABLETcontains Dydrogesterone, a synthetic form of the natural hormone progesterone. It mimics the hormonal activity needed for cycle regulation and supports the environment needed for hormone-responsive conditions. Unlike some other compounds, Dydrogesterone does not have androgenic or estrogenic effects, making it more selective in its action. This tablet is often used in hormone support strategies where balanced progesterone activity is essential.

Is DYDROEVA TABLET a natural or synthetic hormone?
DYDROEVA TABLET contains dydrogesterone, which is a synthetic hormone. It is a synthetic form of the naturally occurring hormone progesterone
How DYDROEVA TABLET may help with menstrual irregularities?

During a normal menstrual cycle, progesterone levels rise in the second half (luteal phase) to prepare the uterus for possible pregnancy. If pregnancy does not occur, progesterone levels drop, triggering menstruation. When the body does not produce enough progesterone, it can lead to irregular or missed periods, spotting, or cycle-related discomfort.

DYDROEVA TABLET compensates for this hormonal gap by providing dydrogesterone, which:

Helps maintain the natural rhythm of the menstrual cycle
Supports the uterine lining (endometrium) during the luteal phase
Encourages a predictable withdrawal bleed, simulating a natural period when the tablet is stopped
DYDROEVA TABLET uses in Pregnancy: 

It is often prescribed during pregnancy to help maintain a healthy pregnancy, particularly in cases where there is a risk of miscarriage or preterm labor due to progesterone deficiency. It supports the uterine lining, making it more favorable for embryo implantation and helps sustain early pregnancy. DYDROEVA TABLET may also be used in women who have a history of recurrent miscarriages or those undergoing fertility management.

DYDROEVA TABLET Uses in Menstrual Disorders:

DYDROEVA TABLET helps balance hormones, reducing the intense uterine contractions that cause pain during menstruation. By reducing the growth of the endometrial tissue that grows outside the uterus, it relieves pain and discomfort associated with endometriosis. DYDROEVA TABLET helps stabilize hormone levels, reducing mood swings, bloating, and other symptoms of PMS.

introduction:
Introduction About MICHELLE AQ 50 INJECTION

MICHELLE AQ 50 INJECTION is used for the maintenance of early pregnancy in patients who faced documented history of repeated miscarriages due to luteal phase defect (a problem in menstrual cycle caused due to deficiency of progesterone during the midway of the menstrual cycle).

It can also be used as an adjuvant to infertility techniques (such as in vitro fertilization (IVF) or gamete intra-fallopian transfer (GIFT)) to facilitate successful implantation of the fertilized egg in the uterus. It is also used to manage threatened abortions and to manage abnormal uterine bleeding caused due to hormonal imbalance.

It can be used as a diagnostic tool in progesterone withdrawal testing to diagnose the endocrinal causes of secondary amenorrhea (irregular or lack of menstrual periods) and to judge the chances of pregnancy among infertile women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before receiving MICHELLE AQ 50 INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, epilepsy, or migraine headaches before receiving MICHELLE AQ 50 INJECTION as a precaution.

MICHELLE AQ 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, ovarian cancer, uterine cancer, blood clot problems or any vaginal infections. MICHELLE AQ 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

MICHELLE AQ 50 INJECTION can be used during the first three months of pregnancy. However, it should not be used in women who have ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside the womb) and in women who had a history of idiopathic jaundice (severe itching of the skin) or other skin problems during their earlier pregnancies.

The most common side effects of receiving MICHELLE AQ 50 INJECTION are pain, redness, itching, irritation or swelling at the injection site, vaginal bleeding, headache, bloating, nausea, hair loss, abnormal hair growth in the body, darkening of the facial skin or difficulty in sleeping. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. Talk to your doctor immediately if you experience any changes in body weight or feel depressed while receiving MICHELLE AQ 50 INJECTION.

How MACGEST SR 200MG TABLET Works

MACGEST SR 200MG TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

HALD SR 200MG TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. HALD SR 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking HALD SR 200MG TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

How HALD SR 200MG TABLET Works

HALD SR 200MG TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.

introduction:
Introduction About DROLUTE TABLET

DROLUTE TABLET contains Dydrogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Replacement Therapy. It is used to manage progesterone-deficiency states. It helps to manage problems that occur due to a deficiency of a female sex hormone called progesterone in the body. It helps to relieve period cramps and manage symptoms of endometriosis and premenstrual syndrome in women with progesterone deficiency. It can also be used to manage female reproductive health and is used in postmenopausal women to manage signs of menopause when used in combination with estrogens.

Dydrogesterone is a synthetic derivative of a female sex hormone called progesterone. It supplements the bodies with sufficient levels of progesterone. As a result, it relieves the unpleasant symptoms associated with progesterone deficiencies, such as menstrual pain, premenstrual syndrome, infertility, irregular periods, or signs of menopause. During management with DROLUTE TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Do not take DROLUTE TABLET if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma). Before taking DROLUTE TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems, depression, or porphyria. Consult your doctor before taking DROLUTE TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. DROLUTE TABLET should be used with caution in adolescent girls who have attained puberty (aged between 12-18 years).

Inform your doctor if you experience any changes in the breast, such as breast pain, tenderness, discharge from the nipple, lump growth in the breasts, heavy menstrual bleeding, pain, swelling, redness of the legs, sudden chest pain, or difficulty breathing after taking DROLUTE TABLET. The most common side effects of taking DROLUTE TABLET are severe headaches, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About AQUAVIRON 40 CAPSULE

AQUAVIRON 40 CAPSULE contains Testosterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Androgens. It is used in adult men to replace testosterone in male hypogonadism (various health problems caused by a deficiency of testosterone). It can also be used in men to manage osteoporosis (a type of bone disease) caused due to very little testosterone.

Male hypogonadism is characterized by symptoms like impotence, infertility, decreased sex drive, tiredness, depressive moods and bone loss due to low hormone levels.

AQUAVIRON 40 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with known or suspected prostate or breast cancer or who have high amounts of calcium in blood or urine, kidney disease, heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking it.

AQUAVIRON 40 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with lung cancer, chronic lung disease, liver disease, kidney cancer, high blood pressure, history of heart attack or stroke, blood clotting problems. AQUAVIRON 40 CAPSULE is not indicated for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

AQUAVIRON 40 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years and it should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years. The most common side effects of taking AQUAVIRON 40 CAPSULE is weight gain. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking AQUAVIRON 40 CAPSULE unless your doctor advises you to stop. Otherwise, your symptoms may reoccur within few weeks.

introduction:
Introduction About NIDAGEN SR 200MG TABLET

NIDAGEN SR 200MG TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking NIDAGEN SR 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take NIDAGEN SR 200MG TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with NIDAGEN SR 200MG TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

NIDAGEN SR 200MG TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. NIDAGEN SR 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking NIDAGEN SR 200MG TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How NIDAGEN SR 200MG TABLET Works

NIDAGEN SR 200MG TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Have porphyria (rare genetic blood disorder)

Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an immune system disease that affects many organs of the body)

introduction:
Introduction About NATUROGEST GEL

NATUROGEST GEL is a vaginal gel used in females to manage female infertility due to incorrect levels of progesterone during the menstrual cycle or when you are having an assisted fertility procedure.

It contains a medicine called Progesterone which is a synthetic female hormone. When the gel is inserted into your vagina, the progesterone will slowly release into your bloodstream throughout the day which mimics the actions of natural progesterone produced in your body.

NATUROGEST GEL is for vaginal use only. Gently insert the gel using the applicator into the vagina. Wash your hands before and after application. Before using this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems, asthma, diabetes, epilepsy, unexplained vaginal bleeding, migraine or history of depression as a precaution.

NATUROGEST GEL is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. It is normally not suggested during pregnancy, unless you have used this medicine to help become pregnancy. The most common side effects of using NATUROGEST GEL are breast tenderness, stomach cramps, pelvic pain, pain around genital area, vaginal discharge or itching, low sex drive, and sleepiness. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

Talk to your doctor if you experience breast enlargement and pain after using this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About C HOP 200 SR TABLET

C HOP 200 SR TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking C HOP 200 SR TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take C HOP 200 SR TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with C HOP 200 SR TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

C HOP 200 SR TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. C HOP 200 SR TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking C HOP 200 SR TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

Female infertility

mechanismOfAction:
How C HOP 200 SR TABLET Works

C HOP 200 SR TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

C HOP 200 SR TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have known or suspected cancer of the breast or womb lining (endometrium)
Have unusual vaginal bleeding
Had or have blood clots in the legs (deep venous thrombosis) or in the veins (thrombosis)
Have bleeding on the brain (cerebral hemorrhage) or stroke
Have blood clotting disorder (like protein C, protein S, or antithrombin deficiency)
Have porphyria (rare genetic blood disorder)

Before taking C HOP 200 SR TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have problems in your uterus (such as fibroid growths or endometriosis (womb lining growth outside your womb)
Have a history of excessive womb lining growth (endometrial hyperplasia)
Have increased risk of blood clot formation (when you are unable to walk for long time after major surgery, injury or illness, obese and older age)
Have a family history of having breast cancer
Have diabetes
Have gallstones
Have migraine or severe headaches
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an immune system disease that affects many organs of the body)
Have epilepsy (fits)
Have otosclerosis (disease affecting the eardrum and hearing)
Have ever had depression
Have skin sensitivity towards light

faqs.answer: A. C HOP 200 SR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who had or have blood clot in the lungs (pulmonary embolism) and it should be used with caution in patients with asthma. Consult your doctor before taking C HOP 200 SR TABLET

faqs.question: Q. What are the common side effects of C HOP 200 SR TABLET?

faqs.question: Q. Why is C HOP 200 SR TABLET necessary for pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A. C HOP 200 SR TABLET supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy. It sustains pregnancy among infertile women and in women who face repeated/threatened abortions by increasing the thickness of uterine wall.

faqs.question: Q. When is progesterone produced in the reproductive cycle?
faqs.answer: A. The typical menstrual cycle takes approximately 28 to 32 days and is divided into three distinct phases namely the follicular phase, the ovulatory phase, and the luteal phase. The luteal phase is the period when the body produces progesterone, the hormone that makes the uterus prepare its lining to receive the egg.

faqs.question: Q. What precautions need to be followed while taking C HOP 200 SR TABLET?
faqs.answer: A. Before taking C HOP 200 SR TABLET inform your doctor if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, heart problems, blood clots, diabetes, or asthma. Take C HOP 200 SR TABLET regularly as instructed by the physician without fail. Do not miss a dose of C HOP 200 SR TABLET to achieve maximum benefits.

faqs.question: Q: What are C HOP 200 SR TABLET used for?
faqs.answer: A: C HOP 200 SR TABLET is commonly used in the management of menstrual disorders, support early pregnancy, manage hormone replacement therapy (HRT), and address symptoms of menopause or infertility.

faqs.question: Q: How C HOP 200 SR TABLET works?
faqs.answer: A: C HOP 200 SR TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy. It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.

faqs.question: Q: Can progesterone tablets cause weight gain?
faqs.answer: A: Progesterone may cause water retention and bloating, which can lead to temporary weight gain in some individuals.

faqs.question: Q: Can you take progesterone tablets during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, in certain cases, progesterone tablets are prescribed during early pregnancy to support the uterine lining and reduce the risk of miscarriage.

faqs.question: Q: Can progesterone tablets affect mood?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, mood swings or depression can occur as a side effect of progesterone, particularly when hormone levels fluctuate.

faqs.question: Q: How long does it take for progesterone tablets to work?
faqs.answer: A: The effect of progesterone tablets can vary depending on the condition being treated, but some users notice changes within a few days to weeks.

faqs.question: Q: Are there any interactions between progesterone tablets and other medications?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, progesterone can interact with certain medications like antifungals, anticonvulsants, and blood thinners. Always inform your doctor about any medications you're taking.

name: GESTOFERT SR 200 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About GESTOFERT SR 200 TABLET

GESTOFERT SR 200 TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking GESTOFERT SR 200 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take GESTOFERT SR 200 TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with GESTOFERT SR 200 TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

GESTOFERT SR 200 TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. GESTOFERT SR 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking GESTOFERT SR 200 TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How GESTOFERT SR 200 TABLET Works

GESTOFERT SR 200 TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About GESTOFIT SR 200MG TABLET

GESTOFIT SR 200MG TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking GESTOFIT SR 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take GESTOFIT SR 200MG TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with GESTOFIT SR 200MG TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

GESTOFIT SR 200MG TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. GESTOFIT SR 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking GESTOFIT SR 200MG TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of GESTOFIT SR 200MG TABLET

It is used in the management of the following progesterone deficiency conditions such as:

Female infertility
Abnormal uterine bleeding
Menopausal disorders

Threatened abortions and pre-term delivery
mechanismOfAction:
How GESTOFIT SR 200MG TABLET Works

GESTOFIT SR 200MG TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SIBOLONE 2.5MG TABLET

SIBOLONE 2.5MG TABLET contains Tibolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Steroids. SIBOLONE 2.5MG TABLET is used in postmenopausal women to provide relief from symptoms that occur after menopause.

SIBOLONE 2.5MG TABLET is also used in post-menopausal women to manage osteoporosis which occurs after menopause, generally characterized by symptoms such as weak and fragile bones.

SIBOLONE 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Tibolone. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have/had/suspected of breast/endometrial cancer or thrombosis (blood clot in vein). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who suffer from unusual vaginal bleeding, unmanageed endometrial hyperplasia (excessive thickening of the womb lining), lung disease (such as pulmonary embolism), heart disease (such as heart attack/heart block), and/or liver disease (such as benign liver tumor).

Before taking SIBOLONE 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have fibroids (non-cancerous growths inside womb), endometriosis (growth of womb lining outside womb)/endometrial hyperplasia (excessive growth of the womb lining), and/or suffer from epilepsy, otosclerosis (disease that affects eardrum and hearing), and/or lung problems (such as asthma).

SIBOLONE 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women since it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women. The medicine is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents since it is indicated for use only in postmenopausal women. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly women (aged 60 years and above) after consulting the doctor since the medicine may increase the risk of heart disease in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking SIBOLONE 2.5MG TABLET are breast pain, stomach/pelvic pain, unusual hair growth, vaginal bleeding/spotting, vaginal problems (such as increased secretions, itching, and/or irritation), thickening of uterus/cervix lining, and/or weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

SIBOLONE 2.5MG TABLET works by substituting loss of estrogen (female sex hormone responsible for ovulation) production in postmenopausal women which helps in managing the occurrence of menopausal symptoms (such as hot flashes, night sweats, and/or vaginal problems) and bone loss (followed by menopause) thus providing relief from menopausal symptoms in affected women.

Have/had thrombosis (blood clot in a vein) such as deep venous thrombosis

Introduction About PREGCERT 400MG CAPSULE

PREGCERT 400MG CAPSULE is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking PREGCERT 400MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take PREGCERT 400MG CAPSULE if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with PREGCERT 400MG CAPSULE, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

PREGCERT 400MG CAPSULE may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. PREGCERT 400MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking PREGCERT 400MG CAPSULE are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How PREGCERT 400MG CAPSULE Works

PREGCERT 400MG CAPSULE is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET
What is DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET?

DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET contains Dydrogesterone, a well-studied synthetic progesterone. It is often prescribed as part of a hormone support plan for individuals managing menstrual cycle irregularities or undergoing reproductive care. This tablet mimics the action of natural progesterone, contributing to a more stable hormonal profile.

Use DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET exactly as directed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken orally with or without food. Dosage and duration depend on your specific health goals and medical history.

During management with DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET helps support hormonal balance by mimicking the natural actions of progesterone during the second half (luteal phase) of the menstrual cycle. This can assist in regulating the uterine lining and promoting cycle regularity. Women who experience inconsistent cycles, mid-cycle spotting, or other cycle-related issues due to hormonal imbalances may benefit from its regulated use as advised by their healthcare provider.

Before starting DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET, it is important to consult a healthcare professional to evaluate the underlying cause of hormonal changes. Usage in pregnancy, breastfeeding, or with other hormonal therapies should always be discussed in advance. Do not take DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET, if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma).

The most common side effects of taking DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET are severe headache, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET Works
Understanding the Role of Dydrogesterone

DROGYNA 20 SR TABLETcontains Dydrogesterone, a synthetic form of the natural hormone progesterone. It mimics the hormonal activity needed for cycle regulation and supports the environment needed for hormone-responsive conditions. Unlike some other compounds, Dydrogesterone does not have androgenic or estrogenic effects, making it more selective in its action. This tablet is often used in hormone support strategies where balanced progesterone activity is essential.

Is DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET a natural or synthetic hormone?
DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET contains dydrogesterone, which is a synthetic hormone. It is a synthetic form of the naturally occurring hormone progesterone
How DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET may help with menstrual irregularities?

During a normal menstrual cycle, progesterone levels rise in the second half (luteal phase) to prepare the uterus for possible pregnancy. If pregnancy does not occur, progesterone levels drop, triggering menstruation. When the body does not produce enough progesterone, it can lead to irregular or missed periods, spotting, or cycle-related discomfort.

DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET compensates for this hormonal gap by providing dydrogesterone, which:

Helps maintain the natural rhythm of the menstrual cycle
Supports the uterine lining (endometrium) during the luteal phase
Encourages a predictable withdrawal bleed, simulating a natural period when the tablet is stopped
DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET uses in Pregnancy: 

It is often prescribed during pregnancy to help maintain a healthy pregnancy, particularly in cases where there is a risk of miscarriage or preterm labor due to progesterone deficiency. It supports the uterine lining, making it more favorable for embryo implantation and helps sustain early pregnancy. DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET may also be used in women who have a history of recurrent miscarriages or those undergoing fertility management.

DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET Uses in Menstrual Disorders:

DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET helps balance hormones, reducing the intense uterine contractions that cause pain during menstruation. By reducing the growth of the endometrial tissue that grows outside the uterus, it relieves pain and discomfort associated with endometriosis. DROGYNA 20 SR TABLET helps stabilize hormone levels, reducing mood swings, bloating, and other symptoms of PMS.

introduction:
Introduction About PROGYNOVA 1MG TABLET

PROGYNOVA 1MG TABLET contains Estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Estrogens. PROGYNOVA 1MG TABLET is used in postmenopausal women (with at least 6 months since their last natural period) to provide relief from symptoms that occurs after menopause. It is also used to manage osteoporosis (condition marked by weak and fragile bones) which occurs after menopause in few women.

PROGYNOVA 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Estradiol. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have/had/suspected of breast/endometrial cancer or thrombosis (blood clot in vein). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who suffer from unusual vaginal bleeding, unmanageed endometrial hyperplasia (excessive thickening of the womb lining), lung disease (such as pulmonary embolism), heart disease (such as heart attack/heart block), and/or liver disease (such as benign liver tumour).

Before taking PROGYNOVA 1MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have fibroids (non-cancerous growths inside womb), endometriosis (growth of womb lining outside womb)/endometrial hyperplasia (excessive growth of the womb lining), and/or suffer from epilepsy, otosclerosis (disease that affects eardrum and hearing), kidney problems, and/or lung problems (such as asthma).

PROGYNOVA 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women since it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women. The medicine is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents since it is indicated for use only in postmenopausal women. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly women (aged 60 years and above) after consulting the doctor since the medicine may increase the risk of heart disease in elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking PROGYNOVA 1MG TABLET are headache, nausea, cramps in legs, abdominal/pelvic pain, unscheduled bleeding/spotting, asthenia (feeling of weakness), and/or rash/itching. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About HALD 100MG INJECTION

HALD 100MG INJECTION is used for the maintenance of early pregnancy in patients who faced documented history of repeated miscarriages due to luteal phase defect (a problem in menstrual cycle caused due to deficiency of progesterone during the midway of the menstrual cycle).

It can also be used as an adjuvant to infertility techniques (such as in vitro fertilization (IVF) or gamete intra-fallopian transfer (GIFT)) to facilitate successful implantation of the fertilized egg in the uterus. It is also used to manage threatened abortions and to manage abnormal uterine bleeding caused due to hormonal imbalance.

It can be used as a diagnostic tool in progesterone withdrawal testing to diagnose the endocrinal causes of secondary amenorrhea (irregular or lack of menstrual periods) and to judge the chances of pregnancy among infertile women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before receiving HALD 100MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, epilepsy, or migraine headaches before receiving HALD 100MG INJECTION as a precaution.

HALD 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, ovarian cancer, uterine cancer, blood clot problems or any vaginal infections. HALD 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

HALD 100MG INJECTION can be used during the first three months of pregnancy. However, it should not be used in women who have ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside the womb) and in women who had a history of idiopathic jaundice (severe itching of the skin) or other skin problems during their earlier pregnancies.

The most common side effects of receiving HALD 100MG INJECTION are pain, redness, itching, irritation or swelling at the injection site, vaginal bleeding, headache, bloating, nausea, hair loss, abnormal hair growth in the body, darkening of the facial skin or difficulty in sleeping. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. Talk to your doctor immediately if you experience any changes in body weight or feel depressed while receiving HALD 100MG INJECTION.

How HALD 100MG INJECTION Works

HALD 100MG INJECTION is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy. It sustains pregnancy among infertile women and in women who face repeated/threatened abortions by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding.

introduction:
Introduction About STRONE 100MG INJECTION

STRONE 100MG INJECTION is used for the maintenance of early pregnancy in patients who faced documented history of repeated miscarriages due to luteal phase defect (a problem in menstrual cycle caused due to deficiency of progesterone during the midway of the menstrual cycle).

It can also be used as an adjuvant to infertility techniques (such as in vitro fertilization (IVF) or gamete intra-fallopian transfer (GIFT)) to facilitate successful implantation of the fertilized egg in the uterus. It is also used to manage threatened abortions and to manage abnormal uterine bleeding caused due to hormonal imbalance.

It can be used as a diagnostic tool in progesterone withdrawal testing to diagnose the endocrinal causes of secondary amenorrhea (irregular or lack of menstrual periods) and to judge the chances of pregnancy among infertile women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before receiving STRONE 100MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, epilepsy, or migraine headaches before receiving STRONE 100MG INJECTION as a precaution.

STRONE 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, ovarian cancer, uterine cancer, blood clot problems or any vaginal infections. STRONE 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

STRONE 100MG INJECTION can be used during the first three months of pregnancy. However, it should not be used in women who have ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside the womb) and in women who had a history of idiopathic jaundice (severe itching of the skin) or other skin problems during their earlier pregnancies.

The most common side effects of receiving STRONE 100MG INJECTION are pain, redness, itching, irritation or swelling at the injection site, vaginal bleeding, headache, bloating, nausea, hair loss, abnormal hair growth in the body, darkening of the facial skin or difficulty in sleeping. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. Talk to your doctor immediately if you experience any changes in body weight or feel depressed while receiving STRONE 100MG INJECTION.

introduction:
Introduction About GESTEROL SR 200MG TABLET

GESTEROL SR 200MG TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking GESTEROL SR 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take GESTEROL SR 200MG TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with GESTEROL SR 200MG TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

GESTEROL SR 200MG TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. GESTEROL SR 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking GESTEROL SR 200MG TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About NUGEST 200MG CAPSULE

NUGEST 200MG CAPSULE is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking NUGEST 200MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take NUGEST 200MG CAPSULE if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with NUGEST 200MG CAPSULE, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

NUGEST 200MG CAPSULE may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. NUGEST 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking NUGEST 200MG CAPSULE are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About EMPROGEST 8% GEL

EMPROGEST 8% GEL is a vaginal gel used in females to manage female infertility due to incorrect levels of progesterone during the menstrual cycle or when you are having an assisted fertility procedure.

It contains a medicine called Progesterone which is a synthetic female hormone. When the gel is inserted into your vagina, the progesterone will slowly release into your bloodstream throughout the day which mimics the actions of natural progesterone produced in your body.

EMPROGEST 8% GEL is for vaginal use only. Gently insert the gel using the applicator into the vagina. Wash your hands before and after application. Before using this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems, asthma, diabetes, epilepsy, unexplained vaginal bleeding, migraine or history of depression as a precaution.

EMPROGEST 8% GEL is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. It is normally not suggested during pregnancy, unless you have used this medicine to help become pregnancy. The most common side effects of using EMPROGEST 8% GEL are breast tenderness, stomach cramps, pelvic pain, pain around genital area, vaginal discharge or itching, low sex drive, and sleepiness. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

Talk to your doctor if you experience breast enlargement and pain after using this medicine.
usesDetails:
Uses Of EMPROGEST 8% GEL
Female Infertility
mechanismOfAction:
How EMPROGEST 8% GEL Works

EMPROGEST 8% GEL contains progesterone which is a synthetic form of naturally occurring female sex hormone. Upon application into the vagina, it slowly releases the medicine and mimic as a natural progesterone which is required in maintaining optimum uterine thickness for egg implantation and maintenance of pregnancy in the early stages.
usageInstructions: Use EMPROGEST 8% GEL under medical supervision
Wash your hands thoroughly with soap and water.
EMPROGEST 8% GEL usually comes with a pre-filled applicator. Take the required amount of the medicine into the gel applicator
Lie on your back with your knees bent or stand with one foot elevated, whichever is more comfortable for you.
Gently insert the gel using the applicator into your vagina, pushing it as far as comfortable.
Slowly press the plunger to release the gel into the vagina.
Remove the applicator and discard it if it’s disposable or wash it with soap and water if it’s reusable.
Wash your hands again after the application.
Follow your doctor’s instructions regarding the timing and frequency of use.

name: CYCLOREG CR 10mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About CYCLOREG CR 10MG TABLET

CYCLOREG CR 10MG TABLET contains Norethisterone, which belongs to a group of medicines called Progestogens. It is used to manage heavy menstrual bleeding or abnormal uterine bleeding (that occurs due to hormonal imbalance), painful periods, irregular periods or periods that are more frequent than normal (polymenorrhoea), premenstrual tension, endometriosis (abnormal growth of endometrial tissue of the uterus that causes pain and menstrual irregularities), metriopatheias haemorrhagia (intermenstrual bleeding) and breast cancer. It is also used to delay the menstrual cycle.

CYCLOREG CR 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pulmonary embolism (blood clots in the lung), liver disease, heart attack (myocardial infarction) or angina and deep vein thrombosis. CYCLOREG CR 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma, kidney disease, fits, and migraine headaches.

CYCLOREG CR 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy as it may affect the developing baby. Inform your doctor if you have had repeated miscarriages. CYCLOREG CR 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. If you experience mood changes and depressive symptoms, contact your doctor as soon as possible.

The most common side effects of taking CYCLOREG CR 10MG TABLET are irregular bleeding, heavy menstruation, spotting between menstrual cycles, delayed or not having a menstrual cycle, stomach discomfort, nausea, vomiting, breast tenderness, headache, and dizziness. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CYCLOREG CR 10MG TABLET Works

CYCLOREG CR 10MG TABLET inhibits the release of pituitary hormones that are responsible for the release of female hormones (such as oestrogen and progesterone) and thereby suppressing ovulation. This action modifies the lining of the endometrium and thus ceases bleeding in menstrual abnormalities in cancer CYCLOREG CR 10MG TABLET may act by pituitary inhibition or by direct action on tumour deposits.

Follow the instructions given by your doctor. Take CYCLOREG CR 10MG TABLET as advised according to your symptoms and disease severity. Swallow the whole tablet with a glass of water.

introduction:
Introduction About DYDROGEST ER 20 TABLET

DYDROGEST ER 20 TABLET contains Dydrogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Replacement Therapy. It is used to manage progesterone-deficiency states. It helps to manage problems that occur due to a deficiency of a female sex hormone called progesterone in the body. It helps to relieve period cramps and manage symptoms of endometriosis and premenstrual syndrome in women with progesterone deficiency. It can also be used to manage female reproductive health and is used in postmenopausal women to manage signs of menopause when used in combination with estrogens.

Dydrogesterone is a synthetic derivative of a female sex hormone called progesterone. It supplements the bodies with sufficient levels of progesterone. As a result, it relieves the unpleasant symptoms associated with progesterone deficiencies, such as menstrual pain, premenstrual syndrome, infertility, irregular periods, or signs of menopause. During management with DYDROGEST ER 20 TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Do not take DYDROGEST ER 20 TABLET if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma). Before taking DYDROGEST ER 20 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems, depression, or porphyria. Consult your doctor before taking DYDROGEST ER 20 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. DYDROGEST ER 20 TABLET should be used with caution in adolescent girls who have attained puberty (aged between 12-18 years).

Inform your doctor if you experience any changes in the breast, such as breast pain, tenderness, discharge from the nipple, lump growth in the breasts, heavy menstrual bleeding, pain, swelling, redness of the legs, sudden chest pain, or difficulty breathing after taking DYDROGEST ER 20 TABLET. The most common side effects of taking DYDROGEST ER 20 TABLET are severe headaches, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DYDROGEST ER 20 TABLET Works

DYDROGEST ER 20 TABLET helps in managing problems associated with progesterone deficiency states. It improves the thickness of the uterine lining, which helps in correcting infertility problems and irregular periods. It also provides relief from postmenopausal symptoms (such as hot flushes, sleep problems, irritability, and depression) by replacing the deficient progesterone levels in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use DYDROGEST ER 20 TABLET

Take DYDROGEST ER 20 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow DYDROGEST ER 20 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take DYDROGEST ER 20 TABLET at the same time each day. It can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of DYDROGEST ER 20 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.
