mechanismOfAction:
How C HOP 100 INJECTION Works

C HOP 100 INJECTION is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy. It sustains pregnancy among infertile women and in women who face repeated/threatened abortions by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About GESTOSERV 300 SR TABLET

GESTOSERV 300 SR TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking GESTOSERV 300 SR TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take GESTOSERV 300 SR TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with GESTOSERV 300 SR TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

GESTOSERV 300 SR TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. GESTOSERV 300 SR TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking GESTOSERV 300 SR TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

How GESTOSERV 300 SR TABLET Works

GESTOSERV 300 SR TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.

Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About GESTOGEST SR 200 TABLET

GESTOGEST SR 200 TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking GESTOGEST SR 200 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take GESTOGEST SR 200 TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with GESTOGEST SR 200 TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

GESTOGEST SR 200 TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. GESTOGEST SR 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking GESTOGEST SR 200 TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:

Female infertility
Abnormal uterine bleeding

Threatened abortions and pre-term delivery
mechanismOfAction:
How GESTOGEST SR 200 TABLET Works

GESTOGEST SR 200 TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: STYPTIN CR Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About STYPTIN CR TABLET

STYPTIN CR TABLET contains Norethisterone, which belongs to a group of medicines called Progestogens. It is used to manage heavy menstrual bleeding or abnormal uterine bleeding (that occurs due to hormonal imbalance), painful periods, irregular periods or periods that are more frequent than normal (polymenorrhoea), premenstrual tension, endometriosis (abnormal growth of endometrial tissue of the uterus that causes pain and menstrual irregularities), metriopatheias haemorrhagia (intermenstrual bleeding) and breast cancer. It is also used to delay the menstrual cycle.

STYPTIN CR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pulmonary embolism (blood clots in the lung), liver disease, heart attack (myocardial infarction) or angina and deep vein thrombosis. STYPTIN CR TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma, kidney disease, fits, and migraine headaches.

STYPTIN CR TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy as it may affect the developing baby. Inform your doctor if you have had repeated miscarriages. STYPTIN CR TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. If you experience mood changes and depressive symptoms, contact your doctor as soon as possible.

The most common side effects of taking STYPTIN CR TABLET are irregular bleeding, heavy menstruation, spotting between menstrual cycles, delayed or not having a menstrual cycle, stomach discomfort, nausea, vomiting, breast tenderness, headache, and dizziness. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How STYPTIN CR TABLET Works

STYPTIN CR TABLET inhibits the release of pituitary hormones that are responsible for the release of female hormones (such as oestrogen and progesterone) and thereby suppressing ovulation. This action modifies the lining of the endometrium and thus ceases bleeding in menstrual abnormalities in cancer STYPTIN CR TABLET may act by pituitary inhibition or by direct action on tumour deposits.

Introduction About DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET
What is DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET?

DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET contains Dydrogesterone, a well-studied synthetic progesterone. It is often prescribed as part of a hormone support plan for individuals managing menstrual cycle irregularities or undergoing reproductive care. This tablet mimics the action of natural progesterone, contributing to a more stable hormonal profile.

Use DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET exactly as directed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken orally with or without food. Dosage and duration depend on your specific health goals and medical history.

During management with DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET helps support hormonal balance by mimicking the natural actions of progesterone during the second half (luteal phase) of the menstrual cycle. This can assist in regulating the uterine lining and promoting cycle regularity. Women who experience inconsistent cycles, mid-cycle spotting, or other cycle-related issues due to hormonal imbalances may benefit from its regulated use as advised by their healthcare provider.

Before starting DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET, it is important to consult a healthcare professional to evaluate the underlying cause of hormonal changes. Usage in pregnancy, breastfeeding, or with other hormonal therapies should always be discussed in advance. Do not take DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET, if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma).

The most common side effects of taking DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET are severe headache, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET Works
Understanding the Role of Dydrogesterone

DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLETcontains Dydrogesterone, a synthetic form of the natural hormone progesterone. It mimics the hormonal activity needed for cycle regulation and supports the environment needed for hormone-responsive conditions. Unlike some other compounds, Dydrogesterone does not have androgenic or estrogenic effects, making it more selective in its action. This tablet is often used in hormone support strategies where balanced progesterone activity is essential.

Is DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET a natural or synthetic hormone?
DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET contains dydrogesterone, which is a synthetic hormone. It is a synthetic form of the naturally occurring hormone progesterone
How DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET may help with menstrual irregularities?

During a normal menstrual cycle, progesterone levels rise in the second half (luteal phase) to prepare the uterus for possible pregnancy. If pregnancy does not occur, progesterone levels drop, triggering menstruation. When the body does not produce enough progesterone, it can lead to irregular or missed periods, spotting, or cycle-related discomfort.

DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET compensates for this hormonal gap by providing dydrogesterone, which:

Helps maintain the natural rhythm of the menstrual cycle
Supports the uterine lining (endometrium) during the luteal phase
Encourages a predictable withdrawal bleed, simulating a natural period when the tablet is stopped
DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET uses in Pregnancy: 

It is often prescribed during pregnancy to help maintain a healthy pregnancy, particularly in cases where there is a risk of miscarriage or preterm labor due to progesterone deficiency. It supports the uterine lining, making it more favorable for embryo implantation and helps sustain early pregnancy. DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET may also be used in women who have a history of recurrent miscarriages or those undergoing fertility management.

DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET Uses in Menstrual Disorders:

DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET helps balance hormones, reducing the intense uterine contractions that cause pain during menstruation. By reducing the growth of the endometrial tissue that grows outside the uterus, it relieves pain and discomfort associated with endometriosis. DYDROSURE SR 20 TABLET helps stabilize hormone levels, reducing mood swings, bloating, and other symptoms of PMS.

introduction:
Introduction About DROPHARM 10MG TABLET

DROPHARM 10MG TABLET contains Dydrogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Replacement Therapy. It is used to manage progesterone-deficiency states. It helps to manage problems that occur due to a deficiency of a female sex hormone called progesterone in the body. It helps to relieve period cramps and manage symptoms of endometriosis and premenstrual syndrome in women with progesterone deficiency. It can also be used to manage female reproductive health and is used in postmenopausal women to manage signs of menopause when used in combination with estrogens.

Dydrogesterone is a synthetic derivative of a female sex hormone called progesterone. It supplements the bodies with sufficient levels of progesterone. As a result, it relieves the unpleasant symptoms associated with progesterone deficiencies, such as menstrual pain, premenstrual syndrome, infertility, irregular periods, or signs of menopause. During management with DROPHARM 10MG TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Do not take DROPHARM 10MG TABLET if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma). Before taking DROPHARM 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems, depression, or porphyria. Consult your doctor before taking DROPHARM 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. DROPHARM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in adolescent girls who have attained puberty (aged between 12-18 years).

Inform your doctor if you experience any changes in the breast, such as breast pain, tenderness, discharge from the nipple, lump growth in the breasts, heavy menstrual bleeding, pain, swelling, redness of the legs, sudden chest pain, or difficulty breathing after taking DROPHARM 10MG TABLET. The most common side effects of taking DROPHARM 10MG TABLET are severe headaches, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Introduction About SUGEST 200 CAPSULE

SUGEST 200 CAPSULE is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking SUGEST 200 CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take SUGEST 200 CAPSULE if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with SUGEST 200 CAPSULE, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

SUGEST 200 CAPSULE may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. SUGEST 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking SUGEST 200 CAPSULE are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How SUGEST 200 CAPSULE Works

SUGEST 200 CAPSULE is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: SUGEST 200 CAPSULE can be taken by pregnant women to support the growth of fetus during the early stages of pregnancy. However, consult your doctor before taking it.
SUGEST 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use during breast-feeding. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or drowsy after taking SUGEST 200 CAPSULE.
SUGEST 200 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.
SUGEST 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients who had or have liver disease and with abnormal liver function test. It should be used with caution in patients with benign liver tumor.
Do not take SUGEST 200 CAPSULE if you are allergic to Progesterone.
SUGEST 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients who had or have blood clot in the lungs (pulmonary embolism). It should be used with caution in patients with asthma.
SUGEST 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent heart attack or chest pain. It should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure.
SUGEST 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

Others

SUGEST 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have known or suspected cancer of the breast or womb lining (endometrium)
Have unusual vaginal bleeding
Had or have blood clots in the legs (deep venous thrombosis) or in the veins (thrombosis)
Have bleeding on the brain (cerebral hemorrhage) or stroke
Have blood clotting disorder (like protein C, protein S, or antithrombin deficiency)
Have porphyria (rare genetic blood disorder)

Before taking SUGEST 200 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Have problems in your uterus (such as fibroid growths or endometriosis (womb lining growth outside your womb)
Have a history of excessive womb lining growth (endometrial hyperplasia)
Have increased risk of blood clot formation (when you are unable to walk for long time after major surgery, injury or illness, obese and older age)
Have a family history of having breast cancer
Have diabetes
Have gallstones
Have migraine or severe headaches
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an immune system disease that affects many organs of the body)
Have epilepsy (fits)
Have otosclerosis (disease affecting the eardrum and hearing)
Have ever had depression
Have skin sensitivity towards light

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking SUGEST 200 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Antiepileptics (Ex. carbamazepine, phenytoin, phenobarbital)
Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, rifabutin, ampicillin and tetracyclines such as doxycycline, minocycline)
Anti-HIV infection (Ex. nelfinavir, nevirapine, efavirenz, ritonavir)
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression)
Bromocriptine (a medicine used to stop breast milk production, manage infertility or parkinsonism)
Cyclosporine (a medicine used to manage graft rejection)
Antifungal agents (Ex. griseofulvin, ketoconazole, terbinafine)
Spironolactone (a medicine used to manage fluid retention)
Other progesterone medicines used to manage hormonal problems (such as medroxyprogesterone acetate and megestrol)
Blood thinning medicines (Ex. warfarin, phenindione)
Antidiabetic agents (Ex. glimepiride, metformin)
Ulipristal (a medicine used to manage pregnancy in emergencies)
Tizanidine (a medicine used to manage multiple sclerosis)

B. Drug – Food interactions:

Do not take SUGEST 200 CAPSULE with food as it may increase the bioavailability of this medicine.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of SUGEST 200 CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are dizziness, tiredness, drowsiness or sleepiness.

introduction:
Introduction About MICHELLE AQ INJECTION

MICHELLE AQ INJECTION is used for the maintenance of early pregnancy in patients who faced documented history of repeated miscarriages due to luteal phase defect (a problem in menstrual cycle caused due to deficiency of progesterone during the midway of the menstrual cycle).

It can also be used as an adjuvant to infertility techniques (such as in vitro fertilization (IVF) or gamete intra-fallopian transfer (GIFT)) to facilitate successful implantation of the fertilized egg in the uterus. It is also used to manage threatened abortions and to manage abnormal uterine bleeding caused due to hormonal imbalance.

It can be used as a diagnostic tool in progesterone withdrawal testing to diagnose the endocrinal causes of secondary amenorrhea (irregular or lack of menstrual periods) and to judge the chances of pregnancy among infertile women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before receiving MICHELLE AQ INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, epilepsy, or migraine headaches before receiving MICHELLE AQ INJECTION as a precaution.

MICHELLE AQ INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, ovarian cancer, uterine cancer, blood clot problems or any vaginal infections. MICHELLE AQ INJECTION is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

MICHELLE AQ INJECTION can be used during the first three months of pregnancy. However, it should not be used in women who have ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside the womb) and in women who had a history of idiopathic jaundice (severe itching of the skin) or other skin problems during their earlier pregnancies.

The most common side effects of receiving MICHELLE AQ INJECTION are pain, redness, itching, irritation or swelling at the injection site, vaginal bleeding, headache, bloating, nausea, hair loss, abnormal hair growth in the body, darkening of the facial skin or difficulty in sleeping. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. Talk to your doctor immediately if you experience any changes in body weight or feel depressed while receiving MICHELLE AQ INJECTION.

name: RETHROWEL 5 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About RETHROWEL 5 TABLET

RETHROWEL 5 TABLET contains Norethisterone, which belongs to a group of medicines called Progestogens. It is used to manage heavy menstrual bleeding or abnormal uterine bleeding (that occurs due to hormonal imbalance), painful periods, irregular periods or periods that are more frequent than normal (polymenorrhoea), premenstrual tension, endometriosis (abnormal growth of endometrial tissue of the uterus that causes pain and menstrual irregularities), metriopatheias haemorrhagia (intermenstrual bleeding) and breast cancer. It is also used to delay the menstrual cycle.

RETHROWEL 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pulmonary embolism (blood clots in the lung), liver disease, heart attack (myocardial infarction) or angina and deep vein thrombosis. RETHROWEL 5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma, kidney disease, fits, and migraine headaches.

RETHROWEL 5 TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy as it may affect the developing baby. Inform your doctor if you have had repeated miscarriages. RETHROWEL 5 TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. If you experience mood changes and depressive symptoms, contact your doctor as soon as possible.

The most common side effects of taking RETHROWEL 5 TABLET are irregular bleeding, heavy menstruation, spotting between menstrual cycles, delayed or not having a menstrual cycle, stomach discomfort, nausea, vomiting, breast tenderness, headache, and dizziness. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen

mechanismOfAction:
How RETHROWEL 5 TABLET Works

RETHROWEL 5 TABLET inhibits the release of pituitary hormones that are responsible for the release of female hormones (such as oestrogen and progesterone) and thereby suppressing ovulation. This action modifies the lining of the endometrium and thus ceases bleeding in menstrual abnormalities in cancer RETHROWEL 5 TABLET may act by pituitary inhibition or by direct action on tumour deposits.
usageDetails:
How to use RETHROWEL 5 TABLET

Follow the instructions given by your doctor. Take RETHROWEL 5 TABLET as advised according to your symptoms and disease severity. Swallow the whole tablet with a glass of water.

introduction:
Introduction About MODUS 10MG TABLET

MODUS 10MG TABLET contains Medroxyprogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal medicines. It is used to maintain balance on menstrual cycle and controls abnormal tissue growth in the uterus.

MODUS 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems, breast cancer, venous thrombosis or arterial thrombosis, porphyria, undiagnosed vaginal bleeding, heart attack or stroke.   

MODUS 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women as it can affect the developing baby. If you think you are pregnant or planning to have baby or have a history of repeated miscarriage, breastfeeding inform your doctor before taking MODUS 10MG TABLET.

MODUS 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. The most common side effects of taking MODUS 10MG TABLET are headache, nausea, difficulty sleeping, tiredness and hair loss. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.
uses: Controls abnormal tissue growth in uterus
usesDetails:

Balances menstrual cycle

mechanismOfAction:
How MODUS 10MG TABLET Works

MODUS 10MG TABLET works by stopping the production of gonadotropin hormone, which is responsible for maturation of cells in the ovary and the process of releasing mature egg from the ovary (ovulation) to avoid pregnancy. This kind of action also thins the endometrium (uterus lining), which in turn provides relief from unpleasant period symptoms.

How to use MODUS 10MG TABLET

Take MODUS 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow MODUS 10MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Gestofit 200mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About GESTOFIT 200MG CAPSULE

GESTOFIT 200MG CAPSULE is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking GESTOFIT 200MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take GESTOFIT 200MG CAPSULE if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with GESTOFIT 200MG CAPSULE, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

GESTOFIT 200MG CAPSULE may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. GESTOFIT 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking GESTOFIT 200MG CAPSULE are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of GESTOFIT 200MG CAPSULE

It is used in the management of the following progesterone deficiency conditions such as:

Female infertility
Abnormal uterine bleeding
Menopausal disorders
Secondary amenorrhea
Supports early stages of pregnancy
Threatened abortions and pre-term delivery
mechanismOfAction:
How GESTOFIT 200MG CAPSULE Works

GESTOFIT 200MG CAPSULE is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

faqs.question: Q. When is progesterone produced in the reproductive cycle?
faqs.answer: A. The typical menstrual cycle takes approximately 28 to 32 days and is divided into three distinct phases namely the follicular phase, the ovulatory phase, and the luteal phase. The luteal phase is the period when the body produces progesterone, the hormone that makes the uterus prepare its lining to receive the egg.

faqs.question: Q: Can progesterone tablets cause weight gain?
faqs.answer: A: Progesterone may cause water retention and bloating, which can lead to temporary weight gain in some individuals.

faqs.question: Q: Can you take progesterone tablets during pregnancy?

faqs.question: Q: Can progesterone tablets affect mood?

introduction:
Introduction About C HOP AQ 50 INJECTION

C HOP AQ 50 INJECTION is used for the maintenance of early pregnancy in patients who faced documented history of repeated miscarriages due to luteal phase defect (a problem in menstrual cycle caused due to deficiency of progesterone during the midway of the menstrual cycle).

It can also be used as an adjuvant to infertility techniques (such as in vitro fertilization (IVF) or gamete intra-fallopian transfer (GIFT)) to facilitate successful implantation of the fertilized egg in the uterus. It is also used to manage threatened abortions and to manage abnormal uterine bleeding caused due to hormonal imbalance.

It can be used as a diagnostic tool in progesterone withdrawal testing to diagnose the endocrinal causes of secondary amenorrhea (irregular or lack of menstrual periods) and to judge the chances of pregnancy among infertile women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before receiving C HOP AQ 50 INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, epilepsy, or migraine headaches before receiving C HOP AQ 50 INJECTION as a precaution.

C HOP AQ 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, ovarian cancer, uterine cancer, blood clot problems or any vaginal infections. C HOP AQ 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

C HOP AQ 50 INJECTION can be used during the first three months of pregnancy. However, it should not be used in women who have ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside the womb) and in women who had a history of idiopathic jaundice (severe itching of the skin) or other skin problems during their earlier pregnancies.

The most common side effects of receiving C HOP AQ 50 INJECTION are pain, redness, itching, irritation or swelling at the injection site, vaginal bleeding, headache, bloating, nausea, hair loss, abnormal hair growth in the body, darkening of the facial skin or difficulty in sleeping. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. Talk to your doctor immediately if you experience any changes in body weight or feel depressed while receiving C HOP AQ 50 INJECTION.

During management with ALGEST SR 200 TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

ALGEST SR 200 TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. ALGEST SR 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

introduction:
Introduction About MENDATE 10MG TABLET

MENDATE 10MG TABLET contains Norethisterone, which belongs to a group of medicines called Progestogens. It is used to manage heavy menstrual bleeding or abnormal uterine bleeding (that occurs due to hormonal imbalance), painful periods, irregular periods or periods that are more frequent than normal (polymenorrhoea), premenstrual tension, endometriosis (abnormal growth of endometrial tissue of the uterus that causes pain and menstrual irregularities), metriopatheias haemorrhagia (intermenstrual bleeding) and breast cancer. It is also used to delay the menstrual cycle.

MENDATE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pulmonary embolism (blood clots in the lung), liver disease, heart attack (myocardial infarction) or angina and deep vein thrombosis. MENDATE 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma, kidney disease, fits, and migraine headaches.

MENDATE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy as it may affect the developing baby. Inform your doctor if you have had repeated miscarriages. MENDATE 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. If you experience mood changes and depressive symptoms, contact your doctor as soon as possible.

The most common side effects of taking MENDATE 10MG TABLET are irregular bleeding, heavy menstruation, spotting between menstrual cycles, delayed or not having a menstrual cycle, stomach discomfort, nausea, vomiting, breast tenderness, headache, and dizziness. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen.

How MENDATE 10MG TABLET Works

MENDATE 10MG TABLET inhibits the release of pituitary hormones that are responsible for the release of female hormones (such as oestrogen and progesterone) and thereby suppressing ovulation. This action modifies the lining of the endometrium and thus ceases bleeding in menstrual abnormalities in cancer MENDATE 10MG TABLET may act by pituitary inhibition or by direct action on tumour deposits.

introduction:
Introduction About NATUROGEST

NATUROGEST is used for the maintenance of early pregnancy in patients who faced documented history of repeated miscarriages due to luteal phase defect (a problem in menstrual cycle caused due to deficiency of progesterone during the midway of the menstrual cycle).

It can also be used as an adjuvant to infertility techniques (such as in vitro fertilization (IVF) or gamete intra-fallopian transfer (GIFT)) to facilitate successful implantation of the fertilized egg in the uterus. It is also used to manage threatened abortions and to manage abnormal uterine bleeding caused due to hormonal imbalance.

It can be used as a diagnostic tool in progesterone withdrawal testing to diagnose the endocrinal causes of secondary amenorrhea (irregular or lack of menstrual periods) and to judge the chances of pregnancy among infertile women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before receiving NATUROGEST inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, epilepsy, or migraine headaches before receiving NATUROGEST as a precaution.

NATUROGEST is not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, ovarian cancer, uterine cancer, blood clot problems or any vaginal infections. NATUROGEST is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

NATUROGEST can be used during the first three months of pregnancy. However, it should not be used in women who have ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside the womb) and in women who had a history of idiopathic jaundice (severe itching of the skin) or other skin problems during their earlier pregnancies.

The most common side effects of receiving NATUROGEST are pain, redness, itching, irritation or swelling at the injection site, vaginal bleeding, headache, bloating, nausea, hair loss, abnormal hair growth in the body, darkening of the facial skin or difficulty in sleeping. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. Talk to your doctor immediately if you experience any changes in body weight or feel depressed while receiving NATUROGEST.

mechanismOfAction:
How NATUROGEST Works

NATUROGEST is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy. It sustains pregnancy among infertile women and in women who face repeated/threatened abortions by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding.

introduction:
Introduction About SUSTEN 200MG INJECTION

SUSTEN 200MG INJECTION is used for the maintenance of early pregnancy in patients who faced documented history of repeated miscarriages due to luteal phase defect (a problem in menstrual cycle caused due to deficiency of progesterone during the midway of the menstrual cycle).

It can also be used as an adjuvant to infertility techniques (such as in vitro fertilization (IVF) or gamete intra-fallopian transfer (GIFT)) to facilitate successful implantation of the fertilized egg in the uterus. It is also used to manage threatened abortions and to manage abnormal uterine bleeding caused due to hormonal imbalance.

It can be used as a diagnostic tool in progesterone withdrawal testing to diagnose the endocrinal causes of secondary amenorrhea (irregular or lack of menstrual periods) and to judge the chances of pregnancy among infertile women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before receiving SUSTEN 200MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, epilepsy, or migraine headaches before receiving SUSTEN 200MG INJECTION as a precaution.

SUSTEN 200MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, ovarian cancer, uterine cancer, blood clot problems or any vaginal infections. SUSTEN 200MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

SUSTEN 200MG INJECTION can be used during the first three months of pregnancy. However, it should not be used in women who have ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside the womb) and in women who had a history of idiopathic jaundice (severe itching of the skin) or other skin problems during their earlier pregnancies.

The most common side effects of receiving SUSTEN 200MG INJECTION are pain, redness, itching, irritation or swelling at the injection site, vaginal bleeding, headache, bloating, nausea, hair loss, abnormal hair growth in the body, darkening of the facial skin or difficulty in sleeping. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. Talk to your doctor immediately if you experience any changes in body weight or feel depressed while receiving SUSTEN 200MG INJECTION.

introduction:
Introduction About HYDROGESTERON DEPOT 250 INJECTION

HYDROGESTERON DEPOT 250 INJECTION contains Hydroxyprogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Progestin hormones. It is used to lower the preterm birth risk in women with a singleton pregnancy having a history of preterm delivery. It is also used to manage premature labor and miscarriage in pregnant women.  

Preterm delivery is a condition in which the baby is born too early that is before the completion of 37 weeks with early symptoms such as frequent sensation of womb contractions, constant backache, feeling of pressure in abdomen, light bleeding or change in vaginal discharge.

Miscarriage is the sudden and early loss of pregnancy before the 20th week of gestation. It is characterized by symptoms such as vaginal bleeding or spotting, pain or cramps in the abdomen or back or fluid/tissue coming out of vagina. Your doctor may monitor your blood sugar levels while using this medicine if you are diabetic or pre-diabetic.

HYDROGESTERON DEPOT 250 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with liver tumours, any active liver disease, thrombosis/thromboembolic disorders (formation of clots in the blood vessels), known or suspected breast cancer/other hormone-sensitive cancers and uncontrolled high blood pressure.

HYDROGESTERON DEPOT 250 INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with asthma, kidney or heart problems, diabetes or pre-diabetes, epilepsy and migraine. It is not recommended for use in pregnant women with cholestatic jaundice and it should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

It is not recommended for use in girls (aged below 16 years). The common side effects associated with the use of HYDROGESTERON DEPOT 250 INJECTION are pain, swelling, itching or a hard bump at the injection site, raised red rashes, itching, nausea and diarrhoea. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens or prolong.

introduction:
Introduction About EMBRYOGEN TABLET

EMBRYOGEN TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking EMBRYOGEN TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take EMBRYOGEN TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with EMBRYOGEN TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

EMBRYOGEN TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. EMBRYOGEN TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking EMBRYOGEN TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How EMBRYOGEN TABLET Works

EMBRYOGEN TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: EMBRYOGEN TABLET can be taken by pregnant women to support the growth of fetus during the early stages of pregnancy. However, consult your doctor before taking it.
EMBRYOGEN TABLET is not recommended for use during breast-feeding. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or drowsy after taking EMBRYOGEN TABLET.
EMBRYOGEN TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.
EMBRYOGEN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who had or have liver disease and with abnormal liver function test. It should be used with caution in patients with benign liver tumor.
Do not take EMBRYOGEN TABLET if you are allergic to Progesterone.
EMBRYOGEN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who had or have blood clot in the lungs (pulmonary embolism). It should be used with caution in patients with asthma.
EMBRYOGEN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with recent heart attack or chest pain. It should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure.
EMBRYOGEN TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

Others

EMBRYOGEN TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have known or suspected cancer of the breast or womb lining (endometrium)
Have unusual vaginal bleeding
Had or have blood clots in the legs (deep venous thrombosis) or in the veins (thrombosis)
Have bleeding on the brain (cerebral hemorrhage) or stroke
Have blood clotting disorder (like protein C, protein S, or antithrombin deficiency)
Have porphyria (rare genetic blood disorder)

Before taking EMBRYOGEN TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have problems in your uterus (such as fibroid growths or endometriosis (womb lining growth outside your womb)
Have a history of excessive womb lining growth (endometrial hyperplasia)
Have increased risk of blood clot formation (when you are unable to walk for long time after major surgery, injury or illness, obese and older age)
Have a family history of having breast cancer
Have diabetes
Have gallstones
Have migraine or severe headaches
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an immune system disease that affects many organs of the body)
Have epilepsy (fits)
Have otosclerosis (disease affecting the eardrum and hearing)
Have ever had depression
Have skin sensitivity towards light

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking EMBRYOGEN TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Antiepileptics (Ex. carbamazepine, phenytoin, phenobarbital)
Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, rifabutin, ampicillin and tetracyclines such as doxycycline, minocycline)
Anti-HIV infection (Ex. nelfinavir, nevirapine, efavirenz, ritonavir)
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression)
Bromocriptine (a medicine used to stop breast milk production, manage infertility or parkinsonism)
Cyclosporine (a medicine used to manage graft rejection)
Antifungal agents (Ex. griseofulvin, ketoconazole, terbinafine)
Spironolactone (a medicine used to manage fluid retention)
Other progesterone medicines used to manage hormonal problems (such as medroxyprogesterone acetate and megestrol)
Blood thinning medicines (Ex. warfarin, phenindione)
Antidiabetic agents (Ex. glimepiride, metformin)
Ulipristal (a medicine used to manage pregnancy in emergencies)
Tizanidine (a medicine used to manage multiple sclerosis)

B. Drug – Food interactions:

Do not take EMBRYOGEN TABLET with food as it may increase the bioavailability of this medicine.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of EMBRYOGEN TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are dizziness, tiredness, drowsiness or sleepiness.

name: Emgra Tablet 28'S
introduction:
Introduction About EMGRA TABLET

EMGRA TABLET contains Estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Estrogens. EMGRA TABLET is used in postmenopausal women (with at least 6 months since their last natural period) to provide relief from symptoms that occurs after menopause. It is also used to manage osteoporosis (condition marked by weak and fragile bones) which occurs after menopause in few women.

EMGRA TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Estradiol. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have/had/suspected of breast/endometrial cancer or thrombosis (blood clot in vein). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who suffer from unusual vaginal bleeding, unmanageed endometrial hyperplasia (excessive thickening of the womb lining), lung disease (such as pulmonary embolism), heart disease (such as heart attack/heart block), and/or liver disease (such as benign liver tumour).

Before taking EMGRA TABLET, inform your doctor if you have fibroids (non-cancerous growths inside womb), endometriosis (growth of womb lining outside womb)/endometrial hyperplasia (excessive growth of the womb lining), and/or suffer from epilepsy, otosclerosis (disease that affects eardrum and hearing), kidney problems, and/or lung problems (such as asthma).

EMGRA TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women since it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women. The medicine is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents since it is indicated for use only in postmenopausal women. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly women (aged 60 years and above) after consulting the doctor since the medicine may increase the risk of heart disease in elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking EMGRA TABLET are headache, nausea, cramps in legs, abdominal/pelvic pain, unscheduled bleeding/spotting, asthenia (feeling of weakness), and/or rash/itching. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How EMGRA TABLET Works

EMGRA TABLET contains precursor of ovarian hormones (responsible for menstruation and reproduction in women) which replaces natural Estradiol hormone in the body that helps in maintaining adequate level of circulating hormones thus providing relief from vasomotor symptoms (such as hot flashes) in post-menopausal women.

Take EMGRA TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Consult your doctor before taking the medicine and stop the medicine immediately if you become pregnant or think you may be pregnant.
EMGRA TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women. Consult your doctor before taking EMGRA TABLET.
EMGRA TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking EMGRA TABLET.

EMGRA TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with/history of liver disease (such as benign liver tumour) and in patients who have abnormal liver function. Consult your doctor before taking EMGRA TABLET.

EMGRA TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with lung disease such as pulmonary embolism (blood clot in lungs). It should be used with caution in patient with other lung problems such as asthma. Consult your doctor before taking EMGRA TABLET.

Others

EMGRA TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have/had/suspected of breast cancer
Have/suspected of endometrium cancer
Have unusual vaginal bleeding
Suffer from unmanageed endometrial hyperplasia (excessive thickening of the womb lining)
Have/had thrombosis (blood clot in a vein) such as deep venous thrombosis
Have blood clotting disorder such as protein C/protein S/antithrombin deficiency
Have/recently had blood clots in arteries such as stroke
Suffer from inherited porphyria (rare blood disorder)

Before taking EMGRA TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have fibroids (non-cancerous growths) inside womb
Suffer from endometriosis (growth of womb lining outside womb) or have a history of endometrial hyperplasia (excessive growth of the womb lining)
Have an increased risk of developing blood clots
Have an increased risk of developing estrogen-sensitive cancer such as mother, sister/ grandmother who has/had breast cancer
Suffer from high blood pressure, diabetes, gallstones, migraine/severe headaches
Suffer from systemic lupus erythematosus (disease of the immune system that affects many organs of the body)
Suffer from epilepsy
Suffer from otosclerosis (disease affecting eardrum and hearing), hereditary and acquired angioedema
Are scheduled for any surgery

Use in Paediatrics:

EMGRA TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents since it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women.

Use in Geriatrics:

EMGRA TABLET should be used with caution in elderly women (aged 60 years and above) due to increased risk of developing heart disease.  Consult your doctor before taking EMGRA TABLET.

name: UNIPROGESTIN 250 Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About UNIPROGESTIN 250 INJECTION

UNIPROGESTIN 250 INJECTION contains Hydroxyprogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Progestin hormones. It is used to lower the preterm birth risk in women with a singleton pregnancy having a history of preterm delivery. It is also used to manage premature labor and miscarriage in pregnant women.  

Preterm delivery is a condition in which the baby is born too early that is before the completion of 37 weeks with early symptoms such as frequent sensation of womb contractions, constant backache, feeling of pressure in abdomen, light bleeding or change in vaginal discharge.

Miscarriage is the sudden and early loss of pregnancy before the 20th week of gestation. It is characterized by symptoms such as vaginal bleeding or spotting, pain or cramps in the abdomen or back or fluid/tissue coming out of vagina. Your doctor may monitor your blood sugar levels while using this medicine if you are diabetic or pre-diabetic.

UNIPROGESTIN 250 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with liver tumours, any active liver disease, thrombosis/thromboembolic disorders (formation of clots in the blood vessels), known or suspected breast cancer/other hormone-sensitive cancers and uncontrolled high blood pressure.

UNIPROGESTIN 250 INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with asthma, kidney or heart problems, diabetes or pre-diabetes, epilepsy and migraine. It is not recommended for use in pregnant women with cholestatic jaundice and it should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

It is not recommended for use in girls (aged below 16 years). The common side effects associated with the use of UNIPROGESTIN 250 INJECTION are pain, swelling, itching or a hard bump at the injection site, raised red rashes, itching, nausea and diarrhoea. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens or prolong.

Prevents premature labor and miscarriage in pregnant women

How UNIPROGESTIN 250 INJECTION Works

UNIPROGESTIN 250 INJECTION helps in lowering the chances of preterm birth where hydroxyprogesterone is a synthetic preparation of progesterone hormone works by regulating the female reproductive system and plays a vital role in implanting the embryo successfully in the womb. It also induces anti-inflammatory response that can initiate pre-term labour.

How to use UNIPROGESTIN 250 INJECTION

UNIPROGESTIN 250 INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse in the back of your upper arm subcutaneously (under the skin) or in the muscle as an intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Lupigest 400mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE

LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE

It is used in the management of the following progesterone deficiency conditions such as:

Female infertility
Abnormal uterine bleeding
Menopausal disorders
Secondary amenorrhea
Supports early stages of pregnancy
Threatened abortions and pre-term delivery
mechanismOfAction:
How LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE Works

LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE can be taken by pregnant women to support the growth of fetus during the early stages of pregnancy. However, consult your doctor before taking it.
LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use during breast-feeding. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or drowsy after taking LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE.
LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.
LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients who had or have liver disease and with abnormal liver function test. It should be used with caution in patients with benign liver tumor.
Do not take LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Progesterone.
LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients who had or have blood clot in the lungs (pulmonary embolism). It should be used with caution in patients with asthma.
LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent heart attack or chest pain. It should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure.
LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

Others

LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have known or suspected cancer of the breast or womb lining (endometrium)
Have unusual vaginal bleeding
Had or have blood clots in the legs (deep venous thrombosis) or in the veins (thrombosis)
Have bleeding on the brain (cerebral hemorrhage) or stroke
Have blood clotting disorder (like protein C, protein S, or antithrombin deficiency)
Have porphyria (rare genetic blood disorder)

Before taking LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Have problems in your uterus (such as fibroid growths or endometriosis (womb lining growth outside your womb)
Have a history of excessive womb lining growth (endometrial hyperplasia)
Have increased risk of blood clot formation (when you are unable to walk for long time after major surgery, injury or illness, obese and older age)
Have a family history of having breast cancer
Have diabetes
Have gallstones
Have migraine or severe headaches
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an immune system disease that affects many organs of the body)
Have epilepsy (fits)
Have otosclerosis (disease affecting the eardrum and hearing)
Have ever had depression
Have skin sensitivity towards light

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Antiepileptics (Ex. carbamazepine, phenytoin, phenobarbital)
Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, rifabutin, ampicillin and tetracyclines such as doxycycline, minocycline)
Anti-HIV infection (Ex. nelfinavir, nevirapine, efavirenz, ritonavir)
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression)
Bromocriptine (a medicine used to stop breast milk production, manage infertility or parkinsonism)
Cyclosporine (a medicine used to manage graft rejection)
Antifungal agents (Ex. griseofulvin, ketoconazole, terbinafine)
Spironolactone (a medicine used to manage fluid retention)
Other progesterone medicines used to manage hormonal problems (such as medroxyprogesterone acetate and megestrol)
Blood thinning medicines (Ex. warfarin, phenindione)
Antidiabetic agents (Ex. glimepiride, metformin)
Ulipristal (a medicine used to manage pregnancy in emergencies)
Tizanidine (a medicine used to manage multiple sclerosis)

B. Drug – Food interactions:

Do not take LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE with food as it may increase the bioavailability of this medicine.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of LUPIGEST 400MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are dizziness, tiredness, drowsiness or sleepiness.

faqs.question: Q. Why is DIVAGEST SR 300MG TABLET necessary for pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A. DIVAGEST SR 300MG TABLET supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy. It sustains pregnancy among infertile women and in women who face repeated/threatened abortions by increasing the thickness of uterine wall.

faqs.question: Q. When is progesterone produced in the reproductive cycle?
faqs.answer: A. The typical menstrual cycle takes approximately 28 to 32 days and is divided into three distinct phases namely the follicular phase, the ovulatory phase, and the luteal phase. The luteal phase is the period when the body produces progesterone, the hormone that makes the uterus prepare its lining to receive the egg.

faqs.question: Q. What precautions need to be followed while taking DIVAGEST SR 300MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A. Before taking DIVAGEST SR 300MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, heart problems, blood clots, diabetes, or asthma. Take DIVAGEST SR 300MG TABLET regularly as instructed by the physician without fail. Do not miss a dose of DIVAGEST SR 300MG TABLET to achieve maximum benefits.

faqs.question: Q: What are DIVAGEST SR 300MG TABLET used for?
faqs.answer: A: DIVAGEST SR 300MG TABLET is commonly used in the management of menstrual disorders, support early pregnancy, manage hormone replacement therapy (HRT), and address symptoms of menopause or infertility.

faqs.question: Q: How DIVAGEST SR 300MG TABLET works?
faqs.answer: A: DIVAGEST SR 300MG TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy. It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.

faqs.question: Q: Can progesterone tablets cause weight gain?
faqs.answer: A: Progesterone may cause water retention and bloating, which can lead to temporary weight gain in some individuals.

faqs.question: Q: Can you take progesterone tablets during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, in certain cases, progesterone tablets are prescribed during early pregnancy to support the uterine lining and reduce the risk of miscarriage.

faqs.question: Q: Can progesterone tablets affect mood?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, mood swings or depression can occur as a side effect of progesterone, particularly when hormone levels fluctuate.

faqs.question: Q: How long does it take for progesterone tablets to work?
faqs.answer: A: The effect of progesterone tablets can vary depending on the condition being treated, but some users notice changes within a few days to weeks.

faqs.question: Q: Are there any interactions between progesterone tablets and other medications?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, progesterone can interact with certain medications like antifungals, anticonvulsants, and blood thinners. Always inform your doctor about any medications you're taking.

Introduction About NIDAGEN 100MG CAPSULE

Before taking NIDAGEN 100MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. The most common side effects of taking NIDAGEN 100MG CAPSULE are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Introduction About DIVAGEST SR 200MG TABLET

DIVAGEST SR 200MG TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking DIVAGEST SR 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take DIVAGEST SR 200MG TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with DIVAGEST SR 200MG TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

DIVAGEST SR 200MG TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. DIVAGEST SR 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking DIVAGEST SR 200MG TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How DIVAGEST SR 200MG TABLET Works

DIVAGEST SR 200MG TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

faqs.question: Q. When is progesterone produced in the reproductive cycle?
faqs.answer: A. The typical menstrual cycle takes approximately 28 to 32 days and is divided into three distinct phases namely the follicular phase, the ovulatory phase, and the luteal phase. The luteal phase is the period when the body produces progesterone, the hormone that makes the uterus prepare its lining to receive the egg.

faqs.question: Q. What precautions need to be followed while taking DIVAGEST SR 200MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A. faqs.question: Q: What are DIVAGEST SR 200MG TABLET used for?
faqs.answer: A: DIVAGEST SR 200MG TABLET is commonly used in the management of menstrual disorders, support early pregnancy, manage hormone replacement therapy (HRT), and address symptoms of menopause or infertility.

faqs.question: Q: How DIVAGEST SR 200MG TABLET works?
faqs.answer: A: DIVAGEST SR 200MG TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy. It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.

faqs.question: Q: Can progesterone tablets cause weight gain?
faqs.answer: A: Progesterone may cause water retention and bloating, which can lead to temporary weight gain in some individuals.

faqs.question: Q: Can you take progesterone tablets during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, in certain cases, progesterone tablets are prescribed during early pregnancy to support the uterine lining and reduce the risk of miscarriage.

faqs.question: Q: Can progesterone tablets affect mood?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, mood swings or depression can occur as a side effect of progesterone, particularly when hormone levels fluctuate.

faqs.question: Q: How long does it take for progesterone tablets to work?
faqs.answer: A: The effect of progesterone tablets can vary depending on the condition being treated, but some users notice changes within a few days to weeks.

faqs.question: Q: Are there any interactions between progesterone tablets and other medications?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, progesterone can interact with certain medications like antifungals, anticonvulsants, and blood thinners. Always inform your doctor about any medications you're taking.

Introduction About GYNASET CR 15 TABLET

GYNASET CR 15 TABLET contains Norethisterone, which belongs to a group of medicines called Progestogens. It is used to manage heavy menstrual bleeding or abnormal uterine bleeding (that occurs due to hormonal imbalance), painful periods, irregular periods or periods that are more frequent than normal (polymenorrhoea), premenstrual tension, endometriosis (abnormal growth of endometrial tissue of the uterus that causes pain and menstrual irregularities), metriopatheias haemorrhagia (intermenstrual bleeding) and breast cancer. It is also used to delay the menstrual cycle.

GYNASET CR 15 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pulmonary embolism (blood clots in the lung), liver disease, heart attack (myocardial infarction) or angina and deep vein thrombosis. GYNASET CR 15 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma, kidney disease, fits, and migraine headaches.

GYNASET CR 15 TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy as it may affect the developing baby. Inform your doctor if you have had repeated miscarriages. GYNASET CR 15 TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. If you experience mood changes and depressive symptoms, contact your doctor as soon as possible.

The most common side effects of taking GYNASET CR 15 TABLET are irregular bleeding, heavy menstruation, spotting between menstrual cycles, delayed or not having a menstrual cycle, stomach discomfort, nausea, vomiting, breast tenderness, headache, and dizziness. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen.

Introduction About DYDROSURE SR 30 TABLET
What is DYDROSURE SR 30 TABLET?

DYDROSURE SR 30 TABLET contains Dydrogesterone, a well-studied synthetic progesterone. It is often prescribed as part of a hormone support plan for individuals managing menstrual cycle irregularities or undergoing reproductive care. This tablet mimics the action of natural progesterone, contributing to a more stable hormonal profile.

Use DYDROSURE SR 30 TABLET exactly as directed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken orally with or without food. Dosage and duration depend on your specific health goals and medical history.

During management with DYDROSURE SR 30 TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

DYDROSURE SR 30 TABLET helps support hormonal balance by mimicking the natural actions of progesterone during the second half (luteal phase) of the menstrual cycle. This can assist in regulating the uterine lining and promoting cycle regularity. Women who experience inconsistent cycles, mid-cycle spotting, or other cycle-related issues due to hormonal imbalances may benefit from its regulated use as advised by their healthcare provider.

Before starting DYDROSURE SR 30 TABLET, it is important to consult a healthcare professional to evaluate the underlying cause of hormonal changes. Usage in pregnancy, breastfeeding, or with other hormonal therapies should always be discussed in advance. Do not take DYDROSURE SR 30 TABLET, if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma).

The most common side effects of taking DYDROSURE SR 30 TABLET are severe headache, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
