introduction:
Introduction About VALUECOC L 0.15 TABLET

VALUECOC L 0.15 TABLET is a combination of Levonorgestrel and Ethinylestradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Contraceptive Agents. It is used as a contraceptive pill to manage pregnancy.

Before taking VALUECOC L 0.15 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, high blood pressure, high blood cholesterol levels, migraine, obesity, epilepsy or depression as a precaution.

VALUECOC L 0.15 TABLET is strictly not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, cervical cancer or liver cancer. It is also not suitable for use in patients with depression, blood clots, stroke or any problems in blood circulation.

VALUECOC L 0.15 TABLET is not intended for use in pregnant women, in children who have not attained puberty and elderly women who have reached menopause. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in women (aged above 35 years) who have the habit of smoking.

The most common side effects of taking VALUECOC L 0.15 TABLET are vaginal infections or inflammation, vaginal discharge, unusual spotting or bleeding, breast tenderness, milk discharge from breasts, mood changes, low sex drive, and changes in body weight. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

Uses Of VALUECOC L 0.15 TABLET
Used as a contraceptive to manage pregnancy
mechanismOfAction:
How VALUECOC L 0.15 TABLET Works

VALUECOC L 0.15 TABLET is a contraceptive pill. It reduces the chances of pregnancy by suppressing ovulation (release of a mature egg from an ovary). It can also reduce the thickness of the inner lining of the uterus which makes it not suitable for the foetus to implant and grow.

Additionally, it can alter the thickness of the cervical mucus which makes it difficult for the sperm to enter the uterus and fertilize the egg. As a result, they create an unfavourable environment for a successful pregnancy.
usageDetails:
How to use VALUECOC L 0.15 TABLET

Take VALUECOC L 0.15 TABLET strictly as advised by your physician. Swallow VALUECOC L 0.15 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. VALUECOC L 0.15 TABLET can be taken with or without meals.

Do not miss any dose of VALUECOC L 0.15 TABLET in between the therapy, as it may reduce its effectiveness. In case you have missed a dose of VALUECOC L 0.15 TABLET, take it as soon as you remember. Avoid taking a double dose of this medicine to compensate for the missed dose.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE

NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE

It is used in the management of the following progesterone deficiency conditions such as:

Female infertility
Abnormal uterine bleeding
Menopausal disorders
Secondary amenorrhea

mechanismOfAction:
How NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE Works

NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use during breast-feeding. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or drowsy after taking NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE.
NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.

NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients who had or have liver disease and with abnormal liver function test. It should be used with caution in patients with benign liver tumor.
Do not take NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Progesterone.
NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients who had or have blood clot in the lungs (pulmonary embolism). It should be used with caution in patients with asthma.
NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with recent heart attack or chest pain. It should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure.
NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

Others

NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have known or suspected cancer of the breast or womb lining (endometrium)
Have unusual vaginal bleeding
Had or have blood clots in the legs (deep venous thrombosis) or in the veins (thrombosis)
Have bleeding on the brain (cerebral hemorrhage) or stroke
Have blood clotting disorder (like protein C, protein S, or antithrombin deficiency)
Have porphyria (rare genetic blood disorder)

Before taking NATUROGEST 100MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Have problems in your uterus (such as fibroid growths or endometriosis (womb lining growth outside your womb)
Have a history of excessive womb lining growth (endometrial hyperplasia)
Have increased risk of blood clot formation (when you are unable to walk for long time after major surgery, injury or illness, obese and older age)
Have a family history of having breast cancer
Have diabetes
Have gallstones
Have migraine or severe headaches
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an immune system disease that affects many organs of the body)
Have epilepsy (fits)
Have otosclerosis (disease affecting the eardrum and hearing)
Have ever had depression
Have skin sensitivity towards light

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking ISOGEST 100MG SOFTGEL, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Antiepileptics (Ex. carbamazepine, phenytoin, phenobarbital)
Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, rifabutin, ampicillin and tetracyclines such as doxycycline, minocycline)
Anti-HIV infection (Ex. nelfinavir, nevirapine, efavirenz, ritonavir)
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression)
Bromocriptine (a medicine used to stop breast milk production, manage infertility or parkinsonism)
Cyclosporine (a medicine used to manage graft rejection)
Antifungal agents (Ex. griseofulvin, ketoconazole, terbinafine)
Spironolactone (a medicine used to manage fluid retention)
Other progesterone medicines used to manage hormonal problems (such as medroxyprogesterone acetate and megestrol)
Blood thinning medicines (Ex. warfarin, phenindione)
Antidiabetic agents (Ex. glimepiride, metformin)
Ulipristal (a medicine used to manage pregnancy in emergencies)
Tizanidine (a medicine used to manage multiple sclerosis)

B. Drug – Food interactions:

Do not take ISOGEST 100MG SOFTGEL with food as it may increase the bioavailability of this medicine.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of ISOGEST 100MG SOFTGEL, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are dizziness, tiredness, drowsiness or sleepiness.

name: MEGAGEST 200 Softgel 10's
introduction:
Introduction About MEGAGEST 200 SOFTGEL

MEGAGEST 200 SOFTGEL is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking MEGAGEST 200 SOFTGEL inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take MEGAGEST 200 SOFTGEL if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with MEGAGEST 200 SOFTGEL, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

MEGAGEST 200 SOFTGEL may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. MEGAGEST 200 SOFTGEL is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking MEGAGEST 200 SOFTGEL are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEGAGEST 200 SOFTGEL

It is used in the management of the following progesterone deficiency conditions such as:

Female infertility
Abnormal uterine bleeding
Menopausal disorders
Secondary amenorrhea
Supports early stages of pregnancy
Threatened abortions and pre-term delivery
mechanismOfAction:
How MEGAGEST 200 SOFTGEL Works

MEGAGEST 200 SOFTGEL is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.

name: GESTOSERV M Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About GESTOSERV M TABLET

GESTOSERV M TABLET contains Medroxyprogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal medicines. It is used to maintain balance on menstrual cycle and controls abnormal tissue growth in the uterus.

GESTOSERV M TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems, breast cancer, venous thrombosis or arterial thrombosis, porphyria, undiagnosed vaginal bleeding, heart attack or stroke.   

GESTOSERV M TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women as it can affect the developing baby. If you think you are pregnant or planning to have baby or have a history of repeated miscarriage, breastfeeding inform your doctor before taking GESTOSERV M TABLET.

GESTOSERV M TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. The most common side effects of taking GESTOSERV M TABLET are headache, nausea, difficulty sleeping, tiredness and hair loss. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.
uses: Controls abnormal tissue growth in uterus
usesDetails:
Uses Of GESTOSERV M TABLET
Balances menstrual cycle
Controls abnormal tissue growth in uterus
mechanismOfAction:
How GESTOSERV M TABLET Works

GESTOSERV M TABLET works by stopping the production of gonadotropin hormone, which is responsible for maturation of cells in the ovary and the process of releasing mature egg from the ovary (ovulation) to avoid pregnancy. This kind of action also thins the endometrium (uterus lining), which in turn provides relief from unpleasant period symptoms.
usageDetails:
How to use GESTOSERV M TABLET

Take GESTOSERV M TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow GESTOSERV M TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Raised reddish bumps in skin with itching
Fever, tiredness and increase in weight
Excessive hair growth in facial area
Milky discharge from the breast when not pregnant or breastfeeding
Fluid retention in legs and ankles
Severe allergic reaction (signs include wheezing, difficulty breathing, fainting, swelling of the face or tongue, hands and feet, intense itchy skin rash)
Signs of a blood clot in the lungs (sudden, severe, sharp chest pain, coughing up blood, shortness of breath, rapid heartbeat)
Signs of a blood clot in the brain/stroke (unusually severe or long headache, eyesight affected, difficulty in speaking, collapse or faint and any part of your body feels weak or numb)
Signs of a deep-vein thrombosis (severe pain, tenderness or swelling in your calf, ankle or foot, purple discolouration of the skin of the leg or the skin becomes red and warm to touch)
Vomiting, yellowing of the skin, eye or nail beds
Signs of dementia (confusion or memory loss)
Lumps or change in your breasts
Increased amount of fat in the upper back, neck, breast and trunk and loss of fat from the legs, arms and face
Uterine cancer, stroke, heart attack, gallbladder disease, ovarian cancer, high blood pressure and high blood sugar
Enlargement of benign tumors of the uterus

warnings.details: GESTOSERV M TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women as it can affect the developing baby. If you think you are pregnant or planning to have baby or have a history of repeated miscarriage, inform your doctor before taking GESTOSERV M TABLET. Use other methods of contraceptives while taking this medicine.

GESTOSERV M TABLET is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women atleast for 6 weeks after the baby has been born as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine to know whether you should use an alternative method of feeding your baby.
Do not drive or operate machines if you feel dizzy, drowsy or tired while taking GESTOSERV M TABLET.

Introduction About DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET
What is DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET?

DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET contains Dydrogesterone, a well-studied synthetic progesterone. It is often prescribed as part of a hormone support plan for individuals managing menstrual cycle irregularities or undergoing reproductive care. This tablet mimics the action of natural progesterone, contributing to a more stable hormonal profile.

Use DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET exactly as directed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken orally with or without food. Dosage and duration depend on your specific health goals and medical history.

During management with DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET helps support hormonal balance by mimicking the natural actions of progesterone during the second half (luteal phase) of the menstrual cycle. This can assist in regulating the uterine lining and promoting cycle regularity. Women who experience inconsistent cycles, mid-cycle spotting, or other cycle-related issues due to hormonal imbalances may benefit from its regulated use as advised by their healthcare provider.

Before starting DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET, it is important to consult a healthcare professional to evaluate the underlying cause of hormonal changes. Usage in pregnancy, breastfeeding, or with other hormonal therapies should always be discussed in advance. Do not take DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET, if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma).

The most common side effects of taking DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET are severe headache, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET Works
Understanding the Role of Dydrogesterone

DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLETcontains Dydrogesterone, a synthetic form of the natural hormone progesterone. It mimics the hormonal activity needed for cycle regulation and supports the environment needed for hormone-responsive conditions. Unlike some other compounds, Dydrogesterone does not have androgenic or estrogenic effects, making it more selective in its action. This tablet is often used in hormone support strategies where balanced progesterone activity is essential.

Is DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET a natural or synthetic hormone?
DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET contains dydrogesterone, which is a synthetic hormone. It is a synthetic form of the naturally occurring hormone progesterone
How DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET may help with menstrual irregularities?

During a normal menstrual cycle, progesterone levels rise in the second half (luteal phase) to prepare the uterus for possible pregnancy. If pregnancy does not occur, progesterone levels drop, triggering menstruation. When the body does not produce enough progesterone, it can lead to irregular or missed periods, spotting, or cycle-related discomfort.

DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET compensates for this hormonal gap by providing dydrogesterone, which:

Helps maintain the natural rhythm of the menstrual cycle
Supports the uterine lining (endometrium) during the luteal phase
Encourages a predictable withdrawal bleed, simulating a natural period when the tablet is stopped
DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET uses in Pregnancy: 

It is often prescribed during pregnancy to help maintain a healthy pregnancy, particularly in cases where there is a risk of miscarriage or preterm labor due to progesterone deficiency. It supports the uterine lining, making it more favorable for embryo implantation and helps sustain early pregnancy. DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET may also be used in women who have a history of recurrent miscarriages or those undergoing fertility management.

DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET Uses in Menstrual Disorders:

DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET helps balance hormones, reducing the intense uterine contractions that cause pain during menstruation. By reducing the growth of the endometrial tissue that grows outside the uterus, it relieves pain and discomfort associated with endometriosis. DYDROGEST ER 30 TABLET helps stabilize hormone levels, reducing mood swings, bloating, and other symptoms of PMS.

introduction:
Introduction About NAEVA SR 300 TABLET

NAEVA SR 300 TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking NAEVA SR 300 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take NAEVA SR 300 TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with NAEVA SR 300 TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

NAEVA SR 300 TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. NAEVA SR 300 TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking NAEVA SR 300 TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

How NAEVA SR 300 TABLET Works

NAEVA SR 300 TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.

Have unusual vaginal bleeding
Had or have blood clots in the legs (deep venous thrombosis) or in the veins (thrombosis)
Have bleeding on the brain (cerebral hemorrhage) or stroke
Have blood clotting disorder (like protein C, protein S, or antithrombin deficiency)
Have porphyria (rare genetic blood disorder)

Before taking NAEVA SR 300 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have problems in your uterus (such as fibroid growths or endometriosis (womb lining growth outside your womb)
Have a history of excessive womb lining growth (endometrial hyperplasia)
Have increased risk of blood clot formation (when you are unable to walk for long time after major surgery, injury or illness, obese and older age)
Have a family history of having breast cancer
Have diabetes
Have gallstones
Have migraine or severe headaches
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an immune system disease that affects many organs of the body)
Have epilepsy (fits)
Have otosclerosis (disease affecting the eardrum and hearing)
Have ever had depression
Have skin sensitivity towards light
interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking NAEVA SR 300 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Antiepileptics (Ex. carbamazepine, phenytoin, phenobarbital)
Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, rifabutin, ampicillin and tetracyclines such as doxycycline, minocycline)
Anti-HIV infection (Ex. nelfinavir, nevirapine, efavirenz, ritonavir)
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression)
Bromocriptine (a medicine used to stop breast milk production, manage infertility or parkinsonism)
Cyclosporine (a medicine used to manage graft rejection)
Antifungal agents (Ex. griseofulvin, ketoconazole, terbinafine)
Spironolactone (a medicine used to manage fluid retention)
Other progesterone medicines used to manage hormonal problems (such as medroxyprogesterone acetate and megestrol)
Blood thinning medicines (Ex. warfarin, phenindione)
Antidiabetic agents (Ex. glimepiride, metformin)
Ulipristal (a medicine used to manage pregnancy in emergencies)
Tizanidine (a medicine used to manage multiple sclerosis)

B. Drug – Food interactions:

Do not take NAEVA SR 300 TABLET with food as it may increase the bioavailability of this medicine.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of NAEVA SR 300 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are dizziness, tiredness, drowsiness or sleepiness.

name: Estova 2mg Tablet 28'S
introduction:
Introduction About ESTOVA 2MG TABLET

ESTOVA 2MG TABLET contains Estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Estrogens. ESTOVA 2MG TABLET is used in postmenopausal women (with at least 6 months since their last natural period) to provide relief from symptoms that occurs after menopause. It is also used to manage osteoporosis (condition marked by weak and fragile bones) which occurs after menopause in few women.

ESTOVA 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Estradiol. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have/had/suspected of breast/endometrial cancer or thrombosis (blood clot in vein). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who suffer from unusual vaginal bleeding, unmanageed endometrial hyperplasia (excessive thickening of the womb lining), lung disease (such as pulmonary embolism), heart disease (such as heart attack/heart block), and/or liver disease (such as benign liver tumour).

Before taking ESTOVA 2MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have fibroids (non-cancerous growths inside womb), endometriosis (growth of womb lining outside womb)/endometrial hyperplasia (excessive growth of the womb lining), and/or suffer from epilepsy, otosclerosis (disease that affects eardrum and hearing), kidney problems, and/or lung problems (such as asthma).

ESTOVA 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women since it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women. The medicine is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents since it is indicated for use only in postmenopausal women. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly women (aged 60 years and above) after consulting the doctor since the medicine may increase the risk of heart disease in elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking ESTOVA 2MG TABLET are headache, nausea, cramps in legs, abdominal/pelvic pain, unscheduled bleeding/spotting, asthenia (feeling of weakness), and/or rash/itching. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
uses: Provides relief from symptoms that occur after menopause in postmenopausal women
usesDetails:
Uses Of ESTOVA 2MG TABLET
Provides relief from symptoms that occur after menopause in postmenopausal women

mechanismOfAction:
How ESTOVA 2MG TABLET Works

ESTOVA 2MG TABLET contains precursor of ovarian hormones (responsible for menstruation and reproduction in women) which replaces natural Estradiol hormone in the body that helps in maintaining adequate level of circulating hormones thus providing relief from vasomotor symptoms (such as hot flashes) in post-menopausal women.
usageDetails:

Take ESTOVA 2MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Clome 100mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About CLOME 100MG TABLET

CLOME 100MG TABLET contains Clomiphene which belongs to the group of medicines called Ovulation Stimulators. It is used in the management of female infertility. It can promote ovulation (release of matured egg from the ovaries) in women who do not produce eggs and in women undergoing fertility managements.

Prior to the management, your doctor may evaluate your fertility status thoroughly as a precaution. During management with CLOME 100MG TABLET, your doctor will closely monitor your health condition through several blood tests and ultrasounds to avoid the risk of side effects. Before taking CLOME 100MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidney or liver. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, high blood fat levels, unexplained vaginal bleeding, early menopause, cyst in the ovaries or cancer in the breast, uterus or ovaries as a precaution.

CLOME 100MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant women after successful conception. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in children or adolescents (aged below 18 years). The most common side effects of taking CLOME 100MG TABLET are flushing, lower stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, painful periods, heavy bleeding, painful breasts and bloating. Consult your doctor if they worsen.

name: Lupigest 100mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About LUPIGEST 100MG CAPSULE

LUPIGEST 100MG CAPSULE is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking LUPIGEST 100MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take LUPIGEST 100MG CAPSULE if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with LUPIGEST 100MG CAPSULE, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

LUPIGEST 100MG CAPSULE may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. LUPIGEST 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking LUPIGEST 100MG CAPSULE are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. introduction:
Introduction About SUGEST SR 200MG TABLET

SUGEST SR 200MG TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking SUGEST SR 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take SUGEST SR 200MG TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with SUGEST SR 200MG TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

SUGEST SR 200MG TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. SUGEST SR 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking SUGEST SR 200MG TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or drowsy after taking ULTIGEST SR 200MG TABLET.
ULTIGEST SR 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.

ULTIGEST SR 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who had or have liver disease and with abnormal liver function test. It should be used with caution in patients with benign liver tumor.
Do not take ULTIGEST SR 200MG TABLET if you are allergic to Progesterone.
ULTIGEST SR 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who had or have blood clot in the lungs (pulmonary embolism). It should be used with caution in patients with asthma.
ULTIGEST SR 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with recent heart attack or chest pain. It should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure.
ULTIGEST SR 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

Others

ULTIGEST SR 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have known or suspected cancer of the breast or womb lining (endometrium)
Have unusual vaginal bleeding
Had or have blood clots in the legs (deep venous thrombosis) or in the veins (thrombosis)
Have bleeding on the brain (cerebral hemorrhage) or stroke
Have blood clotting disorder (like protein C, protein S, or antithrombin deficiency)
Have porphyria (rare genetic blood disorder)

Before taking ULTIGEST SR 200MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have problems in your uterus (such as fibroid growths or endometriosis (womb lining growth outside your womb)
Have a history of excessive womb lining growth (endometrial hyperplasia)
Have increased risk of blood clot formation (when you are unable to walk for long time after major surgery, injury or illness, obese and older age)
Have a family history of having breast cancer
Have diabetes
Have gallstones
Have migraine or severe headaches
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an immune system disease that affects many organs of the body)
Have epilepsy (fits)
Have otosclerosis (disease affecting the eardrum and hearing)
Have ever had depression
Have skin sensitivity towards light

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking ULTIGEST SR 200MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Antiepileptics (Ex. carbamazepine, phenytoin, phenobarbital)
Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, rifabutin, ampicillin and tetracyclines such as doxycycline, minocycline)
Anti-HIV infection (Ex. nelfinavir, nevirapine, efavirenz, ritonavir)
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression)
Bromocriptine (a medicine used to stop breast milk production, manage infertility or parkinsonism)
Cyclosporine (a medicine used to manage graft rejection)
Antifungal agents (Ex. griseofulvin, ketoconazole, terbinafine)
Spironolactone (a medicine used to manage fluid retention)
Other progesterone medicines used to manage hormonal problems (such as medroxyprogesterone acetate and megestrol)
Blood thinning medicines (Ex. warfarin, phenindione)
Antidiabetic agents (Ex. glimepiride, metformin)
Ulipristal (a medicine used to manage pregnancy in emergencies)
Tizanidine (a medicine used to manage multiple sclerosis)

B. Drug – Food interactions:

Do not take ULTIGEST SR 200MG TABLET with food as it may increase the bioavailability of this medicine.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of ULTIGEST SR 200MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are dizziness, tiredness, drowsiness or sleepiness.

name: Lupi Hmg 150mg Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About LUPI HMG 150MG INJECTION

LUPI HMG 150MG INJECTION contains Menotrophin which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotropins. It is used to manage infertility in both men and women. In women, it helps in egg (ovum) growth and stimulates the release of the matured eggs from the ovaries into the uterus. This helps in managing ovulation problems in women with polycystic ovarian disease (PCOD) especially in those who are not responding appropriately with other medicines (Ex. clomiphene citrate).

It also helps in the growth and development of several egg follicles in women undergoing fertility managements. In men, it improves sperm count and corrects fertility problems.

Before receiving LUPI HMG 150MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have thyroid problems, adrenal gland problems, high blood prolactin levels, fibroids in uterus, any tumours in the breasts, uterus, testes, prostate, pituitary gland or hypothalamus, heavy vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. Your doctor may also ask you to reduce body weight to achieve better results.

You must also inform your doctor if you have any damage in the fallopian tubes, as management with LUPI HMG 150MG INJECTION may cause ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside of the womb) in such cases.

LUPI HMG 150MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of receiving LUPI HMG 150MG INJECTION are stomach pain or swelling, nausea, headache, and injection site reactions (such as pain, redness, and swelling). Consult your doctor if they worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How LUPI HMG 150MG INJECTION Works

LUPI HMG 150MG INJECTION stimulates your body to release sufficient amount of sex hormones (Estrogen and Progesterone in females and Testosterone in males) to maintain normal reproductive functions. In women, it helps in the growth and maturation of the eggs followed by their release from the ovaries into the uterus (ovulation). This improves the chances of pregnancy among women facing difficulties in becoming pregnant. In men, it improves the levels of testosterone (male hormone) which in turn improves sperm count and reduces fertility problems.
usageDetails:
How to use LUPI HMG 150MG INJECTION

LUPI HMG 150MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the muscles (intramuscularly) or under the skin (subcutaneously). It can also be self-administered by the patient if instructed by the doctor. Carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor in case of self-administration.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Are overweight

name: LEEPILL 72 Tablet 1's
introduction:
Introduction About LEEPILL 72 TABLET

LEEPILL 72 TABLET contains Levonorgestrel, which belongs to the group of medicines called Emergency Contraceptives. It is used to manage pregnancy. It is recommended for use by women only in the event of an emergency following an event of unprotected sexual intercourse, or failure of birth control measures. However, it is not recommended for regular usage as a contraceptive.

LEEPILL 72 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems, Crohn’s disease (an inflammatory small bowel disease), a history of ectopic pregnancy (a condition where the baby develops elsewhere outside of the womb), salpingitis (inflammation of the fallopian tubes), thrombosis (blood clotting), or serious digestive problems.

LEEPILL 72 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women, as it does not terminate the pregnancy. LEEPILL 72 TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding mothers as it may pass through breast milk. Avoid nursing your baby for the next 8 hours after taking LEEPILL 72 TABLET and your doctor may also recommend draining the breast milk (before nursing your baby) after taking this medicine. LEEPILL 72 TABLET is not recommended for use by children who have not attained puberty.

The most common side effects of taking LEEPILL 72 TABLET are nausea, irregular bleeding until the next menstrual cycle, lower abdominal pain, tiredness, headache, vomiting, tender breasts, diarrhoea, and feeling dizzy. Contact your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LEEPILL 72 TABLET
To manage pregnancy
mechanismOfAction:
How LEEPILL 72 TABLET Works

LEEPILL 72 TABLET works by managing the release and fertilization (when sperm unite with an egg) or of the egg from the ovary, or by managing the attachment of a fertilized egg to the uterus (implantation).
usageDetails:
How to use LEEPILL 72 TABLET

Take LEEPILL 72 TABLET as advised by your physician. Take LEEPILL 72 TABLET within 72 hours after unprotected sexual intercourse. Swallow the medicine with water and do not crush or chew the medicine.

Introduction About DYDRONIX TABLET
What is DYDRONIX TABLET?

DYDRONIX TABLET contains Dydrogesterone, a well-studied synthetic progesterone. It is often prescribed as part of a hormone support plan for individuals managing menstrual cycle irregularities or undergoing reproductive care. This tablet mimics the action of natural progesterone, contributing to a more stable hormonal profile.

Use DYDRONIX TABLET exactly as directed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken orally with or without food. Dosage and duration depend on your specific health goals and medical history.

During management with DYDRONIX TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

DYDRONIX TABLET helps support hormonal balance by mimicking the natural actions of progesterone during the second half (luteal phase) of the menstrual cycle. This can assist in regulating the uterine lining and promoting cycle regularity. Women who experience inconsistent cycles, mid-cycle spotting, or other cycle-related issues due to hormonal imbalances may benefit from its regulated use as advised by their healthcare provider.

Before starting DYDRONIX TABLET, it is important to consult a healthcare professional to evaluate the underlying cause of hormonal changes. Usage in pregnancy, breastfeeding, or with other hormonal therapies should always be discussed in advance. Do not take DYDRONIX TABLET, if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma).

The most common side effects of taking DYDRONIX TABLET are severe headache, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DYDRONIX TABLET Works
Understanding the Role of Dydrogesterone

DYDRONIX TABLETcontains Dydrogesterone, a synthetic form of the natural hormone progesterone. It mimics the hormonal activity needed for cycle regulation and supports the environment needed for hormone-responsive conditions. Unlike some other compounds, Dydrogesterone does not have androgenic or estrogenic effects, making it more selective in its action. This tablet is often used in hormone support strategies where balanced progesterone activity is essential.

Is DYDRONIX TABLET a natural or synthetic hormone?
DYDRONIX TABLET contains dydrogesterone, which is a synthetic hormone. It is a synthetic form of the naturally occurring hormone progesterone
How DYDRONIX TABLET may help with menstrual irregularities?

During a normal menstrual cycle, progesterone levels rise in the second half (luteal phase) to prepare the uterus for possible pregnancy. If pregnancy does not occur, progesterone levels drop, triggering menstruation. When the body does not produce enough progesterone, it can lead to irregular or missed periods, spotting, or cycle-related discomfort.

DYDRONIX TABLET compensates for this hormonal gap by providing dydrogesterone, which:

Helps maintain the natural rhythm of the menstrual cycle
Supports the uterine lining (endometrium) during the luteal phase
Encourages a predictable withdrawal bleed, simulating a natural period when the tablet is stopped
DYDRONIX TABLET uses in Pregnancy: 

It is often prescribed during pregnancy to help maintain a healthy pregnancy, particularly in cases where there is a risk of miscarriage or preterm labor due to progesterone deficiency. It supports the uterine lining, making it more favorable for embryo implantation and helps sustain early pregnancy. DYDRONIX TABLET may also be used in women who have a history of recurrent miscarriages or those undergoing fertility management.

DYDRONIX TABLET Uses in Menstrual Disorders:

DYDRONIX TABLET helps balance hormones, reducing the intense uterine contractions that cause pain during menstruation. By reducing the growth of the endometrial tissue that grows outside the uterus, it relieves pain and discomfort associated with endometriosis. DYDRONIX TABLET helps stabilize hormone levels, reducing mood swings, bloating, and other symptoms of PMS.

introduction:
Introduction About MICHELLE SR

MICHELLE SR is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking MICHELLE SR inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take MICHELLE SR if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with MICHELLE SR, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

MICHELLE SR may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. MICHELLE SR is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking MICHELLE SR are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

How MICHELLE SR Works

MICHELLE SR is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.

Have blood clotting disorder (like protein C, protein S, or antithrombin deficiency)
Have porphyria (rare genetic blood disorder)

Have diabetes
Have gallstones
Have migraine or severe headaches
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an immune system disease that affects many organs of the body)
Have epilepsy (fits)
Have otosclerosis (disease affecting the eardrum and hearing)
Have ever had depression
Have skin sensitivity towards light

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking MICHELLE SR, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Antiepileptics (Ex. carbamazepine, phenytoin, phenobarbital)
Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, rifabutin, ampicillin and tetracyclines such as doxycycline, minocycline)

faqs.question: Q. Why is DUBAGEST SR 400MG TABLET necessary for pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A. DUBAGEST SR 400MG TABLET supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy. It sustains pregnancy among infertile women and in women who face repeated/threatened abortions by increasing the thickness of uterine wall.

faqs.question: Q. When is progesterone produced in the reproductive cycle?
faqs.answer: A. The typical menstrual cycle takes approximately 28 to 32 days and is divided into three distinct phases namely the follicular phase, the ovulatory phase, and the luteal phase. The luteal phase is the period when the body produces progesterone, the hormone that makes the uterus prepare its lining to receive the egg.

faqs.question: Q. What precautions need to be followed while taking DUBAGEST SR 400MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A. Before taking DUBAGEST SR 400MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, heart problems, blood clots, diabetes, or asthma. Take DUBAGEST SR 400MG TABLET regularly as instructed by the physician without fail. Do not miss a dose of DUBAGEST SR 400MG TABLET to achieve maximum benefits.

faqs.question: Q: What are DUBAGEST SR 400MG TABLET used for?
faqs.answer: A: DUBAGEST SR 400MG TABLET is commonly used in the management of menstrual disorders, support early pregnancy, manage hormone replacement therapy (HRT), and address symptoms of menopause or infertility.

faqs.question: Q: How DUBAGEST SR 400MG TABLET works?
faqs.answer: A: DUBAGEST SR 400MG TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy. It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.

faqs.question: Q: Can progesterone tablets cause weight gain?
faqs.answer: A: Progesterone may cause water retention and bloating, which can lead to temporary weight gain in some individuals.

faqs.question: Q: Can you take progesterone tablets during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, in certain cases, progesterone tablets are prescribed during early pregnancy to support the uterine lining and reduce the risk of miscarriage.

faqs.question: Q: Can progesterone tablets affect mood?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, mood swings or depression can occur as a side effect of progesterone, particularly when hormone levels fluctuate.

faqs.question: Q: How long does it take for progesterone tablets to work?
faqs.answer: A: The effect of progesterone tablets can vary depending on the condition being treated, but some users notice changes within a few days to weeks.

faqs.question: Q: Are there any interactions between progesterone tablets and other medications?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, progesterone can interact with certain medications like antifungals, anticonvulsants, and blood thinners. Always inform your doctor about any medications you're taking.

introduction:
Introduction About CLOMIPURE 50MG CAPSULE

CLOMIPURE 50MG CAPSULE is a combination of Clomiphene Citrate and Melatonin, which belong to the groups of medicines called Ovarian stimulants and Nutraceutical products, respectively. It is used in the management of female infertility, which means not being able to get pregnant after at least one year of trying (or 6 months if the woman is over age 35) or a woman who keeps having miscarriages. It can result from age, physical problems, hormone problems and lifestyle or environmental factors and present as abnormal periods, heavy menstrual bleeding or lighter than usual, irregular periods, the number of days in between each period varying each month, painful periods or periods that suddenly stop.

Before starting CLOMIPURE 50MG CAPSULE, your doctor should check for any other causes of fertility problems. CLOMIPURE 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease, unusual menstrual bleeding where the cause is not known, hormone-dependent cancers or ovarian cysts. Before taking CLOMIPURE 50MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have early menopause or stopped having periods because you are underweight, have uterine fibroids, polycystic ovaries or swollen ovaries, hypertriglyceridemia, epilepsy, autoimmune disease, diabetes or smoking habit.

CLOMIPURE 50MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children, adolescents (below 18 years of age) and post-menopausal women. The common side effects of CLOMIPURE 50MG CAPSULE are flushing, pelvic discomfort or abdominal distention or bloating, nausea and vomiting, painful breasts and headaches. If any of these become worse, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CLOMIPURE 50MG CAPSULE
Used to manage female infertility
mechanismOfAction:
How CLOMIPURE 50MG CAPSULE Works

CLOMIPURE 50MG CAPSULE is a combination of Clomiphene citrate that selectively binds to estrogen hormone receptors in the brain, ovary, endometrium and cervix to increase the secretion of the luteinizing hormone as well as a follicle-stimulating hormone for the release of a mature egg from ovaries and Melatonin improves egg quality by reducing the damage, which in turn leads to higher fertilization rate. This collective action is useful in managing female infertility.

Take CLOMIPURE 50MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. The correct dose and duration for you will be decided by your doctor, depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About PREGCERT SR 300MG TABLET

PREGCERT SR 300MG TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking PREGCERT SR 300MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take PREGCERT SR 300MG TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with PREGCERT SR 300MG TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

PREGCERT SR 300MG TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. PREGCERT SR 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking PREGCERT SR 300MG TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

PREGCERT SR 300MG TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

PREGCERT SR 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with recent heart attack or chest pain. It should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure.
PREGCERT SR 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

Others

PREGCERT SR 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have known or suspected cancer of the breast or womb lining (endometrium)
Have unusual vaginal bleeding
Had or have blood clots in the legs (deep venous thrombosis) or in the veins (thrombosis)
Have bleeding on the brain (cerebral hemorrhage) or stroke
Have blood clotting disorder (like protein C, protein S, or antithrombin deficiency)
Have porphyria (rare genetic blood disorder)

Before taking PREGCERT SR 300MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have problems in your uterus (such as fibroid growths or endometriosis (womb lining growth outside your womb)
Have a history of excessive womb lining growth (endometrial hyperplasia)
Have increased risk of blood clot formation (when you are unable to walk for long time after major surgery, injury or illness, obese and older age)
Have a family history of having breast cancer
Have diabetes
Have gallstones
Have migraine or severe headaches
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an immune system disease that affects many organs of the body)
Have epilepsy (fits)
Have otosclerosis (disease affecting the eardrum and hearing)
Have ever had depression
Have skin sensitivity towards light

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking PREGCERT SR 300MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Antiepileptics (Ex. carbamazepine, phenytoin, phenobarbital)
Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, rifabutin, ampicillin and tetracyclines such as doxycycline, minocycline)
Anti-HIV infection (Ex. nelfinavir, nevirapine, efavirenz, ritonavir)
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression)
Bromocriptine (a medicine used to stop breast milk production, manage infertility or parkinsonism)
Cyclosporine (a medicine used to manage graft rejection)
Antifungal agents (Ex. griseofulvin, ketoconazole, terbinafine)
Spironolactone (a medicine used to manage fluid retention)
Other progesterone medicines used to manage hormonal problems (such as medroxyprogesterone acetate and megestrol)
Blood thinning medicines (Ex. warfarin, phenindione)
Antidiabetic agents (Ex. glimepiride, metformin)
Ulipristal (a medicine used to manage pregnancy in emergencies)
Tizanidine (a medicine used to manage multiple sclerosis)

B. Drug – Food interactions:

Do not take PREGCERT SR 300MG TABLET with food as it may increase the bioavailability of this medicine.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of PREGCERT SR 300MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are dizziness, tiredness, drowsiness or sleepiness.

introduction:
Introduction About SEACURE SR 200MG TABLET

SEACURE SR 200MG TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking SEACURE SR 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take SEACURE SR 200MG TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with SEACURE SR 200MG TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

SEACURE SR 200MG TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. SEACURE SR 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking SEACURE SR 200MG TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

faqs.question: Q. Why is ISOGEST SR 300 TABLET necessary for pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A. ISOGEST SR 300 TABLET supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy. It sustains pregnancy among infertile women and in women who face repeated/threatened abortions by increasing the thickness of uterine wall.

faqs.question: Q. When is progesterone produced in the reproductive cycle?
faqs.answer: A. The typical menstrual cycle takes approximately 28 to 32 days and is divided into three distinct phases namely the follicular phase, the ovulatory phase, and the luteal phase. The luteal phase is the period when the body produces progesterone, the hormone that makes the uterus prepare its lining to receive the egg.

faqs.question: Q. What precautions need to be followed while taking ISOGEST SR 300 TABLET?
faqs.answer: A. Before taking ISOGEST SR 300 TABLET inform your doctor if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, heart problems, blood clots, diabetes, or asthma. Take ISOGEST SR 300 TABLET regularly as instructed by the physician without fail. Do not miss a dose of ISOGEST SR 300 TABLET to achieve maximum benefits.

faqs.question: Q: What are ISOGEST SR 300 TABLET used for?
faqs.answer: A: ISOGEST SR 300 TABLET is commonly used in the management of menstrual disorders, support early pregnancy, manage hormone replacement therapy (HRT), and address symptoms of menopause or infertility.

faqs.question: Q: How ISOGEST SR 300 TABLET works?
faqs.answer: A: ISOGEST SR 300 TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy. It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.

faqs.question: Q: Can progesterone tablets cause weight gain?
faqs.answer: A: Progesterone may cause water retention and bloating, which can lead to temporary weight gain in some individuals.

faqs.question: Q: Can you take progesterone tablets during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, in certain cases, progesterone tablets are prescribed during early pregnancy to support the uterine lining and reduce the risk of miscarriage.

faqs.question: Q: Can progesterone tablets affect mood?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, mood swings or depression can occur as a side effect of progesterone, particularly when hormone levels fluctuate.

faqs.question: Q: How long does it take for progesterone tablets to work?
faqs.answer: A: The effect of progesterone tablets can vary depending on the condition being treated, but some users notice changes within a few days to weeks.

faqs.question: Q: Are there any interactions between progesterone tablets and other medications?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, progesterone can interact with certain medications like antifungals, anticonvulsants, and blood thinners. Always inform your doctor about any medications you're taking.

introduction:
Introduction About DYDROTAB TABLET

DYDROTAB TABLET contains Dydrogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Replacement Therapy. It is used to manage progesterone-deficiency states. It helps to manage problems that occur due to a deficiency of a female sex hormone called progesterone in the body. It helps to relieve period cramps and manage symptoms of endometriosis and premenstrual syndrome in women with progesterone deficiency. It can also be used to manage female reproductive health and is used in postmenopausal women to manage signs of menopause when used in combination with estrogens.

Dydrogesterone is a synthetic derivative of a female sex hormone called progesterone. It supplements the bodies with sufficient levels of progesterone. As a result, it relieves the unpleasant symptoms associated with progesterone deficiencies, such as menstrual pain, premenstrual syndrome, infertility, irregular periods, or signs of menopause. During management with DYDROTAB TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Do not take DYDROTAB TABLET if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma). Before taking DYDROTAB TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems, depression, or porphyria. Consult your doctor before taking DYDROTAB TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. DYDROTAB TABLET should be used with caution in adolescent girls who have attained puberty (aged between 12-18 years).

Inform your doctor if you experience any changes in the breast, such as breast pain, tenderness, discharge from the nipple, lump growth in the breasts, heavy menstrual bleeding, pain, swelling, redness of the legs, sudden chest pain, or difficulty breathing after taking DYDROTAB TABLET. The most common side effects of taking DYDROTAB TABLET are severe headaches, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About GESTONE 50MG INJECTION

GESTONE 50MG INJECTION is used for the maintenance of early pregnancy in patients who faced documented history of repeated miscarriages due to luteal phase defect (a problem in menstrual cycle caused due to deficiency of progesterone during the midway of the menstrual cycle).

It can also be used as an adjuvant to infertility techniques (such as in vitro fertilization (IVF) or gamete intra-fallopian transfer (GIFT)) to facilitate successful implantation of the fertilized egg in the uterus. It is also used to manage threatened abortions and to manage abnormal uterine bleeding caused due to hormonal imbalance.

It can be used as a diagnostic tool in progesterone withdrawal testing to diagnose the endocrinal causes of secondary amenorrhea (irregular or lack of menstrual periods) and to judge the chances of pregnancy among infertile women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before receiving GESTONE 50MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, epilepsy, or migraine headaches before receiving GESTONE 50MG INJECTION as a precaution.

GESTONE 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, ovarian cancer, uterine cancer, blood clot problems or any vaginal infections. GESTONE 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

GESTONE 50MG INJECTION can be used during the first three months of pregnancy. However, it should not be used in women who have ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside the womb) and in women who had a history of idiopathic jaundice (severe itching of the skin) or other skin problems during their earlier pregnancies.

The most common side effects of receiving GESTONE 50MG INJECTION are pain, redness, itching, irritation or swelling at the injection site, vaginal bleeding, headache, bloating, nausea, hair loss, abnormal hair growth in the body, darkening of the facial skin or difficulty in sleeping. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. Talk to your doctor immediately if you experience any changes in body weight or feel depressed while receiving GESTONE 50MG INJECTION.

mechanismOfAction:
How GESTONE 50MG INJECTION Works

GESTONE 50MG INJECTION is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy. It sustains pregnancy among infertile women and in women who face repeated/threatened abortions by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding.
usageInstructions: GESTONE 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse either into the muscles (as intramuscular injection) or under the skin (as subcutaneous injection).
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

faqs.question: Q. Why is GESTOFIT 100MG CAPSULE necessary for pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A. GESTOFIT 100MG CAPSULE supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy. It sustains pregnancy among infertile women and in women who face repeated/threatened abortions by increasing the thickness of uterine wall.

faqs.question: Q. When is progesterone produced in the reproductive cycle?
faqs.answer: A. The typical menstrual cycle takes approximately 28 to 32 days and is divided into three distinct phases namely the follicular phase, the ovulatory phase, and the luteal phase. The luteal phase is the period when the body produces progesterone, the hormone that makes the uterus prepare its lining to receive the egg.

faqs.question: Q. What precautions need to be followed while taking GESTOFIT 100MG CAPSULE?
faqs.answer: A. Before taking GESTOFIT 100MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, heart problems, blood clots, diabetes, or asthma. Take GESTOFIT 100MG CAPSULE regularly as instructed by the physician without fail. Do not miss a dose of GESTOFIT 100MG CAPSULE to achieve maximum benefits.

faqs.question: Q: What are GESTOFIT 100MG CAPSULE used for?
faqs.answer: A: GESTOFIT 100MG CAPSULE is commonly used in the management of menstrual disorders, support early pregnancy, manage hormone replacement therapy (HRT), and address symptoms of menopause or infertility.

faqs.question: Q: How GESTOFIT 100MG CAPSULE works?
faqs.answer: A: GESTOFIT 100MG CAPSULE is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy. It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.

faqs.question: Q: Can progesterone tablets cause weight gain?
faqs.answer: A: Progesterone may cause water retention and bloating, which can lead to temporary weight gain in some individuals.

faqs.question: Q: Can you take progesterone tablets during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, in certain cases, progesterone tablets are prescribed during early pregnancy to support the uterine lining and reduce the risk of miscarriage.

faqs.question: Q: Can progesterone tablets affect mood?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, mood swings or depression can occur as a side effect of progesterone, particularly when hormone levels fluctuate.

faqs.question: Q: How long does it take for progesterone tablets to work?
faqs.answer: A: The effect of progesterone tablets can vary depending on the condition being treated, but some users notice changes within a few days to weeks.

faqs.question: Q: Are there any interactions between progesterone tablets and other medications?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, progesterone can interact with certain medications like antifungals, anticonvulsants, and blood thinners. Always inform your doctor about any medications you're taking.

introduction:
Introduction About STRONE 200MG INJECTION

STRONE 200MG INJECTION is used for the maintenance of early pregnancy in patients who faced documented history of repeated miscarriages due to luteal phase defect (a problem in menstrual cycle caused due to deficiency of progesterone during the midway of the menstrual cycle).

It can also be used as an adjuvant to infertility techniques (such as in vitro fertilization (IVF) or gamete intra-fallopian transfer (GIFT)) to facilitate successful implantation of the fertilized egg in the uterus. It is also used to manage threatened abortions and to manage abnormal uterine bleeding caused due to hormonal imbalance.

It can be used as a diagnostic tool in progesterone withdrawal testing to diagnose the endocrinal causes of secondary amenorrhea (irregular or lack of menstrual periods) and to judge the chances of pregnancy among infertile women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before receiving STRONE 200MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, epilepsy, or migraine headaches before receiving STRONE 200MG INJECTION as a precaution.

STRONE 200MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, ovarian cancer, uterine cancer, blood clot problems or any vaginal infections. STRONE 200MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

STRONE 200MG INJECTION can be used during the first three months of pregnancy. However, it should not be used in women who have ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside the womb) and in women who had a history of idiopathic jaundice (severe itching of the skin) or other skin problems during their earlier pregnancies.

The most common side effects of receiving STRONE 200MG INJECTION are pain, redness, itching, irritation or swelling at the injection site, vaginal bleeding, headache, bloating, nausea, hair loss, abnormal hair growth in the body, darkening of the facial skin or difficulty in sleeping. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. Talk to your doctor immediately if you experience any changes in body weight or feel depressed while receiving STRONE 200MG INJECTION.

introduction:
Introduction About THRIOSHOT DS KIT

THRIOSHOT DS KIT contains a combination of Clomiphene, Acetylcysteine and Astaxanthin which belongs to the group of medicines called Ovulatory stimulant, Mucolytic and Antioxidant respectively. It is used to manage infertility (inability to get pregnant) resulting from ovulatory dysfunction (problems with release of an egg), Polycystic ovary syndrome (hormonal disorder causing infrequent or prolonged menstrual periods).

THRIOSHOT DS KIT is also used to manage infertility due to Amenorrhea-galactorrhea syndrome (characterized by the over-production of breast milk (galactorrhea), lack of ovulation (anovulation) and the absence of regular menstrual periods (amenorrhea) and Psychogenic amenorrhea (absence of menstruation due to hypothalamic dysfunction or stress related). 

THRIOSHOT DS KIT is not recommended for use in patients with bronchial asthma, liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.

THRIOSHOT DS KIT is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

THRIOSHOT DS KIT is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. If you experience any side effects after taking this medicine, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:

To manage infertility resulting from:

Ovulatory dysfunction
Polycystic ovary syndrome
Amenorrhea-galactorrhea syndrome
Psychogenic amenorrhea
mechanismOfAction:
How THRIOSHOT DS KIT Works

THRIOSHOT DS KIT is a combination of Clomiphene, Acetylcysteine and Astaxanthin which helps to manage female infertility where clomiphene helps in the production and development of healthy eggs in women. This improves fertility in women and increases the chance of a successful pregnancy in women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) who experience infertility. Astaxanthin is an antioxidant and reduces damage to egg cells, improves egg quality and thus enhances fertility. Acetylcysteine has some beneficial impacts on endometrial thickness and helps to improve the ovulation and pregnancy rates.
usageDetails:
How to use THRIOSHOT DS KIT

Take THRIOSHOT DS KIT as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PROGEST 100 CAPSULE

PROGEST 100 CAPSULE is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking PROGEST 100 CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take PROGEST 100 CAPSULE if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with PROGEST 100 CAPSULE, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

PROGEST 100 CAPSULE may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. PROGEST 100 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking PROGEST 100 CAPSULE are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
