introduction:
Introduction About EVASTON TABLET
What is EVASTON TABLET?

EVASTON TABLET contains Dydrogesterone, a well-studied synthetic progesterone. It is often prescribed as part of a hormone support plan for individuals managing menstrual cycle irregularities or undergoing reproductive care. This tablet mimics the action of natural progesterone, contributing to a more stable hormonal profile.

Use EVASTON TABLET exactly as directed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken orally with or without food. Dosage and duration depend on your specific health goals and medical history.

During management with EVASTON TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

EVASTON TABLET helps support hormonal balance by mimicking the natural actions of progesterone during the second half (luteal phase) of the menstrual cycle. This can assist in regulating the uterine lining and promoting cycle regularity. Women who experience inconsistent cycles, mid-cycle spotting, or other cycle-related issues due to hormonal imbalances may benefit from its regulated use as advised by their healthcare provider.

Before starting EVASTON TABLET, it is important to consult a healthcare professional to evaluate the underlying cause of hormonal changes. Usage in pregnancy, breastfeeding, or with other hormonal therapies should always be discussed in advance. Do not take EVASTON TABLET, if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma).

The most common side effects of taking EVASTON TABLET are severe headache, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How EVASTON TABLET Works
Understanding the Role of Dydrogesterone

EVASTON TABLETcontains Dydrogesterone, a synthetic form of the natural hormone progesterone. It mimics the hormonal activity needed for cycle regulation and supports the environment needed for hormone-responsive conditions. Unlike some other compounds, Dydrogesterone does not have androgenic or estrogenic effects, making it more selective in its action. This tablet is often used in hormone support strategies where balanced progesterone activity is essential.

Is EVASTON TABLET a natural or synthetic hormone?
EVASTON TABLET contains dydrogesterone, which is a synthetic hormone. It is a synthetic form of the naturally occurring hormone progesterone
How EVASTON TABLET may help with menstrual irregularities?

During a normal menstrual cycle, progesterone levels rise in the second half (luteal phase) to prepare the uterus for possible pregnancy. If pregnancy does not occur, progesterone levels drop, triggering menstruation. When the body does not produce enough progesterone, it can lead to irregular or missed periods, spotting, or cycle-related discomfort.

EVASTON TABLET compensates for this hormonal gap by providing dydrogesterone, which:

Helps maintain the natural rhythm of the menstrual cycle
Supports the uterine lining (endometrium) during the luteal phase
Encourages a predictable withdrawal bleed, simulating a natural period when the tablet is stopped
EVASTON TABLET uses in Pregnancy: 

It is often prescribed during pregnancy to help maintain a healthy pregnancy, particularly in cases where there is a risk of miscarriage or preterm labor due to progesterone deficiency. It supports the uterine lining, making it more favorable for embryo implantation and helps sustain early pregnancy. EVASTON TABLET may also be used in women who have a history of recurrent miscarriages or those undergoing fertility management.

EVASTON TABLET Uses in Menstrual Disorders:

EVASTON TABLET helps balance hormones, reducing the intense uterine contractions that cause pain during menstruation. By reducing the growth of the endometrial tissue that grows outside the uterus, it relieves pain and discomfort associated with endometriosis. EVASTON TABLET helps stabilize hormone levels, reducing mood swings, bloating, and other symptoms of PMS.
usageInstructions: The dosage of EVASTON TABLET varies depending on the purpose and the individual's hormonal support plan
It is commonly taken once or twice daily during the second half of the menstrual cycle (luteal phase), often starting from day 14 to day 25
However, the exact dosage and duration should always follow the instructions provided by a healthcare professional based on clinical assessment
EVASTON TABLET can be taken with or without food. Taking it at the same time every day helps maintain consistent hormone levels in the body
If you experience stomach sensitivity, you may take it with a light meal for comfort
Take it as soon as you remember
If it is nearly time for the next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule
Do not double the dose to make up for a missed one
Always follow the day-specific cycle guidance (e.g., Day 14–25) as advised by your healthcare provider
Swallow the tablet whole with water
Do not crush or chew the medicine
Avoid sudden discontinuation without medical advice, especially if it is part of a phased hormonal plan

introduction:
Introduction About PREGACHIEVE HCG 5000IU INJECTION 1ML

PREGACHIEVE HCG 5000IU INJECTION 1ML contains Chorionic Gonadotropin which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotropins. It is used to manage hypogonadism (deficiency of sex hormones) in men. It also helps in the release of matured ovum (eggs) from the ovaries (ovulation) among infertile women after undergoing premanagement with suitable hormonal medicines (such as menotropins or FSH).

It also helps in sustaining pregnancy during the early stages among women who experience habitual abortions. It can also be used in the management of prepubertal cryptorchidism (failure of testis to descend into the scrotum) caused due to hormone deficiency in young male children (aged between 4-9 years).

During management with PREGACHIEVE HCG 5000IU INJECTION 1ML, your doctor would monitor your health condition through several blood test and ultrasound to avoid the risk of side effects like fluid accumulation, abnormally enlarged ovarian follicles or multiple pregnancies (pregnant with more than one child), especially if you are undergoing assisted reproductive techniques.

Before receiving PREGACHIEVE HCG 5000IU INJECTION 1ML inform your doctor if you have any forms of cancer in the ovaries, uterus, breasts or prostate. You must also inform your doctor if you have any damage in the fallopian tubes, as management with PREGACHIEVE HCG 5000IU INJECTION 1ML may cause ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside of the womb) in such cases.

PREGACHIEVE HCG 5000IU INJECTION 1ML may cause false positive pregnant result in women who take pregnancy test using their blood or urine. This effect may last up to 10 days even after discontinuing management with PREGACHIEVE HCG 5000IU INJECTION 1ML.

PREGACHIEVE HCG 5000IU INJECTION 1ML may be used to sustain pregnancy during the initial stages (luteal phase). However, it should not be used on the later stages of pregnancy. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of PREGACHIEVE HCG 5000IU INJECTION 1ML are reaching puberty at an early age, pain at the injection site, headache and irritability. Consult your doctor if they worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How PREGACHIEVE HCG 5000IU INJECTION 1ML Works

PREGACHIEVE HCG 5000IU INJECTION 1ML is a gonadotrophic hormone which stimulates the production of sex hormones in both men and women. In men, it acts by stimulating the release of androgens which are responsible for the development of secondary sexual characteristics and for regulating the onset of puberty. It also helps to move down the testicles into the scrotum in children having undescended testis.

In women, it triggers the release of matured egg from the ovaries and helps to sustain pregnancy by supplementing enough female sex hormones (estrogen and progesterone) which are required for maintaining a successful conception.

Have tumors in pituitary gland (Ex. Pituitary adenoma) or uterus (fibroids)
Have ovarian cancer, uterine cancer, breast cancer or prostate cancer
Have androgen-dependent neoplasms (any forms of tumors caused due to excessive androgen production)

Have failure of ovaries (due to menopause)
Have failure of testis
Are undergoing any surgical procedures in the female reproductive tract (such as tubal occlusion)
Have signs of reaching puberty at a very early age
Have any blood clot problems (like deep vein thrombosis)
Have malformations of sexual organs
Have prepubertal cryptorchidism caused due to anatomical obstruction
Have abnormal vaginal bleeding

 Before receiving PREGACHIEVE HCG 5000IU INJECTION 1ML, inform your physician if you:

Have or ever had migraine (severe throbbing pain usually on one side of the head)
Have or ever had epilepsy (fits or seizures)
Have damaged fallopian tubes
Are going to have a blood/urine test to detect pregnancy or ovulation

Use in pediatrics:

PREGACHIEVE HCG 5000IU INJECTION 1ML can be used in children aged between 4-9 years. It is not recommended for use in children aged below 4 years due to lack of safety data. However, consult your doctor for advice.

introduction:
Introduction About PROFINE SR 400 TABLET

PROFINE SR 400 TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking PROFINE SR 400 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take PROFINE SR 400 TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with PROFINE SR 400 TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

PROFINE SR 400 TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. PROFINE SR 400 TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking PROFINE SR 400 TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How PROFINE SR 400 TABLET Works

PROFINE SR 400 TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Have known or suspected cancer of the breast or womb lining (endometrium)
Have unusual vaginal bleeding
Had or have blood clots in the legs (deep venous thrombosis) or in the veins (thrombosis)
Have bleeding on the brain (cerebral hemorrhage) or stroke
Have blood clotting disorder (like protein C, protein S, or antithrombin deficiency)
Have porphyria (rare genetic blood disorder)

Have migraine or severe headaches
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an immune system disease that affects many organs of the body)
Have epilepsy (fits)
Have otosclerosis (disease affecting the eardrum and hearing)
Have ever had depression
Have skin sensitivity towards light

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking PROFINE SR 400 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Antiepileptics (Ex. carbamazepine, phenytoin, phenobarbital)
Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, rifabutin, ampicillin and tetracyclines such as doxycycline, minocycline)
Anti-HIV infection (Ex. nelfinavir, nevirapine, efavirenz, ritonavir)
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression)
Bromocriptine (a medicine used to stop breast milk production, manage infertility or parkinsonism)
Cyclosporine (a medicine used to manage graft rejection)
Antifungal agents (Ex. griseofulvin, ketoconazole, terbinafine)
Spironolactone (a medicine used to manage fluid retention)
Other progesterone medicines used to manage hormonal problems (such as medroxyprogesterone acetate and megestrol)
Blood thinning medicines (Ex. warfarin, phenindione)
Antidiabetic agents (Ex. glimepiride, metformin)
Ulipristal (a medicine used to manage pregnancy in emergencies)
Tizanidine (a medicine used to manage multiple sclerosis)

B. Drug – Food interactions:

Do not take PROFINE SR 400 TABLET with food as it may increase the bioavailability of this medicine.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of PROFINE SR 400 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are dizziness, tiredness, drowsiness or sleepiness.

faqs.answer: A. The typical menstrual cycle takes approximately 28 to 32 days and is divided into three distinct phases namely the follicular phase, the ovulatory phase, and the luteal phase. introduction:
Introduction About HCG SP 5000IU INJECTION

HCG SP 5000IU INJECTION contains Chorionic gonadotropin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotropins. It is used to manage hypogonadism (deficiency of sex hormones) in men. It also helps in the release of matured ovum (eggs) from the ovaries (ovulation) among infertile women after undergoing premanagement with suitable hormonal medicines (such as menotropins or FSH).

It also helps in sustaining pregnancy during the early stages among women who experience habitual abortions. It can also be used in the management of prepubertal cryptorchidism (failure of testis to descend into the scrotum) caused by hormone deficiency in young male children (aged between 4 and 9 years).

During management with HCG SP 5000IU INJECTION, your doctor would monitor your health condition through several blood tests and ultrasounds to avoid the risk of side effects like fluid accumulation, abnormally enlarged ovarian follicles, or multiple pregnancies (pregnant with more than one child), especially if you are undergoing assisted reproductive techniques.

Before receiving HCG SP 5000IU INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any forms of cancer in the ovaries, uterus, breasts, or prostate. You must also inform your doctor if you have any damage in the fallopian tubes, as management with HCG SP 5000IU INJECTION may cause ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside of the womb) in such cases.

HCG SP 5000IU INJECTION may cause a false positive pregnancy result in women who take a pregnancy test using their blood or urine. This effect may last up to 10 days even after discontinuing management with HCG SP 5000IU INJECTION.

HCG SP 5000IU INJECTION may be used to sustain pregnancy during the initial stages (luteal phase). However, it should not be used in the later stages of pregnancy. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of HCG SP 5000IU INJECTION are reaching puberty at an early age, pain at the injection site, headaches, and irritability. Consult your doctor if they worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How HCG SP 5000IU INJECTION Works

HCG SP 5000IU INJECTION is a gonadotrophic hormone that stimulates the production of sex hormones in both men and women. In men, it acts by stimulating the release of androgens, which are responsible for the development of secondary sexual characteristics and for regulating the onset of puberty. It also helps to move down the testicles into the scrotum in children having undescended testis.

In women, it triggers the release of mature eggs from the ovaries and helps to sustain pregnancy by supplementing enough female sex hormones (estrogen and progesterone), which are required for maintaining a successful conception.

Introduction About EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET
What is EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET?

EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET contains Dydrogesterone, a well-studied synthetic progesterone. It is often prescribed as part of a hormone support plan for individuals managing menstrual cycle irregularities or undergoing reproductive care. This tablet mimics the action of natural progesterone, contributing to a more stable hormonal profile.

Use EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET exactly as directed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken orally with or without food. Dosage and duration depend on your specific health goals and medical history.

During management with EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET helps support hormonal balance by mimicking the natural actions of progesterone during the second half (luteal phase) of the menstrual cycle. This can assist in regulating the uterine lining and promoting cycle regularity. Women who experience inconsistent cycles, mid-cycle spotting, or other cycle-related issues due to hormonal imbalances may benefit from its regulated use as advised by their healthcare provider.

Before starting EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET, it is important to consult a healthcare professional to evaluate the underlying cause of hormonal changes. Usage in pregnancy, breastfeeding, or with other hormonal therapies should always be discussed in advance. Do not take EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET, if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma).

The most common side effects of taking EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET are severe headache, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET Works
Understanding the Role of Dydrogesterone

EVASTON OD 30MG TABLETcontains Dydrogesterone, a synthetic form of the natural hormone progesterone. It mimics the hormonal activity needed for cycle regulation and supports the environment needed for hormone-responsive conditions. Unlike some other compounds, Dydrogesterone does not have androgenic or estrogenic effects, making it more selective in its action. This tablet is often used in hormone support strategies where balanced progesterone activity is essential.

Is EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET a natural or synthetic hormone?
EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET contains dydrogesterone, which is a synthetic hormone. It is a synthetic form of the naturally occurring hormone progesterone
How EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET may help with menstrual irregularities?

During a normal menstrual cycle, progesterone levels rise in the second half (luteal phase) to prepare the uterus for possible pregnancy. If pregnancy does not occur, progesterone levels drop, triggering menstruation. When the body does not produce enough progesterone, it can lead to irregular or missed periods, spotting, or cycle-related discomfort.

EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET compensates for this hormonal gap by providing dydrogesterone, which:

Helps maintain the natural rhythm of the menstrual cycle
Supports the uterine lining (endometrium) during the luteal phase
Encourages a predictable withdrawal bleed, simulating a natural period when the tablet is stopped
EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET uses in Pregnancy: 

It is often prescribed during pregnancy to help maintain a healthy pregnancy, particularly in cases where there is a risk of miscarriage or preterm labor due to progesterone deficiency. It supports the uterine lining, making it more favorable for embryo implantation and helps sustain early pregnancy. EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET may also be used in women who have a history of recurrent miscarriages or those undergoing fertility management.

EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET Uses in Menstrual Disorders:

EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET helps balance hormones, reducing the intense uterine contractions that cause pain during menstruation. By reducing the growth of the endometrial tissue that grows outside the uterus, it relieves pain and discomfort associated with endometriosis. EVASTON OD 30MG TABLET helps stabilize hormone levels, reducing mood swings, bloating, and other symptoms of PMS.

introduction:
Introduction About UTREVA 400MG CAPSULE

UTREVA 400MG CAPSULE is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking UTREVA 400MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take UTREVA 400MG CAPSULE if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with UTREVA 400MG CAPSULE, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

UTREVA 400MG CAPSULE may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. UTREVA 400MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking UTREVA 400MG CAPSULE are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

How UTREVA 400MG CAPSULE Works

UTREVA 400MG CAPSULE is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.

Have unusual vaginal bleeding
Had or have blood clots in the legs (deep venous thrombosis) or in the veins (thrombosis)
Have bleeding on the brain (cerebral hemorrhage) or stroke
Have blood clotting disorder (like protein C, protein S, or antithrombin deficiency)
Have porphyria (rare genetic blood disorder)

Have diabetes
Have gallstones
Have migraine or severe headaches
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an immune system disease that affects many organs of the body)
Have epilepsy (fits)
Have otosclerosis (disease affecting the eardrum and hearing)
Have ever had depression
Have skin sensitivity towards light

What is ZYDRO 20 SR TABLET?

ZYDRO 20 SR TABLET contains Dydrogesterone, a well-studied synthetic progesterone. It is often prescribed as part of a hormone support plan for individuals managing menstrual cycle irregularities or undergoing reproductive care. Use ZYDRO 20 SR TABLET exactly as directed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken orally with or without food. Dosage and duration depend on your specific health goals and medical history.

During management with ZYDRO 20 SR TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

ZYDRO 20 SR TABLET helps support hormonal balance by mimicking the natural actions of progesterone during the second half (luteal phase) of the menstrual cycle. This can assist in regulating the uterine lining and promoting cycle regularity. Women who experience inconsistent cycles, mid-cycle spotting, or other cycle-related issues due to hormonal imbalances may benefit from its regulated use as advised by their healthcare provider.

Before starting ZYDRO 20 SR TABLET, it is important to consult a healthcare professional to evaluate the underlying cause of hormonal changes. Do not take ZYDRO 20 SR TABLET, if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma).

mechanismOfAction:
How ZYDRO 20 SR TABLET Works
Understanding the Role of Dydrogesterone

ZYDRO 20 SR TABLETcontains Dydrogesterone, a synthetic form of the natural hormone progesterone. It mimics the hormonal activity needed for cycle regulation and supports the environment needed for hormone-responsive conditions. Unlike some other compounds, Dydrogesterone does not have androgenic or estrogenic effects, making it more selective in its action. This tablet is often used in hormone support strategies where balanced progesterone activity is essential.

Is ZYDRO 20 SR TABLET a natural or synthetic hormone?
ZYDRO 20 SR TABLET contains dydrogesterone, which is a synthetic hormone. It is a synthetic form of the naturally occurring hormone progesterone
How ZYDRO 20 SR TABLET may help with menstrual irregularities?

During a normal menstrual cycle, progesterone levels rise in the second half (luteal phase) to prepare the uterus for possible pregnancy. If pregnancy does not occur, progesterone levels drop, triggering menstruation. When the body does not produce enough progesterone, it can lead to irregular or missed periods, spotting, or cycle-related discomfort.

ZYDRO 20 SR TABLET compensates for this hormonal gap by providing dydrogesterone, which:

Helps maintain the natural rhythm of the menstrual cycle
Supports the uterine lining (endometrium) during the luteal phase
Encourages a predictable withdrawal bleed, simulating a natural period when the tablet is stopped
ZYDRO 20 SR TABLET uses in Pregnancy: 

It is often prescribed during pregnancy to help maintain a healthy pregnancy, particularly in cases where there is a risk of miscarriage or preterm labor due to progesterone deficiency. It supports the uterine lining, making it more favorable for embryo implantation and helps sustain early pregnancy. ZYDRO 20 SR TABLET may also be used in women who have a history of recurrent miscarriages or those undergoing fertility management.

ZYDRO 20 SR TABLET Uses in Menstrual Disorders:

ZYDRO 20 SR TABLET helps balance hormones, reducing the intense uterine contractions that cause pain during menstruation. By reducing the growth of the endometrial tissue that grows outside the uterus, it relieves pain and discomfort associated with endometriosis. ZYDRO 20 SR TABLET helps stabilize hormone levels, reducing mood swings, bloating, and other symptoms of PMS.

ZYDRO 20 SR TABLET can be taken with or without food. Taking it at the same time every day helps maintain consistent hormone levels in the body
If you experience stomach sensitivity, you may take it with a light meal for comfort
Take it as soon as you remember
If it is nearly time for the next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule
Do not double the dose to make up for a missed one
Always follow the day-specific cycle guidance (e.g., Day 14–25) as advised by your healthcare provider
Swallow the tablet whole with water
Do not crush or chew the medicine
Avoid sudden discontinuation without medical advice, especially if it is part of a phased hormonal plan

introduction:
Introduction About EEMA HP AQ 5000 INJECTION

EEMA HP AQ 5000 INJECTION contains Chorionic gonadotropin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotropins. It is used to manage hypogonadism (deficiency of sex hormones) in men. It also helps in the release of matured ovum (eggs) from the ovaries (ovulation) among infertile women after undergoing premanagement with suitable hormonal medicines (such as menotropins or FSH).

It also helps in sustaining pregnancy during the early stages among women who experience habitual abortions. It can also be used in the management of prepubertal cryptorchidism (failure of testis to descend into the scrotum) caused by hormone deficiency in young male children (aged between 4 and 9 years).

During management with EEMA HP AQ 5000 INJECTION, your doctor would monitor your health condition through several blood tests and ultrasounds to avoid the risk of side effects like fluid accumulation, abnormally enlarged ovarian follicles, or multiple pregnancies (pregnant with more than one child), especially if you are undergoing assisted reproductive techniques.

Before receiving EEMA HP AQ 5000 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any forms of cancer in the ovaries, uterus, breasts, or prostate. You must also inform your doctor if you have any damage in the fallopian tubes, as management with EEMA HP AQ 5000 INJECTION may cause ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside of the womb) in such cases.

EEMA HP AQ 5000 INJECTION may cause a false positive pregnancy result in women who take a pregnancy test using their blood or urine. This effect may last up to 10 days even after discontinuing management with EEMA HP AQ 5000 INJECTION.

EEMA HP AQ 5000 INJECTION may be used to sustain pregnancy during the initial stages (luteal phase). However, it should not be used in the later stages of pregnancy. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of EEMA HP AQ 5000 INJECTION are reaching puberty at an early age, pain at the injection site, headaches, and irritability. Consult your doctor if they worsen.

Others

EEMA HP AQ 5000 INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have tumors in the pituitary gland (Ex. pituitary adenoma) or uterus (fibroids)
Have ovarian cancer, uterine cancer, breast cancer, or prostate cancer
Have androgen-dependent neoplasms (any forms of tumors caused by excessive androgen production)
Have any type of uncontrolled hormonal disorders (Ex. dysfunction of thyroid gland, pituitary gland, or adrenal glands)
Have failure of ovaries (due to menopause)
Have failure of testis
Are undergoing any surgical procedures in the female reproductive tract (such as tubal occlusion)
Have signs of reaching puberty at a very early age
Have any blood clot problems (like deep vein thrombosis)
Have malformations of sexual organs
Have prepubertal cryptorchidism caused by anatomical obstruction
Have abnormal vaginal bleeding

Before receiving EEMA HP AQ 5000 INJECTION, inform your physician if you:

Have or ever had migraine (severe throbbing pain usually on one side of the head)
Have or ever had epilepsy (fits or seizures)
Have damaged fallopian tubes
Are going to have a blood/urine test to detect pregnancy or ovulation

name: NiEL 72 Tablet 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About NIEL 72 TABLET

NIEL 72 TABLET contains Levonorgestrel, which belongs to the group of medicines called Emergency Contraceptives. It is used to manage pregnancy. It is recommended for use by women only in the event of an emergency following an event of unprotected sexual intercourse, or failure of birth control measures. However, it is not recommended for regular usage as a contraceptive.

NIEL 72 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems, Crohn’s disease (an inflammatory small bowel disease), a history of ectopic pregnancy (a condition where the baby develops elsewhere outside of the womb), salpingitis (inflammation of the fallopian tubes), thrombosis (blood clotting), or serious digestive problems.

NIEL 72 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women, as it does not terminate the pregnancy. NIEL 72 TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding mothers as it may pass through breast milk. Avoid nursing your baby for the next 8 hours after taking NIEL 72 TABLET and your doctor may also recommend draining the breast milk (before nursing your baby) after taking this medicine. NIEL 72 TABLET is not recommended for use by children who have not attained puberty.

The most common side effects of taking NIEL 72 TABLET are nausea, irregular bleeding until the next menstrual cycle, lower abdominal pain, tiredness, headache, vomiting, tender breasts, diarrhoea, and feeling dizzy. Contact your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIEL 72 TABLET
To manage pregnancy
mechanismOfAction:
How NIEL 72 TABLET Works

NIEL 72 TABLET works by managing the release and fertilization (when sperm unite with an egg) or of the egg from the ovary, or by managing the attachment of a fertilized egg to the uterus (implantation).
usageDetails:
How to use NIEL 72 TABLET

Take NIEL 72 TABLET as advised by your physician. Take NIEL 72 TABLET within 72 hours after unprotected sexual intercourse. Swallow the medicine with water and do not crush or chew the medicine.

name: Optogest 100mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET

OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET

It is used in the management of the following progesterone deficiency conditions such as:

Female infertility
Abnormal uterine bleeding
Menopausal disorders
Secondary amenorrhea
Supports early stages of pregnancy
Threatened abortions and pre-term delivery
mechanismOfAction:
How OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET Works

OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.
usageInstructions: Always take the medicine as prescribed by your doctor.
It can often be taken with or without food, but if you experience nausea, taking it with food may help.
Try to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent hormone levels.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it's almost time for your next dose.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use during breast-feeding. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or drowsy after taking OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET.
OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.
OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who had or have liver disease and with abnormal liver function test. It should be used with caution in patients with benign liver tumor.
Do not take OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET if you are allergic to Progesterone.
OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who had or have blood clot in the lungs (pulmonary embolism). It should be used with caution in patients with asthma.
OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with recent heart attack or chest pain. It should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure.
OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

Others

OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have known or suspected cancer of the breast or womb lining (endometrium)
Have unusual vaginal bleeding
Had or have blood clots in the legs (deep venous thrombosis) or in the veins (thrombosis)
Have bleeding on the brain (cerebral hemorrhage) or stroke
Have blood clotting disorder (like protein C, protein S, or antithrombin deficiency)
Have porphyria (rare genetic blood disorder)

Before taking OPTOGEST 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have problems in your uterus (such as fibroid growths or endometriosis (womb lining growth outside your womb)
Have a history of excessive womb lining growth (endometrial hyperplasia)
Have increased risk of blood clot formation (when you are unable to walk for long time after major surgery, injury or illness, obese and older age)
Have a family history of having breast cancer
Have diabetes
Have gallstones
Have migraine or severe headaches
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an immune system disease that affects many organs of the body)
Have epilepsy (fits)
Have otosclerosis (disease affecting the eardrum and hearing)
Have ever had depression
Have skin sensitivity towards light

name: Rejun 25mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About REJUN 25MG TABLET

REJUN 25MG TABLET contains Clomiphene which belongs to the group of medicines called Ovulation Stimulators. It is used in the management of female infertility. It can promote ovulation (release of matured egg from the ovaries) in women who do not produce eggs and in women undergoing fertility managements.

Prior to the management, your doctor may evaluate your fertility status thoroughly as a precaution. During management with REJUN 25MG TABLET, your doctor will closely monitor your health condition through several blood tests and ultrasounds to avoid the risk of side effects.

Before taking REJUN 25MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidney or liver. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, high blood fat levels, unexplained vaginal bleeding, early menopause, cyst in the ovaries or cancer in the breast, uterus or ovaries as a precaution.

REJUN 25MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant women after successful conception. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in children or adolescents (aged below 18 years).

The most common side effects of taking REJUN 25MG TABLET are flushing, lower stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, painful periods, heavy bleeding, painful breasts and bloating. Consult your doctor if they worsen.

Introduction About DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET
What is DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET?

DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET contains Dydrogesterone, a well-studied synthetic progesterone. It is often prescribed as part of a hormone support plan for individuals managing menstrual cycle irregularities or undergoing reproductive care. This tablet mimics the action of natural progesterone, contributing to a more stable hormonal profile.

Use DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET exactly as directed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken orally with or without food. Dosage and duration depend on your specific health goals and medical history.

During management with DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET helps support hormonal balance by mimicking the natural actions of progesterone during the second half (luteal phase) of the menstrual cycle. This can assist in regulating the uterine lining and promoting cycle regularity. Women who experience inconsistent cycles, mid-cycle spotting, or other cycle-related issues due to hormonal imbalances may benefit from its regulated use as advised by their healthcare provider.

Before starting DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET, it is important to consult a healthcare professional to evaluate the underlying cause of hormonal changes. Usage in pregnancy, breastfeeding, or with other hormonal therapies should always be discussed in advance. Do not take DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET, if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma).

The most common side effects of taking DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET are severe headache, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET Works
Understanding the Role of Dydrogesterone

DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLETcontains Dydrogesterone, a synthetic form of the natural hormone progesterone. It mimics the hormonal activity needed for cycle regulation and supports the environment needed for hormone-responsive conditions. Unlike some other compounds, Dydrogesterone does not have androgenic or estrogenic effects, making it more selective in its action. This tablet is often used in hormone support strategies where balanced progesterone activity is essential.

Is DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET a natural or synthetic hormone?
DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET contains dydrogesterone, which is a synthetic hormone. It is a synthetic form of the naturally occurring hormone progesterone
How DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET may help with menstrual irregularities?

During a normal menstrual cycle, progesterone levels rise in the second half (luteal phase) to prepare the uterus for possible pregnancy. If pregnancy does not occur, progesterone levels drop, triggering menstruation. When the body does not produce enough progesterone, it can lead to irregular or missed periods, spotting, or cycle-related discomfort.

DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET compensates for this hormonal gap by providing dydrogesterone, which:

Helps maintain the natural rhythm of the menstrual cycle
Supports the uterine lining (endometrium) during the luteal phase
Encourages a predictable withdrawal bleed, simulating a natural period when the tablet is stopped
DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET uses in Pregnancy: 

It is often prescribed during pregnancy to help maintain a healthy pregnancy, particularly in cases where there is a risk of miscarriage or preterm labor due to progesterone deficiency. It supports the uterine lining, making it more favorable for embryo implantation and helps sustain early pregnancy. DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET may also be used in women who have a history of recurrent miscarriages or those undergoing fertility management.

DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET Uses in Menstrual Disorders:

DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET helps balance hormones, reducing the intense uterine contractions that cause pain during menstruation. By reducing the growth of the endometrial tissue that grows outside the uterus, it relieves pain and discomfort associated with endometriosis. DUPHASTON OD 20 TABLET helps stabilize hormone levels, reducing mood swings, bloating, and other symptoms of PMS.

name: PROGEST SR 300 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About PROGEST SR 300 TABLET

PROGEST SR 300 TABLET is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking PROGEST SR 300 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take PROGEST SR 300 TABLET if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with PROGEST SR 300 TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

PROGEST SR 300 TABLET may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. PROGEST SR 300 TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking PROGEST SR 300 TABLET are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How PROGEST SR 300 TABLET Works

PROGEST SR 300 TABLET is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy.

It sustains pregnancy among infertile women by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding and other menstrual problems caused due to incorrect levels of progesterone in the body.

Others

PROGEST SR 300 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have known or suspected cancer of the breast or womb lining (endometrium)
Have unusual vaginal bleeding
Had or have blood clots in the legs (deep venous thrombosis) or in the veins (thrombosis)
Have bleeding on the brain (cerebral hemorrhage) or stroke
Have blood clotting disorder (like protein C, protein S, or antithrombin deficiency)
Have porphyria (rare genetic blood disorder)

Before taking PROGEST SR 300 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have problems in your uterus (such as fibroid growths or endometriosis (womb lining growth outside your womb)
Have a history of excessive womb lining growth (endometrial hyperplasia)
Have increased risk of blood clot formation (when you are unable to walk for long time after major surgery, injury or illness, obese and older age)
Have a family history of having breast cancer
Have diabetes
Have gallstones
Have migraine or severe headaches
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an immune system disease that affects many organs of the body)
Have epilepsy (fits)
Have otosclerosis (disease affecting the eardrum and hearing)
Have ever had depression
Have skin sensitivity towards light

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of PROGEST SR 300 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are dizziness, tiredness, drowsiness or sleepiness.

introduction:
Introduction About FULTERM 5MG TABLET

FULTERM 5MG TABLET contains Allylestrenol which belongs to group of medicines called Progestogens. It is used to manage intrauterine growth retardation (growth of the foetus is lesser than its normal growth rate), threatened abortion (vaginal bleeding at less than 20 weeks of gestation), and threatened premature delivery (onset of labor between 24 and 37 weeks of pregnancy) in affected women.

FULTERM 5MG TABLET is also used to manage habitual abortion. Habitual abortion is a condition that occurs due to sequential loss of three or more pre-viable pregnancies in affected women which is generally characterized by symptoms such as crampy pelvic pain, and bleeding.

FULTERM 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with thrombophlebitis (blood clot in vein), undiagnosed vaginal bleeding, incomplete abortion, stroke, and/or severe hepatic impairment.

Before taking FULTERM 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have lung, kidney, or heart disease, epilepsy, seizures, or migraine.

FULTERM 5MG TABLET can be taken during pregnancy. Consult with your doctor before taking. FULTERM 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. This medicine is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 16 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking FULTERM 5MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting or stomach discomfort. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

How FULTERM 5MG TABLET Works

FULTERM 5MG TABLET works by promoting the attachment of embryo to the lining of the womb which also improves blood flow to the placenta thus relaxing the uterus muscles and managing the occurrence of premature labor in affected women.

Take FULTERM 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition

name: STIMUNINE 150iu Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About STIMUNINE 150IU INJECTION

STIMUNINE 150IU INJECTION contains Urofollitropin which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotropins. It helps your body produce sufficient levels of female sex hormones (estrogen) that is required for conception.

Prior to the management, your doctor may evaluate your and your partner’s fertility status thoroughly as a precaution. During management with STIMUNINE 150IU INJECTION, your doctor will closely monitor your health condition through several blood tests and ultrasounds to avoid the risk of side effects.

Before receiving STIMUNINE 150IU INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any unexplained vaginal bleeding, blood clot problems or any tumours in the brain, breast, uterus or ovaries. You must also inform your doctor if you have any damage in the fallopian tubes, as management with STIMUNINE 150IU INJECTION may cause ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside of the womb) in such cases.

STIMUNINE 150IU INJECTION should not be used in pregnant women after successful conception. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in children or adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data.

The most common side effects of receiving STIMUNINE 150IU INJECTION are hot flushes, stomach pain, headache and injection site reactions (such as pain, redness, and swelling). Consult your doctor if they worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of STIMUNINE 150IU INJECTION
Supports reproductive health in women
mechanismOfAction:
How STIMUNINE 150IU INJECTION Works

STIMUNINE 150IU INJECTION supplements your body with a sufficient levels of a female sex hormone called estrogen that is required to maintain proper functioning of female genital system.
usageDetails:
How to use STIMUNINE 150IU INJECTION

STIMUNINE 150IU INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the muscles (intramuscularly) or under the skin (subcutaneously). It can also be self-administered by the patient if instructed by the doctor. Carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor in case of self-administration.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Mensil N Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MENSIL N TABLET

MENSIL N TABLET contains Norethisterone, which belongs to a group of medicines called Progestogens. It is used to manage heavy menstrual bleeding or abnormal uterine bleeding (that occurs due to hormonal imbalance), painful periods, irregular periods or periods that are more frequent than normal (polymenorrhoea), premenstrual tension, endometriosis (abnormal growth of endometrial tissue of the uterus that causes pain and menstrual irregularities), metriopatheias haemorrhagia (intermenstrual bleeding) and breast cancer. It is also used to delay the menstrual cycle.

MENSIL N TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pulmonary embolism (blood clots in the lung), liver disease, heart attack (myocardial infarction) or angina and deep vein thrombosis. MENSIL N TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma, kidney disease, fits, and migraine headaches.

MENSIL N TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy as it may affect the developing baby. Inform your doctor if you have had repeated miscarriages. MENSIL N TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. If you experience mood changes and depressive symptoms, contact your doctor as soon as possible.

The most common side effects of taking MENSIL N TABLET are irregular bleeding, heavy menstruation, spotting between menstrual cycles, delayed or not having a menstrual cycle, stomach discomfort, nausea, vomiting, breast tenderness, headache, and dizziness. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen

mechanismOfAction:
How MENSIL N TABLET Works

MENSIL N TABLET inhibits the release of pituitary hormones that are responsible for the release of female hormones (such as oestrogen and progesterone) and thereby suppressing ovulation. This action modifies the lining of the endometrium and thus ceases bleeding in menstrual abnormalities in cancer MENSIL N TABLET may act by pituitary inhibition or by direct action on tumour deposits.

introduction:
Introduction About GESTONE 100MG INJECTION

GESTONE 100MG INJECTION is used for the maintenance of early pregnancy in patients who faced documented history of repeated miscarriages due to luteal phase defect (a problem in menstrual cycle caused due to deficiency of progesterone during the midway of the menstrual cycle).

It can also be used as an adjuvant to infertility techniques (such as in vitro fertilization (IVF) or gamete intra-fallopian transfer (GIFT)) to facilitate successful implantation of the fertilized egg in the uterus. It is also used to manage threatened abortions and to manage abnormal uterine bleeding caused due to hormonal imbalance.

It can be used as a diagnostic tool in progesterone withdrawal testing to diagnose the endocrinal causes of secondary amenorrhea (irregular or lack of menstrual periods) and to judge the chances of pregnancy among infertile women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before receiving GESTONE 100MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, epilepsy, or migraine headaches before receiving GESTONE 100MG INJECTION as a precaution.

GESTONE 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with breast cancer, ovarian cancer, uterine cancer, blood clot problems or any vaginal infections. GESTONE 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

GESTONE 100MG INJECTION can be used during the first three months of pregnancy. However, it should not be used in women who have ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside the womb) and in women who had a history of idiopathic jaundice (severe itching of the skin) or other skin problems during their earlier pregnancies.

The most common side effects of receiving GESTONE 100MG INJECTION are pain, redness, itching, irritation or swelling at the injection site, vaginal bleeding, headache, bloating, nausea, hair loss, abnormal hair growth in the body, darkening of the facial skin or difficulty in sleeping. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. Talk to your doctor immediately if you experience any changes in body weight or feel depressed while receiving GESTONE 100MG INJECTION.

How GESTONE 100MG INJECTION Works

GESTONE 100MG INJECTION is a steroid hormone used to manage progesterone deficiency in the body. It supplements your body with sufficient levels of progesterone that is required for a successful implantation of fertilized egg in the uterus and for the maintenance of an early pregnancy. It sustains pregnancy among infertile women and in women who face repeated/threatened abortions by increasing the thickness of uterine wall. It also regulates hormonal balance in the body and corrects abnormal uterine bleeding.

introduction:
Introduction About ESTOFOL 2MG TABLET

ESTOFOL 2MG TABLET contains Estradiol which belongs to the group of medicines called Estrogens. ESTOFOL 2MG TABLET is used in postmenopausal women (with at least 6 months since their last natural period) to provide relief from symptoms that occurs after menopause. It is also used to manage osteoporosis (condition marked by weak and fragile bones) which occurs after menopause in few women.

ESTOFOL 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Estradiol. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have/had/suspected of breast/endometrial cancer or thrombosis (blood clot in vein). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who suffer from unusual vaginal bleeding, unmanageed endometrial hyperplasia (excessive thickening of the womb lining), lung disease (such as pulmonary embolism), heart disease (such as heart attack/heart block), and/or liver disease (such as benign liver tumour).

Before taking ESTOFOL 2MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have fibroids (non-cancerous growths inside womb), endometriosis (growth of womb lining outside womb)/endometrial hyperplasia (excessive growth of the womb lining), and/or suffer from epilepsy, otosclerosis (disease that affects eardrum and hearing), kidney problems, and/or lung problems (such as asthma).

ESTOFOL 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women since it is intended to be used only in postmenopausal women. The medicine is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents since it is indicated for use only in postmenopausal women. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly women (aged 60 years and above) after consulting the doctor since the medicine may increase the risk of heart disease in elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking ESTOFOL 2MG TABLET are headache, nausea, cramps in legs, abdominal/pelvic pain, unscheduled bleeding/spotting, asthenia (feeling of weakness), and/or rash/itching. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About FSHSP 150IU INJECTION

FSHSP 150IU INJECTION contains Urofollitropin which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotropins. It helps your body produce sufficient levels of female sex hormones (estrogen) that is required for conception.

Prior to the management, your doctor may evaluate your and your partner’s fertility status thoroughly as a precaution. During management with FSHSP 150IU INJECTION, your doctor will closely monitor your health condition through several blood tests and ultrasounds to avoid the risk of side effects.

Before receiving FSHSP 150IU INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any unexplained vaginal bleeding, blood clot problems or any tumours in the brain, breast, uterus or ovaries. You must also inform your doctor if you have any damage in the fallopian tubes, as management with FSHSP 150IU INJECTION may cause ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside of the womb) in such cases.

FSHSP 150IU INJECTION should not be used in pregnant women after successful conception. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in children or adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data.

The most common side effects of receiving FSHSP 150IU INJECTION are hot flushes, stomach pain, headache and injection site reactions (such as pain, redness, and swelling). Consult your doctor if they worsen.

Supports reproductive health in women
mechanismOfAction:
How FSHSP 150IU INJECTION Works

FSHSP 150IU INJECTION supplements your body with a sufficient levels of a female sex hormone called estrogen that is required to maintain proper functioning of female genital system.
usageDetails:
How to use FSHSP 150IU INJECTION

FSHSP 150IU INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the muscles (intramuscularly) or under the skin (subcutaneously). It can also be self-administered by the patient if instructed by the doctor. Carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor in case of self-administration.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MEGEST 10MG TABLET

MEGEST 10MG TABLET contains Medroxyprogesterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal medicines. It is used to maintain balance on menstrual cycle and controls abnormal tissue growth in the uterus.

MEGEST 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems, breast cancer, venous thrombosis or arterial thrombosis, porphyria, undiagnosed vaginal bleeding, heart attack or stroke.   

MEGEST 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women as it can affect the developing baby. If you think you are pregnant or planning to have baby or have a history of repeated miscarriage, breastfeeding inform your doctor before taking MEGEST 10MG TABLET.

MEGEST 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. The most common side effects of taking MEGEST 10MG TABLET are headache, nausea, difficulty sleeping, tiredness and hair loss. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.
uses: Controls abnormal tissue growth in uterus
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEGEST 10MG TABLET
Balances menstrual cycle
Controls abnormal tissue growth in uterus
mechanismOfAction:
How MEGEST 10MG TABLET Works

MEGEST 10MG TABLET works by stopping the production of gonadotropin hormone, which is responsible for maturation of cells in the ovary and the process of releasing mature egg from the ovary (ovulation) to avoid pregnancy. This kind of action also thins the endometrium (uterus lining), which in turn provides relief from unpleasant period symptoms.
usageDetails:
How to use MEGEST 10MG TABLET

Take MEGEST 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow MEGEST 10MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CRINONE 8% GEL

CRINONE 8% GEL is a vaginal gel used in females to manage female infertility due to incorrect levels of progesterone during the menstrual cycle or when you are having an assisted fertility procedure.

It contains a medicine called Progesterone which is a synthetic female hormone. When the gel is inserted into your vagina, the progesterone will slowly release into your bloodstream throughout the day which mimics the actions of natural progesterone produced in your body.

CRINONE 8% GEL is for vaginal use only. Gently insert the gel using the applicator into the vagina. Wash your hands before and after application. Before using this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems, asthma, diabetes, epilepsy, unexplained vaginal bleeding, migraine or history of depression as a precaution.

CRINONE 8% GEL is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. It is normally not suggested during pregnancy, unless you have used this medicine to help become pregnancy. The most common side effects of using CRINONE 8% GEL are breast tenderness, stomach cramps, pelvic pain, pain around genital area, vaginal discharge or itching, low sex drive, and sleepiness. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

Talk to your doctor if you experience breast enlargement and pain after using this medicine.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CRINONE 8% GEL
Female Infertility
mechanismOfAction:
How CRINONE 8% GEL Works

CRINONE 8% GEL contains progesterone which is a synthetic form of naturally occurring female sex hormone. Upon application into the vagina, it slowly releases the medicine and mimic as a natural progesterone which is required in maintaining optimum uterine thickness for egg implantation and maintenance of pregnancy in the early stages.
usageInstructions: Use CRINONE 8% GEL under medical supervision
Wash your hands thoroughly with soap and water.
CRINONE 8% GEL usually comes with a pre-filled applicator. Take the required amount of the medicine into the gel applicator
Lie on your back with your knees bent or stand with one foot elevated, whichever is more comfortable for you.
Gently insert the gel using the applicator into your vagina, pushing it as far as comfortable.
Slowly press the plunger to release the gel into the vagina.
Remove the applicator and discard it if it’s disposable or wash it with soap and water if it’s reusable.
Wash your hands again after the application.
Follow your doctor’s instructions regarding the timing and frequency of use.

This medicine should be used with caution in patients with history of asthma.

Heart Disease
USE WITH CAUTION

This medicine should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases.

Use In Pediatrics
CONTRAINDICATED

This medicine is not suitable for use in children and adolescents aged below 18 years.

Others

CRINONE 8% GEL is not recommended for use if you:

Have unexplained vaginal bleeding
Have porphyria
Think you might have breast cancer or cancers in your reproductive organs
Have ever had a blood clot due to swollen veins (thrombophlebitis), a blocked blood vessel (thromboembolic disorder) or a stroke

Before using this medicine, inform your doctor if you:

Have diabetes
Have epilepsy
Often get migraine headache
Have ever had depression
